use anchor_lang::prelude::*;
use anchor_lang::system_program;
use anchor_spl::token::{self, Mint, Token, TokenAccount, Transfer, CloseAccount};
use anchor_spl::associated_token::AssociatedToken;

// ============================================================
// PROGRAM ID — update after deployment
// ============================================================
declare_id!("12mH9wkUUvyQmhqD9A6gJzLGxEUCTZCCuddK6W9EbG2w");

// ============================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================

/// Platform treasury wallet
pub const PLATFORM_TREASURY: Pubkey = pubkey!("9xQeWvG816bUx9EPjHmaT23yvVM2ZWbrrpZb9PusVFin");

/// Tiered fee: flat $2 in USDC micro-units (6 decimals) for invoices below $200
pub const FLAT_FEE_USDC: u64 = 2_000_000; // $2.00

/// Tiered fee threshold: $200 in USDC micro-units
pub const TIER_THRESHOLD_USDC: u64 = 200_000_000; // $200.00

/// Above threshold: 1% (100 basis points)
pub const PERCENTAGE_FEE_BPS: u64 = 100;

/// Auto-release timeout: 7 days in seconds
pub const AUTO_RELEASE_TIMEOUT: i64 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;

/// Max installments in a release schedule
pub const MAX_INSTALLMENTS: usize = 10;

// ============================================================
// PROGRAM
// ============================================================

#[program]
pub mod workspace {
    use super::*;

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // CREATE INVOICE — USDC
    // description and client_email removed — stored in Supabase
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn initialize_config(
        ctx: Context<InitializeConfig>,
        invoice_id: String,
        amount: u64,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        require!(amount > 0, ErrorCode::InvalidAmount);
        require!(invoice_id.len() <= 32, ErrorCode::InvoiceIdTooLong);

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.bump = ctx.bumps.invoice;
        invoice.escrow_bump = ctx.bumps.escrow;
        invoice.invoice_id = invoice_id;
        invoice.creator = ctx.accounts.creator.key();
        invoice.client = None;
        invoice.amount = amount;
        invoice.amount_paid = 0;
        invoice.amount_released = 0;
        invoice.token_type = TokenType::USDC;
        invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::Unpaid;
        invoice.created_at = Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp;
        invoice.paid_at = None;
        invoice.released_at = None;
        invoice.release_schedule = Vec::new();
        invoice.current_release_index = 0;
        invoice.completion_requested_at = None;
        invoice.client_approved = false;
        invoice.dispute_raised_at = None;
        invoice.verdict_hash = None;
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // CREATE INVOICE — SOL
    // description and client_email removed — stored in Supabase
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn initialize_config_sol(
        ctx: Context<InitializeConfigSol>,
        invoice_id: String,
        amount: u64,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        require!(amount > 0, ErrorCode::InvalidAmount);
        require!(invoice_id.len() <= 32, ErrorCode::InvoiceIdTooLong);

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.bump = ctx.bumps.invoice;
        invoice.escrow_bump = 0;
        invoice.invoice_id = invoice_id;
        invoice.creator = ctx.accounts.creator.key();
        invoice.client = None;
        invoice.amount = amount;
        invoice.amount_paid = 0;
        invoice.amount_released = 0;
        invoice.token_type = TokenType::SOL;
        invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::Unpaid;
        invoice.created_at = Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp;
        invoice.paid_at = None;
        invoice.released_at = None;
        invoice.release_schedule = Vec::new();
        invoice.current_release_index = 0;
        invoice.completion_requested_at = None;
        invoice.client_approved = false;
        invoice.dispute_raised_at = None;
        invoice.verdict_hash = None;
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // PAY INVOICE — USDC
    // Tiered fee: flat $2 below $200 USDC, 1% above
    // Fee is always paid by the client, never the creator
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn pay_invoice(
        ctx: Context<PayInvoice>,
        invoice_id: String,
        payment_amount: u64,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(payment_amount > 0, ErrorCode::InvalidPaymentAmount);
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(
            invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::Unpaid || invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::PartiallyPaid,
            ErrorCode::InvoiceNotPayable
        );
        require!(invoice.token_type == TokenType::USDC, ErrorCode::TokenTypeMismatch);
        let remaining = invoice.amount.checked_sub(invoice.amount_paid).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        require!(payment_amount <= remaining, ErrorCode::PaymentExceedsRemaining);

        // Tiered fee for USDC — threshold is exact in micro-units
        let fee = if payment_amount < TIER_THRESHOLD_USDC {
            FLAT_FEE_USDC // $2 flat
        } else {
            payment_amount
                .checked_mul(PERCENTAGE_FEE_BPS)
                .ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?
                .checked_div(10000)
                .ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?
        };

        // Transfer payment_amount to escrow
        token::transfer(
            CpiContext::new(ctx.accounts.token_program.to_account_info(), Transfer {
                from: ctx.accounts.client_token.to_account_info(),
                to: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                authority: ctx.accounts.client.to_account_info(),
            }),
            payment_amount,
        )?;

        // Transfer fee to platform treasury
        if fee > 0 {
            token::transfer(
                CpiContext::new(ctx.accounts.token_program.to_account_info(), Transfer {
                    from: ctx.accounts.client_token.to_account_info(),
                    to: ctx.accounts.platform_treasury_token.to_account_info(),
                    authority: ctx.accounts.client.to_account_info(),
                }),
                fee,
            )?;
        }

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        let new_amount_paid = invoice.amount_paid.checked_add(payment_amount).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        invoice.amount_paid = new_amount_paid;
        if invoice.client.is_none() { invoice.client = Some(ctx.accounts.client.key()); }
        if new_amount_paid == invoice.amount {
            invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::FullyPaid;
            invoice.paid_at = Some(Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp);
        } else {
            invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::PartiallyPaid;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // PAY INVOICE — SOL
    // Fee is calculated on the frontend using Pyth Hermes REST API
    // and passed in as fee_amount (in lamports).
    // Frontend logic: below $200 USD = flat $2 in SOL, above = 1%
    // Contract enforces fee > 0 and transfers it to treasury
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn pay_invoice_sol(
        ctx: Context<PayInvoiceSol>,
        invoice_id: String,
        payment_amount: u64,
        fee_amount: u64,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(payment_amount > 0, ErrorCode::InvalidPaymentAmount);
        require!(fee_amount > 0, ErrorCode::InvalidFeeAmount);
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(
            invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::Unpaid || invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::PartiallyPaid,
            ErrorCode::InvoiceNotPayable
        );
        require!(invoice.token_type == TokenType::SOL, ErrorCode::TokenTypeMismatch);
        let remaining = invoice.amount.checked_sub(invoice.amount_paid).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        require!(payment_amount <= remaining, ErrorCode::PaymentExceedsRemaining);

        let fee = fee_amount;

        // Transfer payment to invoice account (SOL escrow)
        system_program::transfer(
            CpiContext::new(ctx.accounts.system_program.to_account_info(), system_program::Transfer {
                from: ctx.accounts.client.to_account_info(),
                to: ctx.accounts.invoice.to_account_info(),
            }),
            payment_amount,
        )?;

        // Transfer fee to platform treasury
        if fee > 0 {
            system_program::transfer(
                CpiContext::new(ctx.accounts.system_program.to_account_info(), system_program::Transfer {
                    from: ctx.accounts.client.to_account_info(),
                    to: ctx.accounts.platform_treasury.to_account_info(),
                }),
                fee,
            )?;
        }

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        let new_amount_paid = invoice.amount_paid.checked_add(payment_amount).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        invoice.amount_paid = new_amount_paid;
        if invoice.client.is_none() { invoice.client = Some(ctx.accounts.client.key()); }
        if new_amount_paid == invoice.amount {
            invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::FullyPaid;
            invoice.paid_at = Some(Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp);
        } else {
            invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::PartiallyPaid;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // SET RELEASE SCHEDULE
    // Called by client after paying full amount
    // schedule: basis points per installment, must sum to 10000
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn set_release_schedule(
        ctx: Context<SetReleaseSchedule>,
        invoice_id: String,
        schedule: Vec<u16>,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::FullyPaid, ErrorCode::InvoiceNotFullyPaid);
        require!(invoice.client == Some(ctx.accounts.client.key()), ErrorCode::Unauthorized);
        require!(invoice.release_schedule.is_empty(), ErrorCode::ScheduleAlreadySet);
        require!(!schedule.is_empty(), ErrorCode::InvalidSchedule);
        require!(schedule.len() <= MAX_INSTALLMENTS, ErrorCode::TooManyInstallments);
        for &bps in &schedule { require!(bps > 0, ErrorCode::InvalidSchedule); }
        let total: u32 = schedule.iter().map(|&x| x as u32).sum();
        require!(total == 10000, ErrorCode::ScheduleMustSumTo100);

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.release_schedule = schedule;
        invoice.current_release_index = 0;
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // REQUEST RELEASE (DUAL APPROVAL — STEP 1)
    // Creator signals work is complete for current installment
    // Starts the 7-day client approval window
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn request_release(
        ctx: Context<RequestRelease>,
        invoice_id: String,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(invoice.creator == ctx.accounts.creator.key(), ErrorCode::Unauthorized);
        require!(
            invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::PartiallyPaid || invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::FullyPaid,
            ErrorCode::InvoiceNotReleasable
        );
        require!(invoice.status != InvoiceStatus::Disputed, ErrorCode::InvoiceDisputed);
        require!(invoice.completion_requested_at.is_none(), ErrorCode::ReleaseAlreadyRequested);

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.completion_requested_at = Some(Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp);
        invoice.client_approved = false;
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // APPROVE RELEASE (DUAL APPROVAL — STEP 2)
    // Client approves — funds can now be released
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn approve_release(
        ctx: Context<ApproveRelease>,
        invoice_id: String,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(invoice.client == Some(ctx.accounts.client.key()), ErrorCode::Unauthorized);
        require!(invoice.completion_requested_at.is_some(), ErrorCode::NoReleaseRequested);
        require!(invoice.status != InvoiceStatus::Disputed, ErrorCode::InvoiceDisputed);

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.client_approved = true;
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // RAISE DISPUTE
    // Client raises dispute within 7-day window
    // Remaining unreleased installments freeze immediately
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn raise_dispute(
        ctx: Context<RaiseDispute>,
        invoice_id: String,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(invoice.client == Some(ctx.accounts.client.key()), ErrorCode::Unauthorized);
        require!(
            invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::PartiallyPaid || invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::FullyPaid,
            ErrorCode::InvoiceNotReleasable
        );
        require!(invoice.status != InvoiceStatus::Disputed, ErrorCode::AlreadyDisputed);

        // Must be within the 7-day window after a release request
        if let Some(requested_at) = invoice.completion_requested_at {
            let now = Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp;
            require!(
                now - requested_at <= AUTO_RELEASE_TIMEOUT,
                ErrorCode::DisputeWindowExpired
            );
        } else {
            // Can also dispute without a pending release request (while funds are in escrow)
        }

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::Disputed;
        invoice.dispute_raised_at = Some(Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp);
        invoice.completion_requested_at = None; // Cancel pending release request
        invoice.client_approved = false;
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // RELEASE FUNDS — USDC
    // Requires either:
    //   (a) client approved, OR
    //   (b) 7-day timeout has passed since request
    // Enforces installment schedule if set
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn release_funds(
        ctx: Context<ReleaseFunds>,
        invoice_id: String,
        release_amount: u64,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(release_amount > 0, ErrorCode::InvalidReleaseAmount);
        require!(invoice.creator == ctx.accounts.creator.key(), ErrorCode::Unauthorized);
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(
            invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::PartiallyPaid || invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::FullyPaid,
            ErrorCode::InvoiceNotReleasable
        );
        require!(invoice.token_type == TokenType::USDC, ErrorCode::TokenTypeMismatch);
        require!(invoice.status != InvoiceStatus::Disputed, ErrorCode::InvoiceDisputed);

        // Dual approval check: must have request + either approval or timeout
        require!(invoice.completion_requested_at.is_some(), ErrorCode::NoReleaseRequested);
        let requested_at = invoice.completion_requested_at.unwrap();
        let now = Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp;
        let timeout_passed = now - requested_at > AUTO_RELEASE_TIMEOUT;
        require!(
            invoice.client_approved || timeout_passed,
            ErrorCode::AwaitingClientApproval
        );

        // Enforce installment schedule if set
        if !invoice.release_schedule.is_empty() {
            let idx = invoice.current_release_index as usize;
            require!(idx < invoice.release_schedule.len(), ErrorCode::AllInstallmentsReleased);
            let installment_bps = invoice.release_schedule[idx] as u64;
            let installment_amount = invoice.amount_paid
                .checked_mul(installment_bps).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?
                .checked_div(10000).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
            require!(release_amount == installment_amount, ErrorCode::InvalidInstallmentAmount);
        }

        let releasable = invoice.amount_paid.checked_sub(invoice.amount_released).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        require!(release_amount <= releasable, ErrorCode::ReleaseExceedsAvailable);

        let creator_key = ctx.accounts.creator.key();
        let invoice_id_bytes = invoice.invoice_id.as_bytes();
        let escrow_bump = invoice.escrow_bump;
        let bump_arr = [escrow_bump];
        let seeds = &[b"escrow", invoice_id_bytes, creator_key.as_ref(), &bump_arr];
        let signer_seeds: &[&[&[u8]]] = &[seeds];

        token::transfer(
            CpiContext::new_with_signer(ctx.accounts.token_program.to_account_info(), Transfer {
                from: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                to: ctx.accounts.creator_token.to_account_info(),
                authority: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
            }, signer_seeds),
            release_amount,
        )?;

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        let new_amount_released = invoice.amount_released.checked_add(release_amount).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        invoice.amount_released = new_amount_released;

        if !invoice.release_schedule.is_empty() {
            invoice.current_release_index = invoice.current_release_index.checked_add(1).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        }

        // Reset approval state for next installment
        invoice.completion_requested_at = None;
        invoice.client_approved = false;

        if new_amount_released == invoice.amount_paid && invoice.amount_paid == invoice.amount {
            invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::Released;
            invoice.released_at = Some(Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp);

            // Close escrow account and return rent to creator
            let creator_key = ctx.accounts.creator.key();
            let invoice_id_bytes = ctx.accounts.invoice.invoice_id.as_bytes();
            let escrow_bump = ctx.accounts.invoice.escrow_bump;
            let bump_arr = [escrow_bump];
            let seeds = &[b"escrow", invoice_id_bytes, creator_key.as_ref(), &bump_arr];
            let signer_seeds: &[&[&[u8]]] = &[seeds];
            token::close_account(
                CpiContext::new_with_signer(ctx.accounts.token_program.to_account_info(), CloseAccount {
                    account: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                    destination: ctx.accounts.creator.to_account_info(),
                    authority: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                }, signer_seeds),
            )?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // RELEASE FUNDS — SOL
    // Same dual approval logic as USDC version
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn release_funds_sol(
        ctx: Context<ReleaseFundsSol>,
        invoice_id: String,
        release_amount: u64,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(release_amount > 0, ErrorCode::InvalidReleaseAmount);
        require!(invoice.creator == ctx.accounts.creator.key(), ErrorCode::Unauthorized);
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(
            invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::PartiallyPaid || invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::FullyPaid,
            ErrorCode::InvoiceNotReleasable
        );
        require!(invoice.token_type == TokenType::SOL, ErrorCode::TokenTypeMismatch);
        require!(invoice.status != InvoiceStatus::Disputed, ErrorCode::InvoiceDisputed);

        // Dual approval check
        require!(invoice.completion_requested_at.is_some(), ErrorCode::NoReleaseRequested);
        let requested_at = invoice.completion_requested_at.unwrap();
        let now = Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp;
        let timeout_passed = now - requested_at > AUTO_RELEASE_TIMEOUT;
        require!(invoice.client_approved || timeout_passed, ErrorCode::AwaitingClientApproval);

        // Enforce installment schedule if set
        if !invoice.release_schedule.is_empty() {
            let idx = invoice.current_release_index as usize;
            require!(idx < invoice.release_schedule.len(), ErrorCode::AllInstallmentsReleased);
            let installment_bps = invoice.release_schedule[idx] as u64;
            let installment_amount = invoice.amount_paid
                .checked_mul(installment_bps).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?
                .checked_div(10000).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
            require!(release_amount == installment_amount, ErrorCode::InvalidInstallmentAmount);
        }

        let releasable = invoice.amount_paid.checked_sub(invoice.amount_released).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        require!(release_amount <= releasable, ErrorCode::ReleaseExceedsAvailable);
        let new_amount_released = invoice.amount_released.checked_add(release_amount).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        let is_final_release = new_amount_released == invoice.amount_paid && invoice.amount_paid == invoice.amount;

        let invoice_info = ctx.accounts.invoice.to_account_info();
        let creator_info = ctx.accounts.creator.to_account_info();
        let rent = Rent::get()?;
        let rent_exempt_minimum = rent.minimum_balance(8 + Invoice::LEN);
        let invoice_lamports = invoice_info.lamports();
        let available_lamports = invoice_lamports.checked_sub(rent_exempt_minimum).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;

        if is_final_release {
            **invoice_info.try_borrow_mut_lamports()? = rent_exempt_minimum;
            **creator_info.try_borrow_mut_lamports()? = creator_info.lamports()
                .checked_add(available_lamports).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        } else {
            require!(release_amount <= available_lamports, ErrorCode::ReleaseExceedsAvailable);
            **invoice_info.try_borrow_mut_lamports()? = invoice_lamports
                .checked_sub(release_amount).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
            **creator_info.try_borrow_mut_lamports()? = creator_info.lamports()
                .checked_add(release_amount).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        }

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.amount_released = new_amount_released;
        if !invoice.release_schedule.is_empty() {
            invoice.current_release_index = invoice.current_release_index.checked_add(1).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        }
        invoice.completion_requested_at = None;
        invoice.client_approved = false;

        if is_final_release {
            invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::Released;
            invoice.released_at = Some(Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // RESOLVE DISPUTE (KENNY ONLY)
    // Kenny splits funds manually after reviewing evidence
    // creator_bps + client_bps must equal 10000
    // Only remaining unreleased installments are split
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn resolve_dispute(
        ctx: Context<ResolveDispute>,
        invoice_id: String,
        creator_bps: u16,
        client_bps: u16,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::Disputed, ErrorCode::NotDisputed);
        require!(ctx.accounts.kenny.key() == PLATFORM_TREASURY, ErrorCode::Unauthorized);
        if let Some(client_key) = invoice.client {
            require!(ctx.accounts.client_token.owner == client_key, ErrorCode::InvalidOwner);
        }
        require!(creator_bps as u32 + client_bps as u32 == 10000, ErrorCode::InvalidSplit);
        require!(invoice.token_type == TokenType::USDC, ErrorCode::TokenTypeMismatch);

        let splittable = invoice.amount_paid
            .checked_sub(invoice.amount_released)
            .ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        require!(splittable > 0, ErrorCode::NoFundsToSplit);

        let creator_share = splittable
            .checked_mul(creator_bps as u64).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?
            .checked_div(10000).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        let client_share = splittable
            .checked_sub(creator_share).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;

        let creator_key = ctx.accounts.creator.key();
        let invoice_id_bytes = invoice.invoice_id.as_bytes();
        let escrow_bump = invoice.escrow_bump;
        let bump_arr = [escrow_bump];
        let seeds = &[b"escrow", invoice_id_bytes, creator_key.as_ref(), &bump_arr];
        let signer_seeds: &[&[&[u8]]] = &[seeds];

        if creator_share > 0 {
            token::transfer(
                CpiContext::new_with_signer(ctx.accounts.token_program.to_account_info(), Transfer {
                    from: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                    to: ctx.accounts.creator_token.to_account_info(),
                    authority: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                }, signer_seeds),
                creator_share,
            )?;
        }

        if client_share > 0 {
            token::transfer(
                CpiContext::new_with_signer(ctx.accounts.token_program.to_account_info(), Transfer {
                    from: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                    to: ctx.accounts.client_token.to_account_info(),
                    authority: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                }, signer_seeds),
                client_share,
            )?;
        }

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.amount_released = invoice.amount_released.checked_add(creator_share).ok_or(ErrorCode::MathOverflow)?;
        invoice.status = InvoiceStatus::Released;
        invoice.released_at = Some(Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp);

        // Close escrow
        let creator_key = ctx.accounts.creator.key();
        let invoice_id_bytes = ctx.accounts.invoice.invoice_id.as_bytes();
        let escrow_bump = ctx.accounts.invoice.escrow_bump;
        let bump_arr = [escrow_bump];
        let seeds = &[b"escrow", invoice_id_bytes, creator_key.as_ref(), &bump_arr];
        let signer_seeds: &[&[&[u8]]] = &[seeds];
        token::close_account(
            CpiContext::new_with_signer(ctx.accounts.token_program.to_account_info(), CloseAccount {
                account: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
                destination: ctx.accounts.creator.to_account_info(),
                authority: ctx.accounts.escrow.to_account_info(),
            }, signer_seeds),
        )?;

        Ok(())
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // STORE VERDICT HASH (KENNY ONLY)
    // SHA-512 hash of the dispute verdict produced off-chain.
    // Written on-chain after Claude reviews evidence in Supabase.
    // Provides cryptographic proof of verdict — not just "trust me".
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    pub fn store_verdict_hash(
        ctx: Context<StoreVerdictHash>,
        invoice_id: String,
        hash: [u8; 64],
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let invoice = &ctx.accounts.invoice;
        require!(invoice.invoice_id == invoice_id, ErrorCode::InvalidInvoiceId);
        require!(invoice.status == InvoiceStatus::Disputed, ErrorCode::NotDisputed);
        require!(ctx.accounts.kenny.key() == PLATFORM_TREASURY, ErrorCode::Unauthorized);

        let invoice = &mut ctx.accounts.invoice;
        invoice.verdict_hash = Some(hash);
        Ok(())
    }
}

// ============================================================
// INVOICE ACCOUNT
// ============================================================

#[account]
pub struct Invoice {
    pub bump: u8,
    pub escrow_bump: u8,
    pub invoice_id: String,                  // max 32
    pub creator: Pubkey,
    pub client: Option<Pubkey>,
    pub amount: u64,
    pub amount_paid: u64,
    pub amount_released: u64,
    pub token_type: TokenType,
    pub status: InvoiceStatus,
    pub created_at: i64,
    pub paid_at: Option<i64>,
    pub released_at: Option<i64>,
    // Release schedule
    pub release_schedule: Vec<u16>,          // basis points, sums to 10000
    pub current_release_index: u8,
    // Dual approval
    pub completion_requested_at: Option<i64>,
    pub client_approved: bool,
    // Dispute
    pub dispute_raised_at: Option<i64>,
    pub verdict_hash: Option<[u8; 64]>,      // SHA-512 of off-chain verdict
}

impl Invoice {
    pub const LEN: usize =
        1 +                         // bump
        1 +                         // escrow_bump
        (4 + 32) +                  // invoice_id String (max 32 bytes)
        32 +                        // creator Pubkey
        (1 + 32) +                  // client Option<Pubkey>
        8 +                         // amount
        8 +                         // amount_paid
        8 +                         // amount_released
        1 +                         // token_type
        1 +                         // status
        8 +                         // created_at
        (1 + 8) +                   // paid_at Option<i64>
        (1 + 8) +                   // released_at Option<i64>
        (4 + MAX_INSTALLMENTS * 2) + // release_schedule Vec<u16>
        1 +                         // current_release_index
        (1 + 8) +                   // completion_requested_at Option<i64>
        1 +                         // client_approved bool
        (1 + 8) +                   // dispute_raised_at Option<i64>
        (1 + 64);                   // verdict_hash Option<[u8; 64]>
}

// ============================================================
// ENUMS
// ============================================================

#[derive(AnchorSerialize, AnchorDeserialize, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TokenType { USDC = 0, SOL = 1 }

#[derive(AnchorSerialize, AnchorDeserialize, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum InvoiceStatus {
    Unpaid = 0,
    PartiallyPaid = 1,
    FullyPaid = 2,
    Released = 3,
    Disputed = 4,
}

// ============================================================
// ERRORS
// ============================================================

#[error_code]
pub enum ErrorCode {
    #[msg("Invalid amount")] InvalidAmount,
    #[msg("Invoice ID too long — max 32 chars")] InvoiceIdTooLong,
    #[msg("Invoice is not payable")] InvoiceNotPayable,
    #[msg("Invoice is not releasable")] InvoiceNotReleasable,
    #[msg("Invoice must be fully paid before setting release schedule")] InvoiceNotFullyPaid,
    #[msg("Invalid invoice ID")] InvalidInvoiceId,
    #[msg("Unauthorized")] Unauthorized,
    #[msg("Invalid mint")] InvalidMint,
    #[msg("Invalid owner")] InvalidOwner,
    #[msg("Invalid treasury")] InvalidTreasury,
    #[msg("Math overflow")] MathOverflow,
    #[msg("Invalid payment amount")] InvalidPaymentAmount,
    #[msg("Invalid fee amount — must be greater than 0")] InvalidFeeAmount,
    #[msg("Payment exceeds remaining invoice amount")] PaymentExceedsRemaining,
    #[msg("Invalid release amount")] InvalidReleaseAmount,
    #[msg("Release amount exceeds available funds")] ReleaseExceedsAvailable,
    #[msg("Token type mismatch")] TokenTypeMismatch,
    #[msg("Invalid release schedule")] InvalidSchedule,
    #[msg("Release schedule must sum to exactly 100%")] ScheduleMustSumTo100,
    #[msg("Release schedule already set")] ScheduleAlreadySet,
    #[msg("Too many installments — max 10")] TooManyInstallments,
    #[msg("All installments have already been released")] AllInstallmentsReleased,
    #[msg("Release amount must match the current installment amount")] InvalidInstallmentAmount,
    #[msg("No release request pending — creator must request release first")] NoReleaseRequested,
    #[msg("Release request already pending")] ReleaseAlreadyRequested,
    #[msg("Awaiting client approval or 7-day timeout")] AwaitingClientApproval,
    #[msg("Invoice is disputed — funds are frozen")] InvoiceDisputed,
    #[msg("Invoice is not in disputed state")] NotDisputed,
    #[msg("Already disputed")] AlreadyDisputed,
    #[msg("Dispute window has expired")] DisputeWindowExpired,
    #[msg("creator_bps + client_bps must equal 10000")] InvalidSplit,
    #[msg("No funds available to split")] NoFundsToSplit,
}

import * as anchor from "@coral-xyz/anchor";
import { Program } from "@coral-xyz/anchor";
import { Workspace } from "../target/types/workspace";
import { expect } from "chai";
import {
  TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
  ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
  createMint,
  createAssociatedTokenAccount,
  mintTo,
  getAccount,
  getAssociatedTokenAddress,
} from "@solana/spl-token";
import {
  PublicKey,
  SystemProgram,
  Keypair,
  LAMPORTS_PER_SOL,
  SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
} from "@solana/web3.js";

describe("EscrowPay Invoice Payment Program", () => {
  const provider = anchor.AnchorProvider.env();
  anchor.setProvider(provider);

  const program = anchor.workspace.Workspace as Program<Workspace>;

  // Platform treasury (must match the constant in the program)
  const PLATFORM_TREASURY = new PublicKey("9xQeWvG816bUx9EPjHmaT23yvVM2ZWbrrpZb9PusVFin");
  const PLATFORM_FEE_BPS = 100; // 1%

  let creator: Keypair;
  let client: Keypair;
  let usdcMint: PublicKey;
  let creatorTokenAccount: PublicKey;
  let clientTokenAccount: PublicKey;
  let platformTreasuryTokenAccount: PublicKey;

  const invoiceId = "INV-001";
  const amount = new anchor.BN(1000000); // 1 USDC (6 decimals)

  before(async () => {
    // Generate keypairs
    creator = Keypair.generate();
    client = Keypair.generate();

    // Fund accounts with 100 SOL each
    await provider.connection.confirmTransaction(
      await provider.connection.requestAirdrop(
        creator.publicKey,
        100 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL
      )
    );
    await provider.connection.confirmTransaction(
      await provider.connection.requestAirdrop(
        client.publicKey,
        100 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL
      )
    );
    // Fund platform treasury for rent
    await provider.connection.confirmTransaction(
      await provider.connection.requestAirdrop(
        PLATFORM_TREASURY,
        10 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL
      )
    );

    // Create USDC mock mint
    usdcMint = await createMint(
      provider.connection,
      creator,
      creator.publicKey,
      null,
      6 // USDC has 6 decimals
    );

    // Create token accounts
    creatorTokenAccount = await createAssociatedTokenAccount(
      provider.connection,
      creator,
      usdcMint,
      creator.publicKey
    );

    clientTokenAccount = await createAssociatedTokenAccount(
      provider.connection,
      client,
      usdcMint,
      client.publicKey
    );

    // Create platform treasury token account
    platformTreasuryTokenAccount = await createAssociatedTokenAccount(
      provider.connection,
      creator,
      usdcMint,
      PLATFORM_TREASURY
    );

    // Mint USDC to client for testing payments (100 USDC)
    await mintTo(
      provider.connection,
      creator,
      usdcMint,
      clientTokenAccount,
      creator,
      100000000 // 100 USDC
    );
  });

  const getInvoicePDA = (invoiceId: string, creatorPubkey: PublicKey) => {
    return PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
      [
        Buffer.from("invoice"),
        Buffer.from(invoiceId),
        creatorPubkey.toBuffer(),
      ],
      program.programId
    );
  };

  const getEscrowPDA = (invoiceId: string, creatorPubkey: PublicKey) => {
    return PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
      [
        Buffer.from("escrow"),
        Buffer.from(invoiceId),
        creatorPubkey.toBuffer(),
      ],
      program.programId
    );
  };

  describe("initialize_config (USDC Invoice)", () => {
    it("should create a USDC invoice successfully", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(invoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(invoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      await program.methods
        .initializeConfig(invoiceId, amount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      // Fetch and verify invoice
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.invoiceId).to.equal(invoiceId);
      expect(invoice.creator.toString()).to.equal(creator.publicKey.toString());
      expect(invoice.client).to.be.null;
      expect(invoice.amount.toString()).to.equal(amount.toString());
      expect(invoice.amountPaid.toString()).to.equal("0");
      expect(invoice.amountReleased.toString()).to.equal("0");
      expect(invoice.tokenType).to.deep.equal({ usdc: {} });
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ unpaid: {} });
      expect(Number(invoice.createdAt)).to.be.greaterThan(0);
      expect(invoice.paidAt).to.be.null;
      expect(invoice.releasedAt).to.be.null;
    });

    it("should fail with zero amount", async () => {
      const testInvoiceId = "INV-ZERO";
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      try {
        await program.methods
          .initializeConfig(testInvoiceId, new anchor.BN(0))
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoicePDA,
            escrow: escrowPDA,
            usdcMint: usdcMint,
            creator: creator.publicKey,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
            rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
          })
          .signers([creator])
          .rpc();
        expect.fail("Should have thrown error");
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error.message).to.include("InvalidAmount");
      }
    });
  });

  describe("initialize_config_sol (SOL Invoice)", () => {
    const solInvoiceId = "INV-SOL-001";
    const solAmount = new anchor.BN(1 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL); // 1 SOL

    it("should create a SOL invoice successfully", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(solInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      await program.methods
        .initializeConfigSol(solInvoiceId, solAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      // Fetch and verify invoice
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.invoiceId).to.equal(solInvoiceId);
      expect(invoice.tokenType).to.deep.equal({ sol: {} });
      expect(invoice.amount.toString()).to.equal(solAmount.toString());
      expect(invoice.amountPaid.toString()).to.equal("0");
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ unpaid: {} });
    });
  });

  describe("pay_invoice (USDC - Partial Payments)", () => {
    const payInvoiceId = "INV-PAY-001";
    const invoiceAmount = new anchor.BN(2000000); // 2 USDC

    before(async () => {
      // Create invoice for payment tests
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(payInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(payInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      await program.methods
        .initializeConfig(payInvoiceId, invoiceAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();
    });

    it("should make partial payment successfully", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(payInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(payInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      const partialPayment = new anchor.BN(1000000); // 1 USDC
      const expectedFee = partialPayment.toNumber() * PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000; // 1% fee

      // Get balances before
      const clientBalanceBefore = await getAccount(provider.connection, clientTokenAccount);
      const treasuryBalanceBefore = await getAccount(provider.connection, platformTreasuryTokenAccount);

      await program.methods
        .payInvoice(payInvoiceId, partialPayment)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
          platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          client: client.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();

      // Verify invoice status is PartiallyPaid
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ partiallyPaid: {} });
      expect(invoice.amountPaid.toString()).to.equal(partialPayment.toString());
      expect(invoice.client.toString()).to.equal(client.publicKey.toString());

      // Verify escrow received payment
      const escrowAccount = await getAccount(provider.connection, escrowPDA);
      expect(Number(escrowAccount.amount)).to.equal(partialPayment.toNumber());

      // Verify platform treasury received fee
      const treasuryBalanceAfter = await getAccount(provider.connection, platformTreasuryTokenAccount);
      expect(Number(treasuryBalanceAfter.amount) - Number(treasuryBalanceBefore.amount)).to.equal(expectedFee);

      // Verify client paid payment + fee
      const clientBalanceAfter = await getAccount(provider.connection, clientTokenAccount);
      const clientPaid = Number(clientBalanceBefore.amount) - Number(clientBalanceAfter.amount);
      expect(clientPaid).to.equal(partialPayment.toNumber() + expectedFee);
    });

    it("should complete payment with second partial payment", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(payInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(payInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      const remainingPayment = new anchor.BN(1000000); // 1 USDC (remaining)

      await program.methods
        .payInvoice(payInvoiceId, remainingPayment)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
          platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          client: client.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();

      // Verify invoice status is FullyPaid
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ fullyPaid: {} });
      expect(invoice.amountPaid.toString()).to.equal(invoiceAmount.toString());
      expect(Number(invoice.paidAt)).to.be.greaterThan(0);
    });

    it("should fail when payment exceeds remaining amount", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(payInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(payInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      try {
        await program.methods
          .payInvoice(payInvoiceId, new anchor.BN(1000000))
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoicePDA,
            escrow: escrowPDA,
            clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
            platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
            usdcMint: usdcMint,
            client: client.publicKey,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          })
          .signers([client])
          .rpc();
        expect.fail("Should have thrown error");
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error.message).to.include("InvoiceNotPayable");
      }
    });

    it("should fail with zero payment amount", async () => {
      const testInvoiceId = "INV-ZERO-PAY";
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      // Create invoice first
      await program.methods
        .initializeConfig(testInvoiceId, amount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      try {
        await program.methods
          .payInvoice(testInvoiceId, new anchor.BN(0))
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoicePDA,
            escrow: escrowPDA,
            clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
            platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
            usdcMint: usdcMint,
            client: client.publicKey,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          })
          .signers([client])
          .rpc();
        expect.fail("Should have thrown error");
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error.message).to.include("InvalidPaymentAmount");
      }
    });
  });

  describe("pay_invoice_sol (SOL - Partial Payments)", () => {
    const solPayInvoiceId = "INV-SOL-PAY-001";
    const solInvoiceAmount = new anchor.BN(2 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL); // 2 SOL

    before(async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(solPayInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      await program.methods
        .initializeConfigSol(solPayInvoiceId, solInvoiceAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();
    });

    it("should make partial SOL payment successfully", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(solPayInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      const partialPayment = new anchor.BN(1 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL); // 1 SOL
      const expectedFee = partialPayment.toNumber() * PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000;

      const clientBalanceBefore = await provider.connection.getBalance(client.publicKey);
      const treasuryBalanceBefore = await provider.connection.getBalance(PLATFORM_TREASURY);
      const invoiceBalanceBefore = await provider.connection.getBalance(invoicePDA);

      await program.methods
        .payInvoiceSol(solPayInvoiceId, partialPayment)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          platformTreasury: PLATFORM_TREASURY,
          client: client.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();

      // Verify invoice status
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ partiallyPaid: {} });
      expect(invoice.amountPaid.toString()).to.equal(partialPayment.toString());

      // Verify invoice account received payment (SOL stored in invoice account)
      const invoiceBalanceAfter = await provider.connection.getBalance(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoiceBalanceAfter - invoiceBalanceBefore).to.equal(partialPayment.toNumber());

      // Verify platform treasury received fee
      const treasuryBalanceAfter = await provider.connection.getBalance(PLATFORM_TREASURY);
      expect(treasuryBalanceAfter - treasuryBalanceBefore).to.equal(expectedFee);
    });

    it("should complete SOL payment with second partial payment", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(solPayInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      const remainingPayment = new anchor.BN(1 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL); // 1 SOL

      await program.methods
        .payInvoiceSol(solPayInvoiceId, remainingPayment)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          platformTreasury: PLATFORM_TREASURY,
          client: client.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();

      // Verify invoice status is FullyPaid
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ fullyPaid: {} });
      expect(invoice.amountPaid.toString()).to.equal(solInvoiceAmount.toString());
    });
  });

  describe("release_funds (USDC - Partial Releases)", () => {
    const releaseInvoiceId = "INV-RELEASE-001";
    const invoiceAmount = new anchor.BN(2000000); // 2 USDC

    before(async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(releaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(releaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      // Create invoice
      await program.methods
        .initializeConfig(releaseInvoiceId, invoiceAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      // Pay invoice fully
      await program.methods
        .payInvoice(releaseInvoiceId, invoiceAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
          platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          client: client.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();
    });

    it("should release partial funds successfully", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(releaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(releaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      const partialRelease = new anchor.BN(1000000); // 1 USDC

      const creatorBalanceBefore = await getAccount(provider.connection, creatorTokenAccount);

      await program.methods
        .releaseFunds(releaseInvoiceId, partialRelease)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          creatorToken: creatorTokenAccount,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          associatedTokenProgram: ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      // Verify invoice state
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.amountReleased.toString()).to.equal(partialRelease.toString());
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ fullyPaid: {} }); // Still FullyPaid, not Released yet

      // Verify creator received funds
      const creatorBalanceAfter = await getAccount(provider.connection, creatorTokenAccount);
      expect(Number(creatorBalanceAfter.amount) - Number(creatorBalanceBefore.amount)).to.equal(partialRelease.toNumber());
    });

    it("should release remaining funds and update status to Released", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(releaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(releaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      const remainingRelease = new anchor.BN(1000000); // 1 USDC

      await program.methods
        .releaseFunds(releaseInvoiceId, remainingRelease)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          creatorToken: creatorTokenAccount,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          associatedTokenProgram: ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      // Verify invoice status is Released
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ released: {} });
      expect(invoice.amountReleased.toString()).to.equal(invoiceAmount.toString());
      expect(Number(invoice.releasedAt)).to.be.greaterThan(0);
    });

    it("should fail when release exceeds available funds", async () => {
      const testInvoiceId = "INV-RELEASE-EXCEED";
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      // Create and pay invoice
      await program.methods
        .initializeConfig(testInvoiceId, amount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      await program.methods
        .payInvoice(testInvoiceId, amount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
          platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          client: client.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();

      try {
        await program.methods
          .releaseFunds(testInvoiceId, new anchor.BN(2000000)) // Try to release more than paid
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoicePDA,
            escrow: escrowPDA,
            creatorToken: creatorTokenAccount,
            usdcMint: usdcMint,
            creator: creator.publicKey,
            associatedTokenProgram: ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          })
          .signers([creator])
          .rpc();
        expect.fail("Should have thrown error");
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error.message).to.include("ReleaseExceedsAvailable");
      }
    });

    it("should fail when unauthorized user tries to release", async () => {
      const testInvoiceId = "INV-RELEASE-UNAUTH";
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [clientInvoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(testInvoiceId, client.publicKey);
      const [clientEscrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(testInvoiceId, client.publicKey);

      // Create and pay invoice
      await program.methods
        .initializeConfig(testInvoiceId, amount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      await program.methods
        .payInvoice(testInvoiceId, amount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
          platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          client: client.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();

      try {
        // Try to release using client's derived PDAs (wrong creator)
        await program.methods
          .releaseFunds(testInvoiceId, amount)
          .accounts({
            invoice: clientInvoicePDA, // This PDA doesn't exist
            escrow: clientEscrowPDA,
            creatorToken: clientTokenAccount,
            usdcMint: usdcMint,
            creator: client.publicKey, // Wrong creator
            associatedTokenProgram: ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          })
          .signers([client])
          .rpc();
        expect.fail("Should have thrown error");
      } catch (error) {
        // The error will be about account not existing since PDAs are derived from creator
        expect(error.message).to.include("AccountNotInitialized");
      }
    });
  });

  describe("release_funds_sol (SOL - Partial Releases)", () => {
    const solReleaseInvoiceId = "INV-SOL-RELEASE-001";
    const solInvoiceAmount = new anchor.BN(2 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL); // 2 SOL

    before(async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(solReleaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      // Create SOL invoice
      await program.methods
        .initializeConfigSol(solReleaseInvoiceId, solInvoiceAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      // Pay invoice fully
      await program.methods
        .payInvoiceSol(solReleaseInvoiceId, solInvoiceAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          platformTreasury: PLATFORM_TREASURY,
          client: client.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();
    });

    it("should release partial SOL funds successfully", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(solReleaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      const partialRelease = new anchor.BN(1 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL); // 1 SOL

      const creatorBalanceBefore = await provider.connection.getBalance(creator.publicKey);

      await program.methods
        .releaseFundsSol(solReleaseInvoiceId, partialRelease)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      // Verify invoice state
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.amountReleased.toString()).to.equal(partialRelease.toString());

      // Verify creator received funds (accounting for tx fees)
      const creatorBalanceAfter = await provider.connection.getBalance(creator.publicKey);
      expect(creatorBalanceAfter - creatorBalanceBefore).to.be.greaterThanOrEqual(partialRelease.toNumber() - 10000);
    });

    it("should release remaining SOL funds and update status to Released", async () => {
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(solReleaseInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      const remainingRelease = new anchor.BN(1 * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL); // 1 SOL

      await program.methods
        .releaseFundsSol(solReleaseInvoiceId, remainingRelease)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      // Verify invoice status is Released
      const invoice = await program.account.invoice.fetch(invoicePDA);
      expect(invoice.status).to.deep.equal({ released: {} });
      expect(Number(invoice.releasedAt)).to.be.greaterThan(0);
    });
  });

  describe("Token Type Mismatch Validation", () => {
    it("should fail when paying USDC invoice with SOL method", async () => {
      const testInvoiceId = "INV-MISMATCH-USDC";
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      // Create USDC invoice
      await program.methods
        .initializeConfig(testInvoiceId, amount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      try {
        await program.methods
          .payInvoiceSol(testInvoiceId, new anchor.BN(LAMPORTS_PER_SOL))
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoicePDA,
            platformTreasury: PLATFORM_TREASURY,
            client: client.publicKey,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          })
          .signers([client])
          .rpc();
        expect.fail("Should have thrown error");
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error.message).to.include("TokenTypeMismatch");
      }
    });

    it("should fail when paying SOL invoice with USDC method", async () => {
      const testInvoiceId = "INV-MISMATCH-SOL";
      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      // Create SOL invoice
      await program.methods
        .initializeConfigSol(testInvoiceId, new anchor.BN(LAMPORTS_PER_SOL))
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      try {
        await program.methods
          .payInvoice(testInvoiceId, amount)
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoicePDA,
            escrow: escrowPDA,
            clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
            platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
            usdcMint: usdcMint,
            client: client.publicKey,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          })
          .signers([client])
          .rpc();
        expect.fail("Should have thrown error");
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error.message).to.include("AccountNotInitialized");
      }
    });
  });

  describe("Platform Fee Calculation", () => {
    it("should calculate 1% fee correctly on various amounts", async () => {
      const testInvoiceId = "INV-FEE-CALC";
      const testAmount = new anchor.BN(10000000); // 10 USDC
      const expectedFee = testAmount.toNumber() * PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000; // 100000 (0.1 USDC)

      const [invoicePDA] = getInvoicePDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);
      const [escrowPDA] = getEscrowPDA(testInvoiceId, creator.publicKey);

      await program.methods
        .initializeConfig(testInvoiceId, testAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          creator: creator.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          rent: SYSVAR_RENT_PUBKEY,
        })
        .signers([creator])
        .rpc();

      const treasuryBalanceBefore = await getAccount(provider.connection, platformTreasuryTokenAccount);

      await program.methods
        .payInvoice(testInvoiceId, testAmount)
        .accounts({
          invoice: invoicePDA,
          escrow: escrowPDA,
          clientToken: clientTokenAccount,
          platformTreasuryToken: platformTreasuryTokenAccount,
          usdcMint: usdcMint,
          client: client.publicKey,
          tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
        })
        .signers([client])
        .rpc();

      const treasuryBalanceAfter = await getAccount(provider.connection, platformTreasuryTokenAccount);
      const feeReceived = Number(treasuryBalanceAfter.amount) - Number(treasuryBalanceBefore.amount);

      expect(feeReceived).to.equal(expectedFee);
    });
  });

  describe("Edge Cases", () => {
    it("should handle minimum payment amount (1 unit)", async () => {
      const testInvoiceId = "INV-MIN-PAY";

import React, { lazy, Suspense, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Routes, Route } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/toaster';
import { ConnectionProvider } from '@solana/wallet-adapter-react';
import { clusterApiUrl } from '@solana/web3.js';
import NotFound from './pages/NotFound';
import Index from './pages/Index';
import ReferralBootstrap from './components/ReferralBootstrap';
import { NotificationProvider } from './components/NotificationProvider';
import { ActiveWalletProvider } from './contexts/ActiveWalletContext';

const CreateInvoicePage      = lazy(() => import('./pages/CreateInvoicePage'));
const PaymentPage            = lazy(() => import('./pages/PaymentPage'));
const DashboardPage          = lazy(() => import('./pages/DashboardPage'));
const InvalidInvoicePage     = lazy(() => import('./pages/InvalidInvoicePage'));
const ApprovePage            = lazy(() => import('./pages/ApprovePage'));
const ProfilePage            = lazy(() => import('./pages/ProfilePage'));
const AccountPage            = lazy(() => import('./pages/AccountPage'));
const ProfileSettingsPage    = lazy(() => import('./pages/ProfileSettingsPage'));
const WalletPage             = lazy(() => import('./pages/WalletPage'));
const CombinedProfilePage    = lazy(() => import('./pages/CombinedProfilePage'));

const App = () => {
  const endpoint = useMemo(
    () => import.meta.env.VITE_SOLANA_RPC_URL || clusterApiUrl('devnet'),
    [],
  );

  return (
    <ConnectionProvider endpoint={endpoint}>
      <ActiveWalletProvider>
        <NotificationProvider>
          <ReferralBootstrap />
          <Suspense fallback={<div style={{ minHeight: '100vh', background: '#0D1117' }} />}>
            <Routes>
              <Route path="/" element={<Index />} />
              <Route path="/create" element={<CreateInvoicePage />} />
              <Route path="/pay/:invoiceId/:creator" element={<PaymentPage />} />
              <Route path="/invoice/:invoiceId/:creator" element={<PaymentPage />} />
              <Route path="/invoice/:invoiceId" element={<InvalidInvoicePage />} />
              <Route path="/pay/:invoiceId" element={<InvalidInvoicePage />} />
              <Route path="/dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />
              <Route path="/approve/:invoiceId/:creator" element={<ApprovePage />} />
              <Route path="/account" element={<AccountPage />} />
              {/* /profile/account/:slug must come before /profile/:wallet */}
              <Route path="/profile/account/:slug" element={<CombinedProfilePage />} />
              <Route path="/profile/:wallet" element={<ProfilePage />} />
              <Route path="/settings" element={<ProfileSettingsPage />} />
              <Route path="/wallet" element={<WalletPage />} />
              <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
            </Routes>
          </Suspense>
          <Toaster />
        </NotificationProvider>
      </ActiveWalletProvider>
    </ConnectionProvider>
  );
};

export default App;
