              style={{
                fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: '#F8FAFC',

              }}

              Invoices your clients{' '}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useConnection } from '@solana/wallet-adapter-react';
import { usePrivy } from '@privy-io/react-auth';
import { useSignAndSendTransaction } from '@privy-io/react-auth/solana';
import { useActiveWallet } from '@/contexts/ActiveWalletContext';
import { AnchorProvider } from '@coral-xyz/anchor';
import { PublicKey, Connection, Transaction, VersionedTransaction } from '@solana/web3.js';
import {
  Loader2, AlertCircle, Check, ArrowLeft, Shield,
  ExternalLink, Plus, Trash2, Wallet
} from 'lucide-react';
import { EscrowPaySDK, InvoiceData, InvoiceStatus, TokenType, PLATFORM_FEE_BPS, PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD, PLATFORM_FEE_THRESHOLD_USD } from '@/lib/escrowPaySDK';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

type PageState =
  | { type: 'loading' }
  | { type: 'error'; message: string }
  | { type: 'invoice_loaded'; invoice: InvoiceData }
  | { type: 'payment_success'; invoice: InvoiceData; paidAmount: number; txSignature: string };

interface Installment {
  percentage: number;
}

const cardStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  maxWidth: '440px',
  margin: '0 auto',
  backgroundColor: '#161B22',
  border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
  borderRadius: '16px',
  overflow: 'hidden',
};

const InvoicePayment: React.FC = () => {
  const { invoiceId, creator } = useParams<{ invoiceId: string; creator: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { connection } = useConnection();
  const { authenticated, login, getAccessToken } = usePrivy();
  const { activeWallet: privyWallet } = useActiveWallet();
  const publicKey = privyWallet?.address ? new PublicKey(privyWallet.address) : null;
  const connected = authenticated && !!publicKey;
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { signAndSendTransaction } = useSignAndSendTransaction();

  const [pageState, setPageState] = useState<PageState>({ type: 'loading' });
  const [paying, setPaying] = useState(false);
  const [sdkInitError, setSdkInitError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [installments, setInstallments] = useState<Installment[]>([{ percentage: 100 }]);
  const [solPriceUsd, setSolPriceUsd] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [scheduleError, setScheduleError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const urlParams = useMemo(() => {
    if (!invoiceId || !creator) return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid invoice link - missing parameters' };
    try {
      new PublicKey(creator);
      return { valid: true, invoiceId, creator };
    } catch {
      return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid invoice link - invalid creator address' };
    }
  }, [invoiceId, creator]);

  const sdk = useMemo(() => {
    if (!publicKey || !privyWallet) return null;
    try {
      const anchorWallet = {
        publicKey,
        signTransaction: async <T extends Transaction | VersionedTransaction>(tx: T): Promise<T> => {
          const bytes = tx instanceof VersionedTransaction
            ? tx.serialize()
            : tx.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false, verifySignatures: false });
          const { signedTransaction } = await privyWallet.signTransaction({ transaction: bytes });
          return (tx instanceof VersionedTransaction
            ? VersionedTransaction.deserialize(signedTransaction)
            : Transaction.from(Buffer.from(signedTransaction))) as T;
        },
        signAllTransactions: async <T extends Transaction | VersionedTransaction>(txs: T[]): Promise<T[]> => {
          return Promise.all(txs.map(async (tx) => {
            const bytes = tx instanceof VersionedTransaction
              ? tx.serialize()
              : tx.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false, verifySignatures: false });
            const { signedTransaction } = await privyWallet.signTransaction({ transaction: bytes });
            return (tx instanceof VersionedTransaction
              ? VersionedTransaction.deserialize(signedTransaction)
              : Transaction.from(Buffer.from(signedTransaction))) as T;
          }));
        },
      };
      const provider = new AnchorProvider(connection, anchorWallet as any, { commitment: 'confirmed' });
      const sponsorFn = async (tx: Uint8Array): Promise<string> => {
        const result = await signAndSendTransaction({
          transaction: Buffer.from(tx).toString('base64'),
          wallet: privyWallet,
          options: { sponsor: true },
        });
        return result.signature;
      };
      return new EscrowPaySDK(provider, false, sponsorFn);
    } catch { return null; }
  }, [connection, publicKey, privyWallet]);

  const createReadOnlySdk = (conn: Connection): EscrowPaySDK | null => {
    try {
      const mockWallet = {
        publicKey: new PublicKey('11111111111111111111111111111111'),
        signTransaction: async (tx: any) => tx,
        signAllTransactions: async (txs: any[]) => txs,
      };
      const provider = new AnchorProvider(conn, mockWallet as any, { commitment: 'confirmed' });
      const instance = new EscrowPaySDK(provider);
      if (!instance.isInitialized()) { setSdkInitError(instance.getInitError()); return null; }
      return instance;
    } catch (e) {
      setSdkInitError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error');
      return null;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchInvoice = async () => {
      if (!urlParams.valid) { setPageState({ type: 'error', message: urlParams.error || 'Invalid link' }); return; }
      const readOnlySdk = createReadOnlySdk(connection);
      if (!readOnlySdk) { setPageState({ type: 'error', message: sdkInitError || 'Failed to initialize.' }); return; }
      try {
        const creatorPubkey = new PublicKey(urlParams.creator!);
        const [result, price] = await Promise.all([
          readOnlySdk.fetchInvoice(urlParams.invoiceId!, creatorPubkey),
          readOnlySdk.getSolPriceUsd(),
        ]);
        if (price) setSolPriceUsd(price);
        if (result.success && result.data) {
          setPageState({ type: 'invoice_loaded', invoice: result.data });
        } else {
          setPageState({ type: 'error', message: result.error || 'Invoice not found' });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        setPageState({ type: 'error', message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load invoice' });
      }
    };
    fetchInvoice();
  }, [connection, urlParams.valid, urlParams.invoiceId, urlParams.creator]);

  const getDecimals = (t: TokenType) => t === TokenType.USDC ? 6 : 9;

  const fromSmallestUnit = (amount: any, tokenType: TokenType) => {
    const decimals = getDecimals(tokenType);
    try {
      const val = amount?.toNumber ? amount.toNumber() : Number(amount || 0);
      return parseFloat((val / Math.pow(10, decimals)).toFixed(decimals));
    } catch { return 0; }
  };

  const getRemainingAmount = (inv: InvoiceData) => {
    const total = fromSmallestUnit(inv.amount, inv.tokenType);
    const paid = fromSmallestUnit(inv.amountPaid, inv.tokenType);
    return parseFloat(Math.max(0, total - paid).toFixed(getDecimals(inv.tokenType)));
  };

  const formatAmount = (value: number, tokenType: TokenType) => {
    const symbol = tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 'USDC' : 'SOL';
    const decimals = tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 2 : 4;
    return `${parseFloat(value.toFixed(decimals)).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: decimals })} ${symbol}`;
  };

  const calculateBreakdown = (inv: InvoiceData) => {
    const amount = getRemainingAmount(inv);
    const dec = getDecimals(inv.tokenType);
    let fee: number;
    let feeLabel: string;

    if (inv.tokenType === TokenType.USDC) {
      if (amount < PLATFORM_FEE_THRESHOLD_USD) {
        fee = PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD;
        feeLabel = `Platform Fee ($${PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD} flat)`;
      } else {
        fee = parseFloat((amount * (PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000)).toFixed(dec));
        feeLabel = `Platform Fee (${PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 100}%)`;
      }
    } else {
      const valueUsd = solPriceUsd && solPriceUsd > 0 ? amount * solPriceUsd : null;
      if (valueUsd !== null && valueUsd < PLATFORM_FEE_THRESHOLD_USD) {
        fee = parseFloat((PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD / solPriceUsd!).toFixed(dec));
        feeLabel = `Platform Fee ($${PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD} flat)`;
      } else {
        fee = parseFloat((amount * (PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000)).toFixed(dec));
        feeLabel = `Platform Fee (${PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 100}%)`;
      }
    }

    const total = parseFloat((amount + fee).toFixed(dec));
    return { amount, fee, total, feeLabel };
  };

  const totalPercentage = installments.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.percentage || 0), 0);

  const addInstallment = () => {
    if (installments.length >= 10) return;
    setInstallments([...installments, { percentage: 0 }]);
  };

  const removeInstallment = (idx: number) => {
    if (installments.length <= 1) return;
    setInstallments(installments.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  const updateInstallment = (idx: number, value: number) => {
    const updated = [...installments];
    updated[idx] = { percentage: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value)) };
    setInstallments(updated);
  };

  const validateSchedule = (): boolean => {
    if (totalPercentage !== 100) {
      setScheduleError(`Percentages must sum to 100%. Currently: ${totalPercentage}%`);
      return false;
    }
    if (installments.some(i => i.percentage <= 0)) {
      setScheduleError('Each installment must be greater than 0%');
      return false;
    }
    setScheduleError(null);
    return true;
  };

  const handlePay = async () => {
    if (pageState.type !== 'invoice_loaded') return;
    const invoice = pageState.invoice;
    if (!sdk || !connected || !publicKey || !creator) { toast({ title: 'Wallet not connected', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    if (!sdk.isInitialized()) { toast({ title: 'SDK not ready', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    if (!validateSchedule()) return;

    const breakdown = calculateBreakdown(invoice);
    if (breakdown.amount <= 0) { toast({ title: 'Invalid amount', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }

    setPaying(true);
    try {
      const creatorPubkey = new PublicKey(creator);
      const payResult = await sdk.payInvoice(invoice.invoiceId, creatorPubkey, breakdown.amount, invoice.tokenType);
      if (!payResult.success) {
        toast({ title: 'Payment failed', description: typeof payResult.error === 'string' ? payResult.error : 'Payment failed', variant: 'destructive' });
        return;
      }
      const scheduleBps = installments.map(i => Math.round(i.percentage * 100));
      const scheduleResult = await sdk.setReleaseSchedule(invoice.invoiceId, creatorPubkey, scheduleBps);
      if (!scheduleResult.success) {
        toast({ title: 'Schedule not set', description: 'Payment succeeded but release schedule failed. Creator can release freely.', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
      const updated = await sdk.fetchInvoice(invoice.invoiceId, creatorPubkey);
      setPageState({
        type: 'payment_success',
        invoice: updated.success && updated.data ? updated.data : invoice,
        paidAmount: breakdown.amount,
        txSignature: payResult.data?.signature || '',
      });
      const token = await getAccessToken();
      fetch('/api/notify-creator', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          invoiceId: invoice.invoiceId,
          creatorWallet: creator,
          clientWallet: publicKey.toBase58() ?? '',
          event: 'paid',
          amount: formatAmount(breakdown.amount, invoice.tokenType),
        }),
      }).catch(() => {});
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      let msg = 'Transaction failed.';
      const errorStr = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error || '');
      if (errorStr.includes('User rejected') || errorStr.includes('rejected the request')) msg = 'Transaction cancelled.';
      else if (errorStr.toLowerCase().includes('insufficient')) msg = 'Insufficient balance.';
      toast({ title: 'Payment failed', description: msg, variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setPaying(false);
    }
  };

  // ── LOADING ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (pageState.type === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div style={cardStyle}>
        <div className="p-12 flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
          <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin" style={{ color: '#2DD4BF' }} />
          <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px' }}>Loading invoice...</p>
          {sdkInitError && <p style={{ color: '#EF4444', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px' }}>{sdkInitError}</p>}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── ERROR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (pageState.type === 'error') {
    return (
      <div style={cardStyle}>
        <div className="p-10 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
          <AlertCircle className="h-10 w-10" style={{ color: '#EF4444' }} />
          <div>
            <h3 style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '1.125rem', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              Invoice Not Found
            </h3>
            <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
              {pageState.message}
            </p>
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace', fontSize: '11px', color: '#64748B', marginBottom: '24px' }}>
              ID: {invoiceId || 'N/A'}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />Go Home
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── SUCCESS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (pageState.type === 'payment_success') {
    const { invoice, paidAmount, txSignature } = pageState;
    return (
      <div style={cardStyle}>
        <div className="p-10 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
          <div
            className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' }}
          >
            <Check className="h-8 w-8" style={{ color: '#22C55E' }} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <h2 style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '1.5rem', color: '#F8FAFC', letterSpacing: '-0.01em', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              Funds Secured
            </h2>
            <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', marginBottom: '24px' }}>
              <span style={{ color: '#F8FAFC', fontWeight: 500 }}>{formatAmount(paidAmount, invoice.tokenType)}</span> deposited into escrow.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="w-full rounded-lg p-4 text-left space-y-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}>
            {[
              { label: 'Amount paid', value: formatAmount(paidAmount, invoice.tokenType) },
              { label: 'Installments', value: String(installments.length) },
              { label: 'Status', value: 'In escrow', highlight: true },
            ].map(({ label, value, highlight }) => (
              <div key={label} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>{label}</span>
                <span style={{ color: highlight ? '#4ADE80' : '#F8FAFC', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontWeight: highlight ? 500 : 400 }}>{value}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {installments.length > 1 && (
            <div className="w-full rounded-lg p-4 text-left" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}>
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 500, color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '8px' }}>Release schedule</p>
              {installments.map((inst, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex justify-between py-0.5">
                  <span style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px' }}>Installment {i + 1}</span>
                  <span style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px' }}>
                    {inst.percentage}% — {formatAmount(paidAmount * inst.percentage / 100, invoice.tokenType)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <div
            className="w-full rounded-lg p-4 flex items-start gap-3 text-left"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.06)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.15)' }}
          >
            <Shield className="h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#38BDF8' }} />
            <p style={{ color: '#7DD3FC', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
              Funds are secured on-chain. The creator can only release according to the schedule you set.
            </p>
          </div>

          {txSignature && (
            <a
              href={`https://explorer.solana.com/tx/${txSignature}?cluster=devnet`}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-70"
              style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', textDecoration: 'none' }}
            >
              View on Solana Explorer <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
            </a>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            className="w-full rounded-lg py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-90"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF',
              color: '#0D1117',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              border: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            Back to Home
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── INVOICE LOADED ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const invoice = pageState.invoice;
  const totalAmount = fromSmallestUnit(invoice.amount, invoice.tokenType);
  const paidAmount = fromSmallestUnit(invoice.amountPaid, invoice.tokenType);
  const remaining = getRemainingAmount(invoice);
  const progressPercent = totalAmount > 0 ? (paidAmount / totalAmount) * 100 : 0;
  const breakdown = calculateBreakdown(invoice);
  const isPaid = invoice.status === InvoiceStatus.FullyPaid || invoice.status === InvoiceStatus.Released;
  const isPartiallyPaid = invoice.status === InvoiceStatus.PartiallyPaid;
  const symbol = invoice.tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 'USDC' : 'SOL';

  const statusBadge = {
    [InvoiceStatus.Unpaid]: { label: 'Pending', bg: 'rgba(249,115,22,0.1)', color: '#FB923C' },
    [InvoiceStatus.PartiallyPaid]: { label: 'Partial', bg: 'rgba(59,130,246,0.1)', color: '#93C5FD' },
    [InvoiceStatus.FullyPaid]: { label: 'In Escrow', bg: 'rgba(59,130,246,0.1)', color: '#93C5FD' },
    [InvoiceStatus.Released]: { label: 'Released', bg: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)', color: '#4ADE80' },
    [InvoiceStatus.Disputed]: { label: 'Disputed', bg: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.1)', color: '#FCD34D' },
  }[invoice.status] ?? { label: 'Unknown', bg: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', color: '#94A3B8' };

  return (
    <div style={cardStyle}>
      {/* Invoice header */}
      <div className="p-7 border-b" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace',
              fontSize: '12px',
              color: '#94A3B8',
            }}
          >
            {invoice.invoiceId}
          </span>
          <span
            className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium"
            style={{ backgroundColor: statusBadge.bg, color: statusBadge.color, fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}
          >
            {statusBadge.label}
          </span>
        </div>

        <p
          style={{
            fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
            fontWeight: 700,
            fontSize: '3rem',
            color: '#F8FAFC',
            letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
            lineHeight: 1,
            marginBottom: '8px',
          }}
        >
          {parseFloat(totalAmount.toFixed(invoice.tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 2 : 4)).toLocaleString('en-US', {
            maximumFractionDigits: invoice.tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 2 : 4,
          })}
          <span style={{ fontSize: '1.125rem', color: '#64748B', marginLeft: '8px', fontWeight: 500 }}>{symbol}</span>
        </p>

        {(isPartiallyPaid || isPaid) && (
          <div className="mt-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1.5" style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>
              <span>Paid: {formatAmount(paidAmount, invoice.tokenType)}</span>
              <span>{progressPercent.toFixed(0)}%</span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
              <div
                className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                style={{
                  width: `${progressPercent}%`,
                  backgroundColor: invoice.status === InvoiceStatus.Released ? '#22C55E' : '#3B82F6',
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4">
          <span
            className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: invoice.tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,0.1)',
              color: invoice.tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? '#4ADE80' : '#7DD3FC',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
            }}
          >
            {invoice.tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 'USDC' : 'SOL'}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Body */}
      <div className="p-6 space-y-4">
        {/* Creator */}
        <div>
          <div className="rounded-lg p-3.5" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}>
            <p style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.07em', marginBottom: '4px' }}>From</p>
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace', fontSize: '12px', color: '#F8FAFC' }}>
              {creator ? `${creator.slice(0, 6)}...${creator.slice(-6)}` : 'Unknown'}
            </p>

        </div>

        {/* Pay section — only if not yet fully paid */}
        {!isPaid && remaining > 0 && (
          <>
            <div
              className="rounded-lg p-3.5 flex items-start gap-3"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.06)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.15)' }}
            >
              <Shield className="h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#38BDF8' }} />
              <p style={{ color: '#7DD3FC', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                Your payment is held securely in a smart contract. You decide how funds are released to the creator.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Release schedule builder */}
            <div
              className="rounded-lg p-4"
              style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', backgroundColor: 'transparent' }}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <div>
                  <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 500, color: '#F8FAFC' }}>Release schedule</p>
                  <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', color: '#64748B', marginTop: '2px' }}>How should funds be released to the creator?</p>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={addInstallment}
                  disabled={installments.length >= 10}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-40"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
                    color: '#94A3B8',
                    fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                    cursor: installments.length >= 10 ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />Add
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 mb-3">
                {installments.map((inst, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', color: '#64748B', width: '80px', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                      Installment {idx + 1}
                    </span>
                    <div className="relative flex-1">
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        value={inst.percentage || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => updateInstallment(idx, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                        placeholder="0"
                        min="1"
                        max="100"
                        style={{
                          width: '100%',
                          backgroundColor: '#1C2128',
                          border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
                          borderRadius: '6px',
                          color: '#F8FAFC',
                          fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                          fontSize: '13px',
                          padding: '6px 28px 6px 10px',
                          height: '34px',
                          outline: 'none',
                        }}
                      />
                      <span style={{ position: 'absolute', right: '8px', top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', color: '#64748B', fontSize: '12px' }}>%</span>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', color: '#64748B', width: '88px', textAlign: 'right', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                      {inst.percentage > 0 ? formatAmount(breakdown.amount * inst.percentage / 100, invoice.tokenType) : '—'}
                    </span>
                    {installments.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeInstallment(idx)}
                        className="flex-shrink-0 transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-60"
                        style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#64748B', padding: '4px' }}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div
                className="flex justify-between text-xs font-medium pt-2 border-t"
                style={{
                  borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
                  color: totalPercentage === 100 ? '#4ADE80' : '#EF4444',
                  fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                }}
              >
                <span>Total</span>
                <span>{totalPercentage}% {totalPercentage === 100 ? '✓' : `(need ${100 - totalPercentage > 0 ? '+' : ''}${100 - totalPercentage}%)`}</span>
              </div>
              {scheduleError && (
                <p style={{ color: '#EF4444', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', marginTop: '8px' }}>{scheduleError}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Payment breakdown */}
            <div>
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 500, color: '#94A3B8', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.07em', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                Payment Amount
              </p>
              <div className="rounded-lg p-4 space-y-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}>
                {[
                  { label: 'Amount', value: formatAmount(breakdown.amount, invoice.tokenType) },
                  { label: breakdown.feeLabel, value: formatAmount(breakdown.fee, invoice.tokenType) },
                ].map(({ label, value }) => (
                  <div key={label} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <span style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>{label}</span>
                    <span style={{ color: '#F8FAFC', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>{value}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm font-medium pt-2 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
                  <span style={{ color: '#F8FAFC', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>Total</span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, color: '#F8FAFC' }}>{formatAmount(breakdown.total, invoice.tokenType)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Pay button / wallet connect */}
            <div className="pt-1">
              {!connected ? (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div
                    className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg p-3.5"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}
                  >
                    <Wallet className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: '#64748B' }} />
                    <span style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px' }}>
                      Connect to continue
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => login()}
                    style={{
                      width: '100%',
                      padding: '12px',
                      backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF',
                      color: '#0D1117',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '8px',
                      fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                      fontSize: '14px',
                      fontWeight: 500,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    Connect Wallet
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <button
                  onClick={handlePay}
                  disabled={paying || breakdown.amount <= 0 || totalPercentage !== 100}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg py-3.5 text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF',
                    color: '#0D1117',
                    fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: paying ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {paying
                    ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />Processing...</>
                    : `Lock Funds — ${formatAmount(breakdown.total, invoice.tokenType)}`}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Already paid state */}
        {isPaid && (
          <div className="py-6 text-center">
            <div
              className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' }}
            >
              <Check className="h-6 w-6" style={{ color: '#22C55E' }} />
            </div>
            <h3 style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '1.125rem', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
              {invoice.status === InvoiceStatus.Released ? 'Payment Complete' : 'Funds Secured'}
            </h3>
            <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
              {invoice.status === InvoiceStatus.Released
                ? 'Funds have been released to the creator.'
                : 'This invoice has been fully paid. Awaiting release.'}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { X, Bell, CheckCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

interface Notification {
  id: string;
  type: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
  title: string;
  message?: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  read: boolean;
}

interface NotificationContextType {
  notifications: Notification[];
  unreadCount: number;
  addNotification: (notification: Omit<Notification, 'id' | 'timestamp' | 'read'>) => void;
  removeNotification: (id: string) => void;
  markAsRead: (id: string) => void;
  markAllAsRead: () => void;
  clearAll: () => void;
}

const NotificationContext = createContext<NotificationContextType | null>(null);

export const useNotifications = () => {
  const context = useContext(NotificationContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useNotifications must be used within NotificationProvider');
  return context;
};

interface NotificationProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export const NotificationProvider: React.FC<NotificationProviderProps> = ({ children }) => {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);

  const addNotification = useCallback((notification: Omit<Notification, 'id' | 'timestamp' | 'read'>) => {
    const newNotification: Notification = {
      ...notification,
      id: Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
      timestamp: new Date(),
      read: false,
    };
    // Keep last 100 notifications
    setNotifications(prev => [newNotification, ...prev].slice(0, 100));
  }, []);

  const removeNotification = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.filter(n => n.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const markAsRead = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n));
  }, []);

  const markAllAsRead = useCallback(() => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, read: true })));
  }, []);

  const clearAll = useCallback(() => {
    setNotifications([]);
  }, []);

  const unreadCount = notifications.filter(n => !n.read).length;

  return (
    <NotificationContext.Provider value={{
      notifications,
      unreadCount,
      addNotification,
      removeNotification,
      markAsRead,
      markAllAsRead,
      clearAll,
    }}>
      {children}
    </NotificationContext.Provider>
  );
};

// ==================== NOTIFICATION LIST (popover) ====================

interface NotificationListProps {
  onViewAll?: () => void;
}

export const NotificationList: React.FC<NotificationListProps> = ({ onViewAll }) => {
  const { notifications, removeNotification, markAsRead, markAllAsRead, clearAll, unreadCount } = useNotifications();

  const getTypeStyles = (type: Notification['type'], read: boolean) => {
    const opacity = read ? 'opacity-60' : '';
    switch (type) {
      case 'success': return `bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 ${opacity}`;
      case 'warning': return `bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 ${opacity}`;
      case 'error': return `bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 ${opacity}`;
      default: return `bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 ${opacity}`;
    }
  };

  const getTypeDot = (type: Notification['type']) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success': return 'bg-green-500';
      case 'warning': return 'bg-amber-500';
      case 'error': return 'bg-red-500';
      default: return 'bg-blue-500';
    }
  };

  const formatTime = (date: Date) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const diff = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
    const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
    if (mins < 1) return 'just now';
    if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
    return `${days}d ago`;
  };

  // Show only last 5 in popover, rest via "View all"
  const recent = notifications.slice(0, 5);

  return (
    <div className="w-80">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-border">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Bell className="h-4 w-4 text-foreground" />
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">Notifications</span>
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <span className="text-xs bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium">
              {unreadCount}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={markAllAsRead}
              className="text-xs text-primary hover:text-primary/80 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <CheckCheck className="h-3 w-3" />
              Mark all read
            </button>
          )}
          {notifications.length > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={clearAll}
              className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
            >
              Clear all
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Notification list */}
      {notifications.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-8 text-center">
          <Bell className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/40 mx-auto mb-2" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No notifications yet</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="divide-y divide-border max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
            {recent.map(notification => (
              <div
                key={notification.id}
                className={`p-3 flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:brightness-95 ${getTypeStyles(notification.type, notification.read)}`}
                onClick={() => markAsRead(notification.id)}
              >
                {/* Unread dot */}
                <div className="mt-1.5 flex-shrink-0">
                  {!notification.read ? (
                    <span className={`block w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${getTypeDot(notification.type)}`} />
                  ) : (
                    <span className="block w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-transparent" />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className={`text-sm font-medium ${notification.read ? 'text-muted-foreground' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                    {notification.title}
                  </p>
                  {notification.message && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 line-clamp-2">{notification.message}</p>
                  )}
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">{formatTime(notification.timestamp)}</p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); removeNotification(notification.id); }}
                  className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex-shrink-0"
                >
                  <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* View all button */}
          {notifications.length > 5 && onViewAll && (
            <div className="border-t border-border p-2">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full text-xs" onClick={onViewAll}>
                View all {notifications.length} notifications
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
          {notifications.length <= 5 && notifications.length > 0 && (
            <div className="border-t border-border px-4 py-2">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Click a notification to mark as read</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// ==================== FULL HISTORY PANEL ====================

export const NotificationHistory: React.FC<{ onClose: () => void }> = ({ onClose }) => {
  const { notifications, removeNotification, markAsRead, markAllAsRead, clearAll, unreadCount } = useNotifications();

  const getTypeDot = (type: Notification['type']) => {
    switch (type) { case 'success': return 'bg-green-500'; case 'warning': return 'bg-amber-500'; case 'error': return 'bg-red-500'; default: return 'bg-blue-500'; }
  };

  const getTypeBadge = (type: Notification['type']) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400';
      case 'warning': return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400';
      case 'error': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400';
      default: return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-400';
    }
  };

  const formatFullTime = (date: Date) => {
    return date.toLocaleString('en-US', {
      month: 'short', day: 'numeric',
      hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-start justify-end p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-background border border-border rounded-xl shadow-xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b border-border flex-shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Bell className="h-5 w-5 text-foreground" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">All Notifications</h2>
            {unreadCount > 0 && (
              <span className="text-xs bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-medium">
                {unreadCount} unread
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Actions */}
        {notifications.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-2 border-b border-border flex-shrink-0">
            {unreadCount > 0 && (
              <button onClick={markAllAsRead} className="text-xs text-primary hover:text-primary/80 flex items-center gap-1">
                <CheckCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Mark all as read
              </button>
            )}
            <button onClick={clearAll} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive ml-auto">
              Clear all
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* List */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1">
          {notifications.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center">
              <Bell className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground/40 mx-auto mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No notifications yet</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-border">
              {notifications.map(notification => (
                <div
                  key={notification.id}
                  className={`px-5 py-4 flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors ${!notification.read ? 'bg-muted/20' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => markAsRead(notification.id)}
                >
                  <div className="mt-1.5 flex-shrink-0">
                    {!notification.read ? (
                      <span className={`block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${getTypeDot(notification.type)}`} />
                    ) : (
                      <span className="block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/20" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-0.5">
                      <p className={`text-sm font-medium ${notification.read ? 'text-muted-foreground' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                        {notification.title}
                      </p>
                      <span className={`text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${getTypeBadge(notification.type)}`}>
                        {notification.type}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {notification.message && (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{notification.message}</p>
                    )}
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1.5">{formatFullTime(notification.timestamp)}</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); removeNotification(notification.id); }}
                    className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                  >
                    <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default NotificationProvider;

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { usePrivy } from '@privy-io/react-auth';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'escrowpay_pending_referral_code';

function normalizeReferralCode(value: string): string {
  return value.trim().toUpperCase();
}

function isReferralCodeCandidate(value: string): boolean {
  return /^[A-Z0-9]{4,32}$/.test(value);
}

// Safely read from localStorage without throwing.
function readPendingCode(): string | null {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// Safely remove from localStorage without throwing.
function clearPendingCode(): void {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  } catch {
    // non-blocking
  }
}

const ReferralBootstrap: React.FC = () => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { ready, authenticated, getAccessToken } = usePrivy();
  const appliedCodeRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const bootstrapCompleteRef = useRef(false);

  // Capture ?ref= into localStorage whenever the query param is present.
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const referral = params.get('ref');
    if (!referral) return;

    const normalized = normalizeReferralCode(referral);
    if (!isReferralCodeCandidate(normalized)) return;

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);
    } catch {
      // non-blocking
    }
  }, [location.search]);

  // FIX: When the user logs out, clear any pending referral code from localStorage
  // so it cannot be inherited by the next session on a shared device.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return;
    if (!authenticated) {
      bootstrapCompleteRef.current = false;
      appliedCodeRef.current = null;
      clearPendingCode();
    }
  }, [ready, authenticated]);

  // On login, apply the pending code — but only after verifying the server
  // has not already set referred_by_code for this account.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || !authenticated) return;

    let cancelled = false;

    const bootstrap = async () => {
      if (bootstrapCompleteRef.current) return;
      bootstrapCompleteRef.current = true;

      try {
        const token = await getAccessToken();
        if (!token || cancelled) return;

        // Fetch profile to ensure the user row exists AND to check the
        // server-side referred_by_code state before doing anything.
        const profileRes = await fetch('/api/profile', {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });

        if (!profileRes.ok || cancelled) return;

        const profile = await profileRes.json() as {
          referred_by_code?: string | null;
        };

        // FIX: If the server already has a referral code recorded, discard the
        // pending localStorage value — nothing to do.
        if (profile.referred_by_code) {
          clearPendingCode();
          return;
        }

        const pendingCode = readPendingCode();
        if (!pendingCode || pendingCode === appliedCodeRef.current || cancelled) return;

        const response = await fetch('/api/referrals', {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ referred_by_code: pendingCode }),
        });

        if (response.ok) {
          appliedCodeRef.current = pendingCode;
          clearPendingCode();
          return;
        }

        // 400 / 404 / 409 all mean we should not retry — discard.
        const status = response.status;
        if ([400, 404, 409].includes(status)) {
          appliedCodeRef.current = pendingCode;
          clearPendingCode();
        }
      } catch {
        bootstrapCompleteRef.current = false;
      }
    };

    void bootstrap();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [authenticated, getAccessToken, ready]);

  return null;
};

export default ReferralBootstrap;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { usePrivy } from '@privy-io/react-auth';
import { useCreateWallet, useImportWallet } from '@privy-io/react-auth/solana';

async function registerWallet(address: string, getAccessToken: () => Promise<string | null>) {
  try {
    const token = await getAccessToken();
    await fetch('/api/register-wallet', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
      body: JSON.stringify({ wallet_address: address }),
    });
  } catch { /* non-blocking */ }
}
import { Keypair } from '@solana/web3.js';
import * as bip39 from 'bip39';
import { derivePath } from 'ed25519-hd-key';
import bs58 from 'bs58';
import { Loader2, Wallet, Download, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

type Step = 'choice' | 'import';
type ImportTab = 'privateKey' | 'seedPhrase';

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
  fontSize: '12px',
  fontWeight: 500,
  color: '#94A3B8',
  textTransform: 'uppercase',
  letterSpacing: '0.06em',
  marginBottom: '6px',
};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%',
  backgroundColor: '#1C2128',
  border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
  borderRadius: '8px',
  color: '#F8FAFC',
  fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace',
  fontSize: '13px',
  padding: '10px 14px',
  outline: 'none',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
};

const WalletOnboarding: React.FC = () => {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { getAccessToken } = usePrivy();
  const { createWallet } = useCreateWallet();
  const { importWallet } = useImportWallet();

  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>('choice');
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<ImportTab>('privateKey');
  const [privateKey, setPrivateKey] = useState('');
  const [seedPhrase, setSeedPhrase] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const newWallet = await createWallet();
      if (newWallet?.address) registerWallet(newWallet.address, getAccessToken);
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to create wallet';
      toast({ title: 'Failed to create wallet', description: msg, variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleImport = async () => {
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      let key = '';
      if (tab === 'privateKey') {
        key = privateKey.trim();
        if (!key) { setError('Enter your private key.'); setLoading(false); return; }
      } else {
        const words = seedPhrase.trim().split(/\s+/);
        if (words.length !== 12 && words.length !== 24) {
          setError('Enter a valid 12 or 24-word seed phrase.');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        if (!bip39.validateMnemonic(seedPhrase.trim())) {
          setError('Invalid seed phrase — check your words.');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        const seed = bip39.mnemonicToSeedSync(seedPhrase.trim());
        const { key: derivedKey } = derivePath("m/44'/501'/0'/0'", seed.toString('hex'));
        const keypair = Keypair.fromSeed(derivedKey);
        key = bs58.encode(keypair.secretKey);
      }
      const imported = await importWallet({ privateKey: key });
      if (imported?.address) registerWallet(imported.address, getAccessToken);
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Import failed';
      setError(msg.includes('already') ? 'A wallet is already linked to this key.' : msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)',
        zIndex: 9999,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: '16px',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          backgroundColor: '#161B22',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
          borderRadius: '16px',
          padding: '32px',
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: '420px',
        }}
      >
        {step === 'choice' ? (
          <>
            <h2
              style={{
                fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '1.375rem',
                color: '#F8FAFC',
                letterSpacing: '-0.01em',
                marginBottom: '8px',
              }}
            >
              Set up your wallet
            </h2>
            <p style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', marginBottom: '24px' }}>
              How would you like to get started?
            </p>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' }}>
              <button
                onClick={handleGenerate}
                disabled={loading}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'flex-start',
                  gap: '14px',
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,212,191,0.06)',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.2)',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  padding: '16px',
                  cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  textAlign: 'left',
                  opacity: loading ? 0.6 : 1,
                  transition: 'border-color 150ms ease',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ width: '36px', height: '36px', borderRadius: '8px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,212,191,0.1)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                  {loading ? <Loader2 size={18} style={{ color: '#2DD4BF', animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} /> : <Wallet size={18} style={{ color: '#2DD4BF' }} />}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '14px', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                    Generate a new wallet
                  </p>
                  <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', color: '#64748B' }}>
                    A secure wallet is created for you — no setup needed
                  </p>
                </div>
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setStep('import')}
                disabled={loading}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'flex-start',
                  gap: '14px',
                  backgroundColor: '#1C2128',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  padding: '16px',
                  cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  textAlign: 'left',
                  opacity: loading ? 0.6 : 1,
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ width: '36px', height: '36px', borderRadius: '8px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                  <Download size={18} style={{ color: '#94A3B8' }} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '14px', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                    Import existing wallet
                  </p>
                  <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', color: '#64748B' }}>
                    Use your own wallet via private key or seed phrase
                  </p>
                </div>
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setStep('choice'); setError(''); }}
              style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px', background: 'none', border: 'none', color: '#64748B', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', padding: '0', marginBottom: '20px' }}
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={14} /> Back
            </button>

            <h2 style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '1.25rem', color: '#F8FAFC', letterSpacing: '-0.01em', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
              Import wallet
            </h2>

            {/* Tabs */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '4px', backgroundColor: '#1C2128', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '3px', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
              {(['privateKey', 'seedPhrase'] as const).map(t => (
                <button
                  key={t}
                  onClick={() => { setTab(t); setError(''); }}
                  style={{
                    flex: 1,
                    padding: '7px 0',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                    fontSize: '13px',
                    fontWeight: 500,
                    backgroundColor: tab === t ? '#161B22' : 'transparent',
                    color: tab === t ? '#F8FAFC' : '#64748B',
                    transition: 'all 150ms ease',
                  }}
                >
                  {t === 'privateKey' ? 'Private Key' : 'Seed Phrase'}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {tab === 'privateKey' ? (
              <div style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Private Key (base58)</label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={privateKey}
                  onChange={e => { setPrivateKey(e.target.value); setError(''); }}
                  placeholder="Paste your base58-encoded private key"
                  style={inputStyle}
                />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Seed Phrase</label>
                <textarea
                  value={seedPhrase}
                  onChange={e => { setSeedPhrase(e.target.value); setError(''); }}
                  placeholder="Enter your 12 or 24-word seed phrase..."
                  rows={3}
                  style={{ ...inputStyle, resize: 'none', height: 'auto', lineHeight: 1.6 }}
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {error && (
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', color: '#F87171', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={handleImport}
              disabled={loading}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF',
                color: '#0D1117',

              }}
            >
              {loading && <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" />}
              {loading ? 'Importing…' : 'Import Wallet'}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default WalletOnboarding;

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import useEmblaCarousel, {
  type UseEmblaCarouselType,
} from "embla-carousel-react"
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

type CarouselApi = UseEmblaCarouselType[1]
type UseCarouselParameters = Parameters<typeof useEmblaCarousel>
type CarouselOptions = UseCarouselParameters[0]
type CarouselPlugin = UseCarouselParameters[1]

type CarouselProps = {
  opts?: CarouselOptions
  plugins?: CarouselPlugin
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical"
  setApi?: (api: CarouselApi) => void
}

type CarouselContextProps = {
  carouselRef: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[0]
  api: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[1]
  scrollPrev: () => void
  scrollNext: () => void
  canScrollPrev: boolean
  canScrollNext: boolean
} & CarouselProps

const CarouselContext = React.createContext<CarouselContextProps | null>(null)

function useCarousel() {
  const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />")
  }

  return context
}

const Carousel = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & CarouselProps
>(
  (
    {
      orientation = "horizontal",
      opts,
      setApi,
      plugins,
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
      {
        ...opts,
        axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
      },
      plugins
    )
    const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false)
    const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false)

    const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {
      if (!api) {
        return
      }

      setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev())
      setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext())
    }, [])

    const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
      api?.scrollPrev()
    }, [api])

    const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
      api?.scrollNext()
    }, [api])

    const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
      (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
          event.preventDefault()
          scrollPrev()
        } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
          event.preventDefault()
          scrollNext()
        }
      },
      [scrollPrev, scrollNext]
    )

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!api || !setApi) {
        return
      }

      setApi(api)
    }, [api, setApi])

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!api) {
        return
      }

      onSelect(api)
      api.on("reInit", onSelect)
      api.on("select", onSelect)

      return () => {
        api?.off("select", onSelect)
      }
    }, [api, onSelect])

    return (
      <CarouselContext.Provider
        value={{
          carouselRef,
          api: api,
          opts,
          orientation:
            orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
          scrollPrev,
          scrollNext,
          canScrollPrev,
          canScrollNext,
        }}
      >
        <div
          ref={ref}
          onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
          className={cn("relative", className)}
          role="region"
          aria-roledescription="carousel"
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </CarouselContext.Provider>
    )
  }
)
Carousel.displayName = "Carousel"

const CarouselContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { carouselRef, orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div ref={carouselRef} className="overflow-hidden">
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex",
          orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  )
})
CarouselContent.displayName = "CarouselContent"

      )}

  )

CarouselItem.displayName = "CarouselItem"

  HTMLButtonElement,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import * as RechartsPrimitive from "recharts"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = { light: "", dark: ".dark" } as const

export type ChartConfig = {
  [k in string]: {
    label?: React.ReactNode
    icon?: React.ComponentType
  } & (
    | { color?: string; theme?: never }
    | { color?: never; theme: Record<keyof typeof THEMES, string> }
  )
}

type ChartContextProps = {
  config: ChartConfig
}

const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null)

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />")
  }

  return context
}

const ChartContainer = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    config: ChartConfig
    children: React.ComponentProps<
      typeof RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
    >["children"]
  }
>(({ id, className, children, config, ...props }, ref) => {
  const uniqueId = React.useId()
  const chartId = `chart-${id || uniqueId.replace(/:/g, "")}`

  return (
    <ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-chart={chartId}
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-none [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-none [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-none",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
          {children}
        </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>
  )
})
ChartContainer.displayName = "Chart"

const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(
    ([_, config]) => config.theme || config.color
  )

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <style
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(
            ([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
  .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
    const color =
      itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] ||
      itemConfig.color
    return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null
  })
  .join("\n")}
}
`
          )
          .join("\n"),
      }}
    />
  )
}

const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip

const ChartTooltipContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &
    React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
      hideLabel?: boolean
      hideIndicator?: boolean
      indicator?: "line" | "dot" | "dashed"
      nameKey?: string
      labelKey?: string
    }
>(
  (
    {
      active,
      payload,
      className,
      indicator = "dot",
      hideLabel = false,
      hideIndicator = false,
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      labelClassName,
      formatter,
      color,
      nameKey,
      labelKey,
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart()

    const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
      if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
        return null
      }

      const [item] = payload
      const key = `${labelKey || item.dataKey || item.name || "value"}`
      const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
      const value =
        !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
          ? config[label as keyof typeof config]?.label || label
          : itemConfig?.label

      if (labelFormatter) {
        return (
          <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
            {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
          </div>
        )
      }

      if (!value) {
        return null
      }

      return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>
    }, [
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      payload,
      hideLabel,
      labelClassName,
      config,
      labelKey,
    ])

    if (!active || !payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot"

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "grid min-w-[8rem] items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
          className
        )}
      >
        {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          {payload.map((item, index) => {
            const key = `${nameKey || item.name || item.dataKey || "value"}`
            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
            const indicatorColor = color || item.payload.fill || item.color

            return (
              <div
                key={item.dataKey}
                className={cn(
                  "flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
                  indicator === "dot" && "items-center"
                )}
              >
                {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
                  formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {itemConfig?.icon ? (
                      <itemConfig.icon />
                    ) : (
                      !hideIndicator && (
                        <div
                          className={cn(
                            "shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-[--color-border] bg-[--color-bg]",
                            {
                              "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
                              "w-1": indicator === "line",
                              "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
                                indicator === "dashed",
                              "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
                            }
                          )}
                          style={
                            {
                              "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
                              "--color-border": indicatorColor,
                            } as React.CSSProperties
                          }
                        />
                      )
                    )}
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
                        nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center"
                      )}
                    >
                      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                        {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {itemConfig?.label || item.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {item.value && (
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums text-foreground">
                          {item.value.toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
)
ChartTooltipContent.displayName = "ChartTooltip"

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend

const ChartLegendContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> &
    Pick<RechartsPrimitive.LegendProps, "payload" | "verticalAlign"> & {
      hideIcon?: boolean
      nameKey?: string
    }
>(
  (
    { className, hideIcon = false, payload, verticalAlign = "bottom", nameKey },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart()

    if (!payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
          verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
          className
        )}
      >
        {payload.map((item) => {
          const key = `${nameKey || item.dataKey || "value"}`
          const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)

          return (
            <div
              key={item.value}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground"
              )}
            >
              {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
                <itemConfig.icon />
              ) : (
                <div
                  className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: item.color,
                  }}
                />
              )}
              {itemConfig?.label}
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    )
  }
)
ChartLegendContent.displayName = "ChartLegend"

// Helper to extract item config from a payload.
function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  config: ChartConfig,
  payload: unknown,
  key: string
) {
  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
    return undefined
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    "payload" in payload &&
    typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
    payload.payload !== null
      ? payload.payload
      : undefined

  let configLabelKey: string = key

  if (
    key in payload &&
    typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
      key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
    ] as string
  }

  return configLabelKey in config
    ? config[configLabelKey]
    : config[key as keyof typeof config]
}

export {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartStyle,
}
