import React from 'react';
import Header from '@/components/Header';
import Footer from '@/components/Footer';
import InvoicePayment from '@/components/InvoicePayment';
import { AlertCircle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';

// Error Boundary — preserved exactly from original
interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
}

class PaymentErrorBoundary extends React.Component<
  { children: React.ReactNode },
  ErrorBoundaryState
> {
  constructor(props: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('[PaymentPage] Error caught by boundary:', error);
    console.error('[PaymentPage] Error info:', errorInfo);
  }

  handleRetry = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
    window.location.reload();
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div
          className="max-w-md mx-auto rounded-xl p-10 text-center"
          style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' }}
        >
          <AlertCircle className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-4" style={{ color: '#EF4444' }} />
          <h3
            style={{
              fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: '1.125rem',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              marginBottom: '8px',
            }}
          >
            Something went wrong
          </h3>
          <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
            We encountered an error loading this page.
          </p>
          {this.state.error && (
            <p
              className="text-xs rounded-lg p-3 mb-6"
              style={{
                fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace',
                color: '#64748B',
                backgroundColor: '#1C2128',
              }}
            >
              {this.state.error.message}
            </p>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={this.handleRetry}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 mx-auto px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            Try Again
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

const PaymentPage: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col" style={{ backgroundColor: '#0D1117' }}>
      <Header />
      <main className="flex-1 w-full px-4 sm:px-6 py-12">
        <PaymentErrorBoundary>
          <InvoicePayment />
        </PaymentErrorBoundary>
      </main>
      <Footer />
    </div>
  );
};

export default PaymentPage;

﻿import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useConnection } from '@solana/wallet-adapter-react';
import { AnchorProvider, type Wallet } from '@coral-xyz/anchor';
import { PublicKey, Connection } from '@solana/web3.js';
import { ExternalLink, AlertCircle, Loader2, Shield, Zap, TrendingUp, Calendar, Info, Copy, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { EscrowPaySDK, InvoiceData, InvoiceStatus } from '@/lib/escrowPaySDK';
import Header from '@/components/Header';
import Footer from '@/components/Footer';
import TruvloLogo from '@/components/TruvloLogo';

// â”€â”€ helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

function getMemberSince(invoices: InvoiceData[]): string {
  if (!invoices.length) return 'â€”';
  const timestamps = invoices
    .map(i => { try { return i.createdAt.toNumber ? i.createdAt.toNumber() : Number(i.createdAt); } catch { return 0; } })
    .filter(t => t > 0);
  if (!timestamps.length) return 'â€”';
  return new Date(Math.min(...timestamps) * 1000).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
}

function getLongestCleanStreak(invoices: InvoiceData[]): number {
  const sorted = [...invoices].sort((a, b) => {
    const at = a.createdAt.toNumber ? a.createdAt.toNumber() : Number(a.createdAt);
    const bt = b.createdAt.toNumber ? b.createdAt.toNumber() : Number(b.createdAt);
    return at - bt;
  });
  let max = 0, current = 0;
  for (const inv of sorted) {
    if (inv.status === InvoiceStatus.Released && !inv.disputeRaisedAt) {
      current++; max = Math.max(max, current);
    } else if (inv.disputeRaisedAt) {
      current = 0;
    }
  }
  return max;
}

// â”€â”€ reputation score â€” deterministic, 0â€“1000 â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Completion rate    40% â†’ up to 400 pts  (linear â€” based on rate, not count)
// Activity volume    20% â†’ up to 200 pts  (log scale â€” never plateaus)
// Best streak        20% â†’ up to 200 pts  (log scale â€” keeps rewarding consistency)
// Two-sided          10% â†’ up to 100 pts  (binary â€” used platform both ways)
// Dispute penalty   âˆ’10% â†’ up to âˆ’100 pts (50 per dispute, max 100 deducted)
//
// Log scale means 200 invoices scores better than 50 but not 4x better.
// The score approaches 1000 asymptotically â€” always a reason to do one more.

interface ScoreBreakdown {
  total: number;
  completionPts: number;
  activityPts: number;
  streakPts: number;
  twoSidedPts: number;
  disputePenalty: number;
}

function calcReputationScore(
  totalSent: number,
  cleanCompletions: number,
  longestStreak: number,
  totalPaid: number,
  disputedAsCreator: number,
  disputedAsClient: number,
): ScoreBreakdown {
  // 1. Completion rate â€” linear, based on rate not raw count (0â€“400)
  const completionRate = totalSent > 0 ? cleanCompletions / totalSent : 0;
  const completionPts = Math.round(completionRate * 400);

  // 2. Activity â€” log scale, reference point: 50 invoices â‰ˆ 150pts, 200 â‰ˆ 190pts (0â€“200)
  const totalActivity = totalSent + totalPaid;
  const activityPts = totalActivity > 0
    ? Math.round(Math.log(totalActivity + 1) / Math.log(202) * 200)
    : 0;

  // 3. Streak â€” log scale, reference point: 20 streak â‰ˆ 150pts, 100 â‰ˆ 190pts (0â€“200)
  const streakPts = longestStreak > 0
    ? Math.round(Math.log(longestStreak + 1) / Math.log(202) * 200)
    : 0;

  // 4. Two-sided participation â€” binary (0 or 100)
  const twoSidedPts = totalSent > 0 && totalPaid > 0 ? 100 : 0;

  // 5. Dispute penalty â€” 50pts per dispute, max 100 deducted
  const disputePenalty = Math.min((disputedAsCreator + disputedAsClient) * 50, 100);

  const total = Math.max(0, Math.min(1000, completionPts + activityPts + streakPts + twoSidedPts - disputePenalty));

  return { total, completionPts, activityPts, streakPts, twoSidedPts, disputePenalty };
}

// â”€â”€ read-only SDK â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

function createReadOnlySdk(connection: Connection): EscrowPaySDK | null {
  try {
    const mock: Wallet = {
      publicKey: new PublicKey('11111111111111111111111111111111'),
      signTransaction: async <T extends { serialize: () => Uint8Array }>(tx: T): Promise<T> => tx,
      signAllTransactions: async <T extends { serialize: () => Uint8Array }>(txs: T[]): Promise<T[]> => txs,
    };
    const provider = new AnchorProvider(connection, mock, { commitment: 'confirmed' });
    return new EscrowPaySDK(provider);
  } catch { return null; }
}

// â”€â”€ score ring â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

const ScoreRing: React.FC<{ score: number }> = ({ score }) => {
  const size = 160;
  const stroke = 10;
  const radius = (size - stroke) / 2;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const dashOffset = circumference * (1 - score / 1000);
  const color = score >= 800 ? '#2DD4BF' : score >= 500 ? '#38BDF8' : score >= 200 ? '#F59E0B' : '#EF4444';

  return (
    <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
      <svg width={size} height={size} style={{ transform: 'rotate(-90deg)' }}>
        <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.06)" strokeWidth={stroke} />
        <circle
          cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none"
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={stroke} strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeDasharray={circumference} strokeDashoffset={dashOffset}
          style={{ transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 1s ease' }}
        />
      </svg>
      <div className="absolute flex flex-col items-center">
        <span style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '2.5rem', color, letterSpacing: '-0.03em', lineHeight: 1 }}>
          {score}
        </span>
        <span style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', color: '#64748B', marginTop: '4px' }}>
          / 1000
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// â”€â”€ stat card â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

const StatCard = ({ label, value, sub, accent }: { label: string; value: string | number; sub?: string; accent?: boolean }) => (
  <div className="rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-1" style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' }}>
    <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest" style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', letterSpacing: '0.08em' }}>
      {label}
    </p>
    <p style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '2rem', color: accent ? '#2DD4BF' : '#F8FAFC', letterSpacing: '-0.02em', lineHeight: 1.1 }}>
      {value}
    </p>
    {sub && <p style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px' }}>{sub}</p>}
  </div>
);

// â”€â”€ breakdown row â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

const BreakdownRow = ({ label, pts, max, negative }: { label: string; pts: number; max: number; negative?: boolean }) => (
  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
    <span style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', color: '#94A3B8', minWidth: '170px', flexShrink: 0 }}>
      {label}
    </span>
    <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
      <div
        className="h-full rounded-full"
        style={{ width: `${(Math.abs(pts) / max) * 100}%`, backgroundColor: negative ? '#EF4444' : '#2DD4BF', transition: 'width 0.8s ease' }}
      />
    </div>
    <span style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '12px', color: negative ? '#EF4444' : '#F8FAFC', minWidth: '56px', textAlign: 'right', flexShrink: 0 }}>
      {negative ? 'âˆ’' : '+'}{Math.abs(pts)} / {max}
    </span>
  </div>
);

// â”€â”€ session cache (cleared on tab close) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

const profileCache = new Map<string, { data: ProfileData; fetchedAt: number }>();
const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes

// â”€â”€ types â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

type LoadState = 'loading' | 'error' | 'loaded';

interface ProfileData {
  totalSent: number;
  cleanCompletions: number;
  disputedAsCreator: number;
  longestStreak: number;
  totalPaid: number;
  disputedAsClient: number;
  memberSince: string;
  walletAddress: string;
  score: ScoreBreakdown;
}

// â”€â”€ page â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

const ProfilePage: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallet } = useParams<{ wallet: string }>();
  const { connection } = useConnection();

  const [loadState, setLoadState] = useState<LoadState>('loading');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<ProfileData | null>(null);
  const [showBreakdown, setShowBreakdown] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const walletPubkey = useMemo(() => {
    if (!wallet) return null;
    try { return new PublicKey(wallet); } catch { return null; }
  }, [wallet]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!walletPubkey) { setError('Invalid wallet address.'); setLoadState('error'); return; }

    const cacheKey = walletPubkey.toBase58();
    const cached = profileCache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && Date.now() - cached.fetchedAt < CACHE_TTL) {
      setProfile(cached.data);
      setLoadState('loaded');
      return;
    }

    const load = async () => {
      setLoadState('loading');
      const sdk = createReadOnlySdk(connection);
      if (!sdk) { setError('Failed to connect to Solana.'); setLoadState('error'); return; }

      try {
        const [creatorResult, clientResult] = await Promise.all([
          sdk.fetchInvoicesByCreator(walletPubkey),
          sdk.fetchInvoicesByClient(walletPubkey),
        ]);

        const creatorInvoices: InvoiceData[] = creatorResult.success && creatorResult.data
          ? creatorResult.data.map(i => i.account) : [];
        const clientInvoices: InvoiceData[] = clientResult.success && clientResult.data
          ? clientResult.data.map(i => i.account) : [];

        const cleanCompletions = creatorInvoices.filter(i => i.status === InvoiceStatus.Released && !i.disputeRaisedAt).length;
        const disputedAsCreator = creatorInvoices.filter(i => !!i.disputeRaisedAt).length;
        const streak = getLongestCleanStreak(creatorInvoices);
        const disputedAsClient = clientInvoices.filter(i => !!i.disputeRaisedAt).length;

        const score = calcReputationScore(
          creatorInvoices.length, cleanCompletions, streak,
          clientInvoices.length, disputedAsCreator, disputedAsClient,
        );

        const data: ProfileData = {
          totalSent: creatorInvoices.length,
          cleanCompletions,
          disputedAsCreator,
          longestStreak: streak,
          totalPaid: clientInvoices.length,
          disputedAsClient,
          memberSince: getMemberSince([...creatorInvoices, ...clientInvoices]),
          walletAddress: walletPubkey.toBase58(),
          score,
        };
        profileCache.set(cacheKey, { data, fetchedAt: Date.now() });
        setProfile(data);
        setLoadState('loaded');
      } catch (e) {
        setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load profile.');
        setLoadState('error');
      }
    };

    load();
  }, [walletPubkey, connection]);

  // â”€â”€ loading â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  if (loadState === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col" style={{ backgroundColor: '#0D1117' }}>
        <Header />
        <main className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin" style={{ color: '#2DD4BF' }} />
            <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px' }}>Reading on-chain data...</p>
          </div>
        </main>
        <Footer />
      </div>
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ error â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  if (loadState === 'error' || !profile) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col" style={{ backgroundColor: '#0D1117' }}>
        <Header />
        <main className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center px-4">
          <div className="rounded-xl p-10 text-center" style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', maxWidth: '400px', width: '100%' }}>
            <AlertCircle className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-4" style={{ color: '#EF4444' }} />
            <h3 style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '1.125rem', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              Profile not found
            </h3>
            <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', marginBottom: '24px' }}>
              {error || 'No on-chain activity found for this wallet.'}
            </p>
            <Link to="/" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', color: '#F8FAFC', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', textDecoration: 'none' }}>
              Go Home
            </Link>
          </div>
        </main>
        <Footer />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const hasCreatorActivity = profile.totalSent > 0;
  const hasClientActivity = profile.totalPaid > 0;
  const hasAnyActivity = hasCreatorActivity || hasClientActivity;
  const completionRate = profile.totalSent > 0 ? Math.round((profile.cleanCompletions / profile.totalSent) * 100) : null;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col" style={{ backgroundColor: '#0D1117' }}>
      <Header />
      <main className="flex-1 w-full px-4 sm:px-6 py-12">
        <div style={{ maxWidth: '720px', margin: '0 auto' }}>

          {/* â”€â”€ Identity â”€â”€ */}
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 mb-10">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest mb-2" style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', letterSpacing: '0.08em' }}>
                Wallet Record
              </p>
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace', fontSize: '1rem', color: '#F8FAFC', letterSpacing: '0.01em', wordBreak: 'break-all', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                {profile.walletAddress}
              </p>
              {profile.memberSince !== 'â€”' && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
                  <Calendar className="h-3 w-3" style={{ color: '#64748B' }} />
                  <span style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px' }}>
                    Active since {profile.memberSince}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
              <a
                href={`https://explorer.solana.com/address/${profile.walletAddress}?cluster=devnet`}
                target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-70"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)', color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', textDecoration: 'none' }}
              >
                <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
                Verify on-chain
              </a>
              <button
                onClick={async () => {
                  try {
                    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
                    setCopied(true);
                    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
                  } catch { /* ignore */ }
                }}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs transition-all duration-150"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: copied ? 'rgba(45,212,191,0.1)' : 'transparent',
                  border: copied ? '1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.3)' : '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
                  color: copied ? '#2DD4BF' : '#94A3B8',
                  fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                {copied
                  ? <><Check className="h-3 w-3" />Copied!</>
                  : <><Copy className="h-3 w-3" />Copy link</>}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* â”€â”€ No activity â”€â”€ */}
          {!hasAnyActivity && (
            <div className="rounded-xl p-12 text-center mb-8" style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' }}>
              <TruvloLogo size="sm" className="mx-auto mb-4" />
              <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px' }}>
                No on-chain escrow activity found for this wallet yet.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {hasAnyActivity && (
            <>
              {/* â”€â”€ Reputation score â€” hero â”€â”€ */}
              <div
                className="rounded-xl p-8 mb-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center gap-8"
                style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', borderLeft: '4px solid #2DD4BF' }}
              >
                <ScoreRing score={profile.score.total} />

                <div className="flex-1 text-center md:text-left">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-center md:justify-start mb-2">
                    <p style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '1.25rem', color: '#F8FAFC', letterSpacing: '-0.01em' }}>
                      Wallet Reputation
                    </p>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setShowBreakdown(v => !v)}
                      style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#64748B', padding: '2px', display: 'flex' }}
                      title="How is this calculated?"
                    >
                      <Info className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', color: '#94A3B8', lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                    Derived entirely from verified on-chain activity. Cannot be edited or faked.
                    Used for future token distribution and airdrop eligibility.
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center md:justify-start">
                    {profile.cleanCompletions > 0 && (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,212,191,0.1)', color: '#2DD4BF', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>
                        <Shield className="h-3 w-3" />
                        {profile.cleanCompletions} clean completion{profile.cleanCompletions !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {profile.longestStreak >= 3 && (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.1)', color: '#38BDF8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>
                        <Zap className="h-3 w-3" />
                        {profile.longestStreak} streak
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {profile.disputedAsCreator === 0 && profile.disputedAsClient === 0 && (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)', color: '#4ADE80', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>
                        Zero disputes
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {profile.score.twoSidedPts === 100 && (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(249,115,22,0.1)', color: '#FB923C', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>
                        Two-sided
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* â”€â”€ Breakdown (expandable via â„¹ï¸ button) â”€â”€ */}
              {showBreakdown && (
                <div className="rounded-xl p-6 mb-6 space-y-3" style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
                  <p style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 500, fontSize: '13px', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                    How the score is calculated
                  </p>
                  <BreakdownRow label="Completion rate (Ã—400)" pts={profile.score.completionPts} max={400} />
                  <BreakdownRow label="Activity volume (Ã—200)" pts={profile.score.activityPts} max={200} />
                  <BreakdownRow label="Best streak (Ã—200)" pts={profile.score.streakPts} max={200} />
                  <BreakdownRow label="Two-sided (Ã—100)" pts={profile.score.twoSidedPts} max={100} />
                  {profile.score.disputePenalty > 0 && (
                    <BreakdownRow label="Dispute penalty (Ã—100)" pts={profile.score.disputePenalty} max={100} negative />
                  )}
                  <div className="flex justify-between pt-3 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', color: '#94A3B8' }}>Total</span>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '13px', color: '#2DD4BF' }}>
                      {profile.score.total} / 1000
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* â”€â”€ As Creator â”€â”€ */}
              {hasCreatorActivity && (
                <div className="mb-6">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                    <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: '#94A3B8' }} />
                    <h2 style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 500, fontSize: '1rem', color: '#F8FAFC' }}>As Creator</h2>
                    <div className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                    <StatCard label="Clean completions" value={profile.cleanCompletions} sub={`of ${profile.totalSent} sent`} accent={profile.cleanCompletions > 0} />
                    <StatCard label="Completion rate" value={completionRate !== null ? `${completionRate}%` : 'â€”'} sub={profile.disputedAsCreator > 0 ? `${profile.disputedAsCreator} disputed` : 'No disputes'} />
                    <StatCard label="Best streak" value={profile.longestStreak} sub="dispute-free in a row" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* â”€â”€ As Client â”€â”€ */}
              {hasClientActivity && (
                <div className="mb-6">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                    <Shield className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: '#94A3B8' }} />
                    <h2 style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 500, fontSize: '1rem', color: '#F8FAFC' }}>As Client</h2>
                    <div className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <StatCard label="Invoices paid" value={profile.totalPaid} sub="via escrow" />
                    <StatCard label="Disputes raised" value={profile.disputedAsClient} sub={profile.disputedAsClient === 0 ? 'Clean record' : 'as client'} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          {/* â”€â”€ Verification footer â”€â”€ */}
          <div className="rounded-xl p-5 flex items-start gap-4" style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,212,191,0.1)' }}>
              <Shield className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: '#2DD4BF' }} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontWeight: 500, fontSize: '13px', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                This record is verified on-chain
              </p>
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', color: '#64748B', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                Every figure here is derived from one wallet's on-chain activity.
                For pooled account reputation across linked wallets, open the{' '}
                <Link to="/account" style={{ color: '#2DD4BF', textDecoration: 'none' }}>
                  Account page
                </Link>{' '}
                instead. {' '}
                <a href={`https://explorer.solana.com/address/${profile.walletAddress}?cluster=devnet`}
                  target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ color: '#2DD4BF', textDecoration: 'none' }}>
                  Verify yourself →
                </a>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* â”€â”€ Wallet match warning â”€â”€ */}
          <div
            className="rounded-xl p-4 flex items-start gap-3 mt-3"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.06)', border: '1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.15)' }}
          >
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: '#F59E0B' }} />
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', color: '#94A3B8', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
              <span style={{ color: '#F8FAFC', fontWeight: 500 }}>Always verify the wallet address matches. </span>
              This page is public and wallet-specific. Before paying an invoice, confirm the wallet shown here
              matches the one on the invoice you received. For pooled account reputation, use the Account page.
            </p>
          </div>

        </div>
      </main>
      <Footer />
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProfilePage;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useConnection } from '@solana/wallet-adapter-react';
import { usePrivy } from '@privy-io/react-auth';

import { useActiveWallet } from '@/contexts/ActiveWalletContext';
import {
  PublicKey, Transaction, VersionedTransaction,
  SystemProgram, LAMPORTS_PER_SOL,
} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {
  getAssociatedTokenAddress, getAccount, createTransferInstruction,
  TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID, ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID, createAssociatedTokenAccountInstruction,
} from '@solana/spl-token';
import { Keypair } from '@solana/web3.js';
import * as bip39 from 'bip39';
import { derivePath } from 'ed25519-hd-key';
import bs58 from 'bs58';

// Devnet USDC mint
const USDC_MINT = new PublicKey('4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU');

type TokenType = 'SOL' | 'USDC';

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
  fontSize: '12px',
  fontWeight: 500,

function getErrorMessage(e: unknown): string {
  if (e instanceof Error) return e.message;
  if (typeof e === 'string') return e;
  return 'Unknown error';
}

async function registerWallet(address: string, getAccessToken: () => Promise<string | null>) {
  try {
    const token = await getAccessToken();
    await fetch('/api/register-wallet', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
      body: JSON.stringify({ wallet_address: address }),
    });
  } catch { /* non-blocking */ }
}

async function unregisterWallet(address: string, getAccessToken: () => Promise<string | null>) {
  try {
    const token = await getAccessToken();
    await fetch('/api/register-wallet', {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
      body: JSON.stringify({ wallet_address: address }),
    });
  } catch { /* non-blocking */ }
}

const WalletPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { authenticated, ready, getAccessToken } = usePrivy();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { connection } = useConnection();
  const { activeWallet, allWallets, setActiveWallet } = useActiveWallet();
  const { importWallet } = useImportWallet();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  // ─── all state up-front (hooks must not be after early return) ───────────
  const [solBalance, setSolBalance] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [usdcBalance, setUsdcBalance] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [balanceLoading, setBalanceLoading] = useState(false);
  const [addressCopied, setAddressCopied] = useState(false);
  const [sendToken, setSendToken] = useState<TokenType>('SOL');
  const [recipient, setRecipient] = useState('');
  const [sendAmount, setSendAmount] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [importTab, setImportTab] = useState<ImportTab>('privateKey');
  const [importKey, setImportKey] = useState('');
  const [importSeed, setImportSeed] = useState('');
  const [importError, setImportError] = useState('');
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
  const [profileSlug, setProfileSlug] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [removeModalWallet, setRemoveModalWallet] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState(false);
  const [showCombinedWarning, setShowCombinedWarning] = useState(false);

  // FIX: Memoize publicKey so its reference is stable across renders.
  // Without useMemo, `new PublicKey(addr)` creates a new object on every render,
  // causing fetchBalances (which depends on publicKey) to re-fire endlessly:
  // fetch → setBalanceLoading(false) → re-render → new publicKey ref → new fetchBalances → fetch again.
  const walletAddress = activeWallet?.address ?? null;
  const publicKey = useMemo(
    () => walletAddress ? new PublicKey(walletAddress) : null,
    [walletAddress]
  );

  // Auth guard
  useEffect(() => {
    if (ready && !authenticated) navigate('/', { replace: true });
  }, [ready, authenticated, navigate]);

  // Load profile slug — if null, auto-register active wallet to generate one
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || !authenticated || !activeWallet) return;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const token = await getAccessToken();
        const res = await fetch('/api/profile', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.profile_slug) {
          setProfileSlug(data.profile_slug);
        } else {
          // No slug yet — register the active wallet to generate one
          const regRes = await fetch('/api/register-wallet', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
            body: JSON.stringify({ wallet_address: activeWallet.address }),
          });
          if (regRes.ok) {
            const regData = await regRes.json();
            setProfileSlug(regData.profile_slug ?? null);
          }
        }
      } catch { /* non-blocking */ }
    })();
  }, [ready, authenticated, getAccessToken, activeWallet]);

  // ─── balances ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchBalances = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!publicKey) return;
    setBalanceLoading(true);
    try {
      const sol = await connection.getBalance(publicKey);
      setSolBalance(sol / LAMPORTS_PER_SOL);
    } catch { setSolBalance(null); }
    try {
      const ata = await getAssociatedTokenAddress(USDC_MINT, publicKey);
      const account = await getAccount(connection, ata);
      setUsdcBalance(Number(account.amount) / 1_000_000);
    } catch { setUsdcBalance(0); }
    setBalanceLoading(false);
  }, [publicKey, connection]);

  useEffect(() => { fetchBalances(); }, [fetchBalances]);

  // ─── anchor wallet for signing ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const anchorWallet = useMemo(() => {
    if (!publicKey || !activeWallet) return null;
    return {
      publicKey,
      signTransaction: async <T extends Transaction | VersionedTransaction>(tx: T): Promise<T> => {
        const bytes = tx instanceof VersionedTransaction
          ? tx.serialize()
          : tx.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false, verifySignatures: false });
        const { signedTransaction } = await activeWallet.signTransaction({ transaction: bytes });
        return (tx instanceof VersionedTransaction
          ? VersionedTransaction.deserialize(signedTransaction)
          : Transaction.from(Buffer.from(signedTransaction))) as T;
      },
    };
  }, [publicKey, activeWallet]);

  // Early return after all hooks
  if (!ready || !authenticated) return <div style={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: '#0D1117' }} />;

  // ─── handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleCopyAddress = async () => {
    if (!activeWallet?.address) return;
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(activeWallet.address);
    setAddressCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setAddressCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleRemoveWallet = async () => {
    if (!removeModalWallet) return;
    setRemoving(true);
    await unregisterWallet(removeModalWallet, getAccessToken);
    toast({ title: 'Wallet removed from your account' });
    setRemoveModalWallet(null);
    setRemoving(false);
  };

  const handleCopySingleLink = async () => {
    if (!activeWallet?.address) return;
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${window.location.origin}/profile/${activeWallet.address}`);
    toast({ title: 'Link copied' });
  };

  const handleCopyCombinedLink = async () => {
    if (!profileSlug) return;
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${window.location.origin}/profile/account/${profileSlug}`);
    toast({ title: 'Combined profile link copied' });
    setShowCombinedWarning(false);
  };

  const handleSend = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!publicKey || !anchorWallet) return;

    let recipientKey: PublicKey;
    try {
      recipientKey = new PublicKey(recipient.trim());
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'Invalid recipient address', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }

    const amount = parseFloat(sendAmount);
    if (isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) {
      toast({ title: 'Enter a valid amount', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }

    setSending(true);
    try {
      const { blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight } = await connection.getLatestBlockhash();
      const tx = new Transaction({ blockhash, feePayer: publicKey, lastValidBlockHeight });

      if (sendToken === 'SOL') {
        tx.add(SystemProgram.transfer({
          fromPubkey: publicKey,
          toPubkey: recipientKey,
          lamports: Math.floor(amount * LAMPORTS_PER_SOL),
        }));
      } else {
        const fromAta = await getAssociatedTokenAddress(USDC_MINT, publicKey);
        const toAta = await getAssociatedTokenAddress(USDC_MINT, recipientKey);
        try {
          await getAccount(connection, toAta);
        } catch {
          tx.add(createAssociatedTokenAccountInstruction(
            publicKey, toAta, recipientKey, USDC_MINT,
            TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID, ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          ));
        }
        tx.add(createTransferInstruction(
          fromAta, toAta, publicKey,
          BigInt(Math.floor(amount * 1_000_000)),
        ));
      }

      const signed = await anchorWallet.signTransaction(tx);
      const sig = await connection.sendRawTransaction(signed.serialize());
      await connection.confirmTransaction({ blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight, signature: sig });

      toast({ title: `${sendToken} sent`, description: `Tx: ${sig.slice(0, 8)}...` });
      setRecipient('');
      setSendAmount('');
      fetchBalances();
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = getErrorMessage(err);
      const display = msg.includes('insufficient') ? 'Insufficient balance.'
        : msg.includes('rejected') ? 'Transaction cancelled.' : msg;
      toast({ title: 'Send failed', description: display, variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleImport = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setImportError('');
    setImporting(true);
    try {
      let key = '';
      if (importTab === 'privateKey') {
        key = importKey.trim();
        if (!key) { setImportError('Enter your private key.'); setImporting(false); return; }
      } else {
        const words = importSeed.trim().split(/\s+/);
        if (words.length !== 12 && words.length !== 24) {
          setImportError('Enter a valid 12 or 24-word seed phrase.');
          setImporting(false);
          return;
        }
        if (!bip39.validateMnemonic(importSeed.trim())) {
          setImportError('Invalid seed phrase — check your words.');
          setImporting(false);
          return;
        }
        const seed = bip39.mnemonicToSeedSync(importSeed.trim());
        const { key: derivedKey } = derivePath("m/44'/501'/0'/0'", seed.toString('hex'));
        const keypair = Keypair.fromSeed(derivedKey);
        key = bs58.encode(keypair.secretKey);
      }
      const imported = await importWallet({ privateKey: key });
      if (imported?.address) registerWallet(imported.address, getAccessToken);
      toast({ title: 'Wallet imported' });
      setImportKey('');
      setImportSeed('');
      fetchBalances();
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = getErrorMessage(err);
      setImportError(msg.includes('already') ? 'A wallet is already linked to this key.' : msg);
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
    }
  };

  // ─── render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <div style={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: '#0D1117', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Header />
      <main style={{ flex: 1, maxWidth: '560px', margin: '0 auto', width: '100%', padding: '32px 16px 80px' }}>

        {/* Page title */}
        <div style={{ marginBottom: '24px' }}>
          <h1 style={{
            fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
            fontWeight: 700,
            fontSize: '1.625rem',
            color: '#F8FAFC',
            letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
            marginBottom: '4px',
          }}>
            Wallet
          </h1>
          <p style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px' }}>
            {activeWallet?.address
              ? `${activeWallet.address.slice(0, 6)}...${activeWallet.address.slice(-6)}`
              : 'No wallet connected'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* ── Your Wallets ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={sectionCard}>
          <p style={{ ...sectionTitle, marginBottom: '14px' }}>Your Wallets</p>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '8px' }}>
            {allWallets.length === 0 && (
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', color: '#64748B' }}>
                No wallets connected.
              </p>
            )}
            {allWallets.map(w => {
              const isActive = w.address === activeWallet?.address;
              const short = `${w.address.slice(0, 6)}...${w.address.slice(-6)}`;
              return (
                <div
                  key={w.address}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '8px',
                    backgroundColor: isActive ? 'rgba(45,212,191,0.05)' : '#1C2128',
                    border: `1px solid ${isActive ? 'rgba(45,212,191,0.2)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'}`,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    padding: '10px 12px',
                    minWidth: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Status dot */}
                  <div style={{
                    width: '7px', height: '7px', borderRadius: '50%', flexShrink: 0,
                    backgroundColor: isActive ? '#2DD4BF' : '#334155',
                  }} />

                  {/* Address — truncated, takes remaining space */}
                  <span style={{
                    fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace',
                    fontSize: '12px',
                    color: '#F8FAFC',
                    flex: 1,
                    minWidth: 0,
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  }}>
                    {short}
                  </span>

                  {/* Active badge */}
                  {isActive && (
                    <span style={{
                      fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: 600,
                      color: '#2DD4BF', backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,212,191,0.1)',
                      border: '1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.2)', borderRadius: '4px',
                      padding: '2px 7px', flexShrink: 0,
                    }}>
                      Active
                    </span>
                  )}

                  {/* Set as Active button */}
                  {!isActive && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setActiveWallet(w);
                        toast({ title: 'Wallet switched — dashboard and invoices now use this wallet' });
                      }}
                      style={{
                        fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: 500,
                        color: '#94A3B8', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
                        border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', borderRadius: '6px',
                        padding: '3px 8px', cursor: 'pointer', flexShrink: 0, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      }}
                    >
                      Set Active
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {/* View reputation link */}
                  <Link
                    to={`/profile/${w.address}`}
                    style={{ color: '#64748B', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}
                    title="View on-chain reputation"
                  >
                    <ExternalLink size={13} />
                  </Link>

                  {/* Remove button (non-active only) */}
                  {!isActive && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setRemoveModalWallet(w.address)}
                      style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#EF4444', padding: '2px', flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}
                      title="Remove wallet"
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={13} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ── Balances ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={sectionCard}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
            <p style={sectionTitle}>Balances</p>
            <button
              onClick={fetchBalances}
              disabled={balanceLoading}
              style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: balanceLoading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', color: '#64748B', padding: '4px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}
              title="Refresh balances"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={14} style={{ animation: balanceLoading ? 'spin 1s linear infinite' : 'none' }} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '10px' }}>
            {([
              { label: 'SOL', value: solBalance },
              { label: 'USDC', value: usdcBalance },
            ] as const).map(({ label, value }) => (
              <div key={label} style={{
                backgroundColor: '#1C2128',
                borderRadius: '10px',
                padding: '16px 14px',
                minWidth: 0,
              }}>
                <p style={{
                  fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                  fontSize: '11px',
                  color: '#64748B',
                  textTransform: 'uppercase',
                  letterSpacing: '0.07em',
                  marginBottom: '8px',
                }}>
                  {label}
                </p>
                <p style={{
                  fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
                  fontWeight: 700,

        {/* ── Receive ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={sectionCard}>

          <div style={{

            )}

            <button
              type="submit"

              style={{

                border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
                borderRadius: '8px',

                padding: '10px 0',
                cursor: importing ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                opacity: importing ? 0.6 : 1,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                gap: '8px',
              }}
            >
              {importing && <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" />}
              {importing ? 'Importing…' : 'Import Wallet'}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

      </main>
      <Footer />

      {/* ── Remove wallet confirmation modal ──────────────────────────────── */}
      {removeModalWallet && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed', inset: 0, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)',
          zIndex: 9999, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '16px',
        }}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
            borderRadius: '16px', padding: '28px', width: '100%', maxWidth: '380px',
          }}>
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
              Remove wallet?
            </p>
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', color: '#94A3B8', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace', fontSize: '13px', color: '#F8FAFC' }}>
                {removeModalWallet.slice(0, 4)}...{removeModalWallet.slice(-4)}
              </span>
            </p>
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', color: '#94A3B8', marginBottom: '24px', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
              This only unlinks the wallet from your Truvlo profile. The wallet and its on-chain history are not affected.
            </p>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px' }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setRemoveModalWallet(null)}
                style={{ flex: 1, padding: '10px 0', borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', backgroundColor: 'transparent', color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleRemoveWallet}
                disabled={removing}
                style={{ flex: 1, padding: '10px 0', borderRadius: '8px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: '#EF4444', color: '#fff', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '14px', cursor: removing ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', opacity: removing ? 0.7 : 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px' }}
              >
                {removing && <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />}
                Remove
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Combined profile privacy warning modal ────────────────────────── */}
      {showCombinedWarning && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed', inset: 0, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)',
          zIndex: 9999, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '16px',
        }}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
            borderRadius: '16px', padding: '28px', width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px',
          }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
              <AlertTriangle size={18} style={{ color: '#F59E0B', flexShrink: 0 }} />
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '1rem', color: '#F8FAFC' }}>
                Heads up
              </p>
            </div>
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', color: '#94A3B8', lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: '24px' }}>
              Your combined profile lists all {allWallets.length} wallet{allWallets.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} linked to your account. Anyone with this link will be able to see every wallet address and verify them on Solana. Only share this if you're comfortable disclosing all your wallets.

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px' }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowCombinedWarning(false)}
                style={{ flex: 1, padding: '10px 0', borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', backgroundColor: 'transparent', color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', cursor: 'pointer' }}

              >
                <Copy size={14} /> Share anyway
              </button>

      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default WalletPage;

import "jsr:@supabase/functions-js/edge-runtime.d.ts";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Client-Info, Apikey",
};

interface InvoiceEmailRequest {
  clientEmail: string;
  invoiceId: string;
  amount: string;
  tokenType: string;
  description: string;
  creatorAddress: string;
  paymentUrl: string;
}

Deno.serve(async (req: Request) => {
  // Handle CORS preflight
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, {
      status: 200,
      headers: corsHeaders,
    });
  }

  try {
    const RESEND_API_KEY = Deno.env.get("RESEND_API_KEY");
    
    if (!RESEND_API_KEY) {
      console.error("RESEND_API_KEY not configured");
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Email service not configured" }),
        {
          status: 500,
          headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        }
      );
    }

    const body: InvoiceEmailRequest = await req.json();
    const { clientEmail, invoiceId, amount, tokenType, description, creatorAddress, paymentUrl } = body;

    // Validate required fields
    if (!clientEmail || !invoiceId || !amount || !paymentUrl) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing required fields" }),
        {
          status: 400,
          headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        }
      );
    }

    // Shorten creator address for display
    const shortCreator = creatorAddress 
      ? `${creatorAddress.slice(0, 4)}...${creatorAddress.slice(-4)}`
      : "Unknown";

    // Build email HTML
    const emailHtml = `
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

                    <p style="margin: 0 0 4px; color: #666; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase;">Amount Due</p>
                    <p style="margin: 0; color: #00d4ff; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600;">${amount} ${tokenType}</p>
                  </td>
                </tr>

                    <p style="margin: 0 0 4px; color: #666; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase;">From</p>
                    <p style="margin: 0; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-family: monospace;">${shortCreator}</p>
                  </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                  <td style="padding-bottom: 32px;">
                    <p style="margin: 0 0 4px; color: #666; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase;">Description</p>
                    <p style="margin: 0; color: #ccc; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5;">${description || "No description provided"}</p>
                  </td>

                  </td>

            </td>
          </tr>
          
          <!-- Footer -->
          <tr>
            <td style="padding: 24px 32px; border-top: 1px solid #1e1e2e; text-align: center;">
              <p style="margin: 0 0 8px; color: #666; font-size: 12px;">Payment is secured by escrow on Solana</p>
              <p style="margin: 0; color: #444; font-size: 11px;">Funds are held securely until released by the creator</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </table>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </table>
</body>
</html>
    `;

    // Send email via Resend
    const resendResponse = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Authorization": `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: "EscrowPay <onboarding@resend.dev>",
        to: [clientEmail],
        subject: `Invoice ${invoiceId} - ${amount} ${tokenType}`,
        html: emailHtml,
      }),
    });

    const resendData = await resendResponse.json();

    if (!resendResponse.ok) {
      console.error("Resend API error:", resendData);
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Failed to send email", details: resendData }),
        {
          status: 500,
          headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        }
      );
    }

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ success: true, messageId: resendData.id }),
      {
        status: 200,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Edge function error:", error);
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ error: "Internal server error" }),
      {
        status: 500,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      }
    );
  }
});

import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';
import type { VercelRequest } from '@vercel/node';
import { PrivyClient } from '@privy-io/server-auth';
import { createClient, type SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { PublicKey } from '@solana/web3.js';

const PRIVY_APP_ID = process.env.VITE_PRIVY_APP_ID!;
const PRIVY_APP_SECRET = process.env.PRIVY_APP_SECRET!;
const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.SUPABASE_URL!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!;

export const privy = new PrivyClient(PRIVY_APP_ID, PRIVY_APP_SECRET);
export const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

export type TokenType = 'USDC' | 'SOL';
export type ReferralRewardStatus = 'pending' | 'matured' | 'requestable' | 'requested' | 'scheduled' | 'paid' | 'rejected';
export type DisputeStatus = 'open' | 'under_review' | 'resolved' | 'closed';
export type DisputeDecision = 'creator' | 'client' | 'split';

export function getAuthToken(req: VercelRequest): string | null {
  const header = req.headers.authorization;
  if (!header) return null;
  return header.startsWith('Bearer ') ? header.slice(7) : header;
}

export async function requireUserId(req: VercelRequest): Promise<string | null> {
  const token = getAuthToken(req);
  if (!token) return null;
  try {
    const claims = await privy.verifyAuthToken(token);
    return claims.userId;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function isValidSolanaAddress(address: string): boolean {
  try {
    void new PublicKey(address);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function normalizeSolanaAddress(address: string): string {
  return new PublicKey(address).toBase58();
}

export function generateReferralCode(): string {
  return randomBytes(4).toString('hex').toUpperCase();
}

export async function getProfileByPrivyId<T extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
  client: SupabaseClient,
  privyId: string,
  columns = '*'
): Promise<T | null> {
  const { data, error } = await client
    .from('profiles')
    .select(columns)
    .eq('privy_id', privyId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error || !data) return null;
  return data as unknown as T;
}

export async function getPrivyIdForWallet(client: SupabaseClient, walletAddress: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const { data, error } = await client
    .from('wallets')
    .select('privy_id')
    .eq('wallet_address', walletAddress)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error || !data) return null;
  return data.privy_id as string;
}

export async function walletBelongsToUser(client: SupabaseClient, privyId: string, walletAddress: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const owner = await getPrivyIdForWallet(client, walletAddress);
  return owner === privyId;
}

export async function ensureReferralCode(client: SupabaseClient, privyId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const { data, error } = await client
    .from('profiles')
    .select('referral_code')
    .eq('privy_id', privyId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error || !data) return null;
  if (data.referral_code) return data.referral_code as string;

  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {
    const referralCode = generateReferralCode();
    const { error: updateError } = await client
      .from('profiles')
      .upsert({ privy_id: privyId, referral_code: referralCode }, { onConflict: 'privy_id' });
    if (!updateError) return referralCode;
  }

  return null;
}

export function calculatePlatformFee(amount: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return 0;
  return amount < 200 ? 2 : amount * 0.01;
}

export function calculateReferralPool(platformFee: number): number {
  return platformFee * 0.1;
}

export function getNextPayoutCycle(now = new Date()): { payoutCycleDate: Date; requestDeadline: Date } {
  const year = now.getUTCFullYear();
  const month = now.getUTCMonth();
  const nextMonthStart = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0));
  const deadline = new Date(nextMonthStart.getTime() - 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  if (now <= deadline) {
    return { payoutCycleDate: nextMonthStart, requestDeadline: deadline };
  }

  const followingMonthStart = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0));
  return {
    payoutCycleDate: followingMonthStart,
    requestDeadline: new Date(followingMonthStart.getTime() - 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
  };
}

export function chooseReferralShares(
  creatorCreatedAt: string | null | undefined,
  clientCreatedAt: string | null | undefined,
  creatorHasReferrer: boolean,
  clientHasReferrer: boolean
): Array<{ role: 'creator' | 'client'; shareBps: number }> {
  if (creatorHasReferrer && clientHasReferrer) {
    const creatorTime = creatorCreatedAt ? new Date(creatorCreatedAt).getTime() : 0;
    const clientTime = clientCreatedAt ? new Date(clientCreatedAt).getTime() : 0;
    if (creatorTime <= clientTime) {
      return [{ role: 'creator', shareBps: 3000 }, { role: 'client', shareBps: 7000 }];
    }
    return [{ role: 'creator', shareBps: 7000 }, { role: 'client', shareBps: 3000 }];
  }

  if (creatorHasReferrer) return [{ role: 'creator', shareBps: 10000 }];
  if (clientHasReferrer) return [{ role: 'client', shareBps: 10000 }];
  return [];
}

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const supabase = createClient(
  process.env.SUPABASE_URL!,
  process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!
);

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  if (req.method !== 'GET') return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });

  const { slug } = req.query;
  if (!slug || typeof slug !== 'string') {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'slug query parameter required' });
  }

  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('privy_id, display_name')
    .eq('profile_slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (profileError) return res.status(500).json({ error: profileError.message });
  if (!profile) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Profile not found' });

  const { data: wallets, error: walletsError } = await supabase
    .from('wallets')
    .select('wallet_address')
    .eq('privy_id', profile.privy_id);

  if (walletsError) return res.status(500).json({ error: walletsError.message });

  return res.status(200).json({
    display_name: profile.display_name ?? null,
    wallet_addresses: (wallets ?? []).map(w => w.wallet_address),
  });
}

FILE: api\create-invoice-meta.ts

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import {
  isValidSolanaAddress,
  normalizeSolanaAddress,
  requireUserId,
  supabase,
  walletBelongsToUser,
} from './_shared.js';

const RESEND_API_KEY = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
const FROM_EMAIL = process.env.FROM_EMAIL || 'notifications@truvlo.io';

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
  }

  const privyId = await requireUserId(req);
  if (!privyId) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Missing or invalid authorization token' });
  }

  // 2. Validate body
  const {
    invoiceId, creatorWallet, clientWallet, clientEmail, senderName,
    description, tokenType, amount, invoiceUrl,
  } = req.body;

  if (!invoiceId || !creatorWallet || !tokenType || amount == null || !invoiceUrl) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required fields' });
  }

  if (!isValidSolanaAddress(creatorWallet)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid creator wallet' });
  }
  if (clientWallet && !isValidSolanaAddress(clientWallet)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid client wallet' });
  }

  const normalizedCreatorWallet = normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet);
  if (!(await walletBelongsToUser(supabase, privyId, normalizedCreatorWallet))) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Creator wallet does not belong to the authenticated user' });
  }

  // 3. Look up creator's notification_email from their profile
  let creatorEmail: string | null = null;
  try {
    const { data: profile } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('notification_email')
      .eq('privy_id', privyId)
      .maybeSingle();
    creatorEmail = profile?.notification_email ?? null;
  } catch { /* non-blocking */ }

  // 4. Write to Supabase invoice_meta
  const { error: dbError } = await supabase.from('invoice_meta').insert({
    invoice_id: invoiceId,
    creator_wallet: normalizedCreatorWallet,
    creator_privy_id: privyId,
    client_wallet: clientWallet ? normalizeSolanaAddress(clientWallet) : null,
    client_email: clientEmail || null,
    sender_name: senderName || null,
    description: description || null,
    token_type: tokenType,
    amount,
    invoice_url: invoiceUrl,
    email_sent: false,
    creator_email: creatorEmail,
  });

  if (dbError) {
    console.error('Supabase insert error:', dbError);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to save invoice metadata' });
  }

  // 4. Send invoice email — non-fatal if it fails
  if (clientEmail && RESEND_API_KEY) {
    try {
      const shortCreator = `${creatorWallet.slice(0, 8)}...${creatorWallet.slice(-8)}`;
      const emailHtml = buildInvoiceEmail({
        invoiceId, senderName, amount, tokenType, description, invoiceUrl, shortCreator,
      });

      const emailRes = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          from: `Truvlo <${FROM_EMAIL}>`,
          to: [clientEmail],
          subject: `${senderName ? senderName + ' sent you an invoice' : 'New invoice'} — ${amount} ${tokenType}`,
          html: emailHtml,
        }),
      });

      if (emailRes.ok) {
        await supabase
          .from('invoice_meta')
          .update({ email_sent: true })
          .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId);
      } else {
        console.error('Resend error:', await emailRes.text());
      }
    } catch (emailErr) {
      console.error('Email send error:', emailErr);
    }
  }

  return res.status(200).json({ success: true });
}

FILE: api\disputes.ts
