import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import {
  isValidSolanaAddress,
  normalizeSolanaAddress,
  requireUserId,
  supabase,
  walletBelongsToUser,
} from './_shared.js';

type DisputeDecision = 'creator' | 'client' | 'split';
type DisputeSide = 'creator' | 'client' | 'admin';

function parseDecision(value: unknown): DisputeDecision | null {
  return value === 'creator' || value === 'client' || value === 'split' ? value : null;
}

function getAdminPrivyIds(): string[] {
  const raw = process.env.DISPUTE_ADMIN_PRIVY_IDS || process.env.DISPUTE_ADMIN_PRIVY_ID || '';
  return raw
    .split(',')
    .map(v => v.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  const userId = await requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

  const adminIds = getAdminPrivyIds();
  const isAdmin = adminIds.includes(userId);

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // GET /api/disputes?invoiceId=...
  // FIX: Authorize that the caller is a party to the dispute or admin.
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    const invoiceId = typeof req.query.invoiceId === 'string' ? req.query.invoiceId : null;
    if (!invoiceId) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'invoiceId is required' });
    }

    const { data: disputeCase, error } = await supabase
      .from('dispute_cases')
      .select('*')
      .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
    if (!disputeCase) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Dispute case not found' });

    // FIX: Verify the caller is the creator, client, or admin before returning any data.
    const isCreator = disputeCase.creator_privy_id === userId;
    // client_privy_id may be null for older cases; fall back to wallet ownership check.
    const isClient =
      disputeCase.client_privy_id === userId ||
      (disputeCase.client_wallet &&
        (await walletBelongsToUser(supabase, userId, disputeCase.client_wallet)));

    if (!isCreator && !isClient && !isAdmin) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Not authorized to view this dispute' });
    }

    const { data: evidence, error: evidenceError } = await supabase
      .from('dispute_evidence')
      .select('*')
      .eq('case_id', disputeCase.id)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

    if (evidenceError) return res.status(500).json({ error: evidenceError.message });
    return res.status(200).json({ dispute_case: disputeCase, evidence: evidence ?? [] });
  }

  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    const { action } = req.body as { action?: string };

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // POST action=open
    // FIX 1: Replace upsert with insert — fail if a case already exists.
    // FIX 2: Verify openedByWallet is a party to the invoice from invoice_meta.
    // FIX 3: Derive openedByRole from the verified wallet match, not from input.
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (action === 'open') {
      const {
        invoiceId,
        openedByWallet,
        evidenceDeadlineHours = 72,
      } = req.body as {
        invoiceId?: string;
        openedByWallet?: string;
        evidenceDeadlineHours?: number;
      };

      if (!invoiceId || !openedByWallet) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required fields' });
      }
      if (!isValidSolanaAddress(openedByWallet)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid wallet address' });
      }

      const normalizedOpener = normalizeSolanaAddress(openedByWallet);

      if (!(await walletBelongsToUser(supabase, userId, normalizedOpener))) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Opened-by wallet does not belong to the authenticated user' });
      }

      // FIX: Verify opener is a party to this invoice; derive role server-side.
      const { data: invoiceMeta, error: metaError } = await supabase
        .from('invoice_meta')
        .select('creator_wallet, client_wallet, creator_privy_id, client_privy_id')
        .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (metaError) return res.status(500).json({ error: metaError.message });
      if (!invoiceMeta) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Invoice not found' });

      let derivedRole: 'creator' | 'client';
      if (invoiceMeta.creator_wallet === normalizedOpener) {
        derivedRole = 'creator';
      } else if (invoiceMeta.client_wallet === normalizedOpener) {
        derivedRole = 'client';
      } else {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Wallet is not a party to this invoice' });
      }

      const evidenceDeadlineAt = new Date(
        Date.now() + Math.max(24, evidenceDeadlineHours) * 60 * 60 * 1000
      ).toISOString();

      // FIX: Use insert instead of upsert so an existing dispute cannot be overwritten.
      const { data: disputeCase, error } = await supabase
        .from('dispute_cases')
        .insert({
          invoice_id: invoiceId,
          creator_wallet: invoiceMeta.creator_wallet,
          client_wallet: invoiceMeta.client_wallet ?? null,
          creator_privy_id: invoiceMeta.creator_privy_id ?? null,
          client_privy_id: invoiceMeta.client_privy_id ?? null,
          opened_by_privy_id: userId,
          opened_by_role: derivedRole,
          status: 'open',
          evidence_deadline_at: evidenceDeadlineAt,
        })
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        // Postgres unique_violation — a case already exists for this invoice.
        if (error.code === '23505') {
          return res.status(409).json({ error: 'A dispute already exists for this invoice' });
        }
        return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
      }

      await supabase
        .from('invoice_meta')
        .update({ dispute_case_id: disputeCase.id })
        .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
        .eq('creator_wallet', invoiceMeta.creator_wallet);

      return res.status(200).json({ success: true, dispute_case: disputeCase });
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // POST action=evidence
    // FIX: Derive `side` from server-validated wallet match, not from input.
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (action === 'evidence') {
      const {
        caseId,
        submittedByWallet,
        evidenceType,
        evidenceUrl,
        note,
      } = req.body as {
        caseId?: string;
        submittedByWallet?: string;
        // `side` is intentionally NOT destructured — we derive it server-side.
        evidenceType?: string;
        evidenceUrl?: string;
        note?: string;
      };

      if (!caseId || !submittedByWallet || !evidenceType) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required fields' });
      }
      if (!isValidSolanaAddress(submittedByWallet)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid wallet address' });
      }

      const normalizedSubmitter = normalizeSolanaAddress(submittedByWallet);

      if (!(await walletBelongsToUser(supabase, userId, normalizedSubmitter))) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Submitted wallet does not belong to the authenticated user' });
      }

      const { data: disputeCase, error: caseError } = await supabase
        .from('dispute_cases')
        .select('*')
        .eq('id', caseId)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (caseError) return res.status(500).json({ error: caseError.message });
      if (!disputeCase) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Dispute case not found' });

      // FIX: Derive side from the authenticated wallet's role in this dispute.
      let derivedSide: DisputeSide;
      if (isAdmin) {
        derivedSide = 'admin';
      } else if (normalizedSubmitter === disputeCase.creator_wallet) {
        derivedSide = 'creator';
      } else if (normalizedSubmitter === disputeCase.client_wallet) {
        derivedSide = 'client';
      } else {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Wallet is not a party to this dispute' });
      }

      const { data: inserted, error } = await supabase
        .from('dispute_evidence')
        .insert({
          case_id: caseId,
          submitted_by_privy_id: userId,
          submitted_by_wallet: normalizedSubmitter,
          side: derivedSide,          // server-derived, not caller-supplied
          evidence_type: evidenceType,
          evidence_url: evidenceUrl || null,
          note: note || null,
        })
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });

      await supabase
        .from('dispute_cases')
        .update({ status: 'under_review' })
        .eq('id', caseId);

      return res.status(200).json({ success: true, evidence: inserted });
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // POST action=resolve  (unchanged — already admin-gated)
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (action === 'resolve') {
      if (adminIds.length === 0) {
        return res.status(503).json({ error: 'Dispute admin is not configured' });
      }
      if (!isAdmin) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Admin access required' });
      }

      const {
        caseId,
        decision,
        creatorShareBps,
        clientShareBps,
        verdictNote,
        verdictHash,
      } = req.body as {
        caseId?: string;
        decision?: DisputeDecision;
        creatorShareBps?: number;
        clientShareBps?: number;
        verdictNote?: string;
        verdictHash?: string;
      };

      const parsedDecision = parseDecision(decision);
      if (!caseId || !parsedDecision) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing caseId or invalid decision' });
      }

      const shares = parsedDecision === 'split'
        ? { creator: creatorShareBps ?? 0, client: clientShareBps ?? 0 }
        : parsedDecision === 'creator'
          ? { creator: 10000, client: 0 }
          : { creator: 0, client: 10000 };

      if (parsedDecision === 'split' && shares.creator + shares.client !== 10000) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Split shares must total 10000 bps' });
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('dispute_cases')
        .update({
          status: 'resolved',
          decision: parsedDecision,
          resolution_creator_bps: shares.creator,
          resolution_client_bps: shares.client,
          resolved_by_privy_id: userId,
          resolved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          verdict_note: verdictNote || null,
          verdict_hash: verdictHash || null,
        })
        .eq('id', caseId)
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
      return res.status(200).json({ success: true, dispute_case: data });
    }

    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Unknown action' });
  }

  return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
}

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import {
  isValidSolanaAddress,
  normalizeSolanaAddress,
  requireUserId,
  supabase,
  walletBelongsToUser,
} from './_shared.js';

const RESEND_API_KEY = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
const FROM_EMAIL = process.env.FROM_EMAIL || 'notifications@truvlo.io';
// FIX: Use a server-controlled origin so the approve URL cannot be forged by the caller.
const APP_ORIGIN = process.env.APP_ORIGIN;

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
  }

  const userId = await requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

  if (!APP_ORIGIN) {
    console.error('APP_ORIGIN env var is not configured');
    return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Server misconfiguration' });
  }

  // FIX: invoiceUrl is removed from the destructured body — it is no longer trusted.
  const { invoiceId, creatorWallet, amount, description, senderName } = req.body as {
    invoiceId?: string;
    creatorWallet?: string;
    amount?: string;
    description?: string;
    senderName?: string;
  };

  if (!invoiceId || !creatorWallet || !amount) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required fields' });
  }

  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Email service not configured' });
  if (!isValidSolanaAddress(creatorWallet)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid creator wallet' });
  }

  const normalizedCreatorWallet = normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet);
  if (!(await walletBelongsToUser(supabase, userId, normalizedCreatorWallet))) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Creator wallet does not belong to the authenticated user' });
  }

  const { data: meta, error: metaError } = await supabase
    .from('invoice_meta')
    .select('client_email, sender_name, description')
    .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
    .eq('creator_wallet', normalizedCreatorWallet)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (metaError) return res.status(500).json({ error: metaError.message });

  const clientEmail = meta?.client_email;
  if (!clientEmail || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(clientEmail)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No client email on record for this invoice' });
  }

  // FIX: Generate approve URL server-side from a trusted, allowlisted origin.
  // invoiceId is already validated to belong to this creator, so it is safe to embed.
  const approveUrl = `${APP_ORIGIN}/approve/${encodeURIComponent(invoiceId)}`;

  const shortCreator = `${normalizedCreatorWallet.slice(0, 8)}...${normalizedCreatorWallet.slice(-8)}`;
  const headline = senderName ? `${senderName} requested payment approval` : 'Release requested';
  const body = senderName
    ? `<strong style="color:#F8FAFC;">${senderName}</strong> has marked the work complete and requested release.`
    : 'The creator has marked the work complete and requested release.';

  const html = `
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f4f4f5;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;">
  <div style="max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px;">
    <div style="background:#0D1117;border-radius:16px;padding:28px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#F8FAFC;margin-bottom:16px;">Truvlo</div>
      <h1 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:22px;color:#F8FAFC;">${headline}</h1>
      <p style="margin:0 0 20px;color:#94A3B8;line-height:1.6;">${body}</p>
      <div style="background:#161B22;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;">Invoice</div>
        <div style="color:#F8FAFC;font-family:monospace;margin-top:4px;">${invoiceId}</div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-top:14px;">Amount</div>
        <div style="color:#F8FAFC;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;">${amount}</div>
        ${description ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-top:14px;">Description</div><div style="color:#F8FAFC;margin-top:4px;">${description}</div>` : ''}
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-top:14px;">Creator</div>
        <div style="color:#94A3B8;font-family:monospace;margin-top:4px;">${shortCreator}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="background:#1C2128;border-left:3px solid #2DD4BF;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="color:#F8FAFC;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px;">You have 7 days to respond</div>
        <div style="color:#94A3B8;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">Review the work and approve the release, or raise a dispute if there is an issue.</div>
      </div>
      <a href="${approveUrl}" style="display:inline-block;background:#2DD4BF;color:#0D1117;text-decoration:none;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;">Approve or Dispute</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`.trim();

  try {
    const response = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: `Truvlo <${FROM_EMAIL}>`,
        to: [clientEmail],
        subject: `Release requested — ${senderName || shortCreator} (${invoiceId})`,
        html,
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      return res.status(502).json({ error: 'Failed to send email' });
    }

    await supabase
      .from('invoice_meta')
      .update({ creator_privy_id: userId })
      .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
      .eq('creator_wallet', normalizedCreatorWallet);

    return res.status(200).json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Email send error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
}

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import {
  ensureReferralCode,
  isValidSolanaAddress,
  normalizeSolanaAddress,
  requireUserId,
  supabase,
  walletBelongsToUser,
} from './_shared.js';

const RESEND_API_KEY = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
const FROM_EMAIL = process.env.FROM_EMAIL || 'notifications@truvlo.io';

type EventType = 'paid' | 'release_approved' | 'disputed';

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });

  const userId = await requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

  const {
    invoiceId,
    creatorWallet,
    clientWallet,
    event,
    amount,
  } = req.body as {
    invoiceId?: string;
    creatorWallet?: string;
    clientWallet?: string;
    event?: EventType;
    amount?: string;
  };

  if (!invoiceId || !creatorWallet || !clientWallet || !event) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required fields' });
  }

  if (!isValidSolanaAddress(creatorWallet) || !isValidSolanaAddress(clientWallet)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid wallet address' });
  }

  const normalizedCreatorWallet = normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet);
  const normalizedClientWallet = normalizeSolanaAddress(clientWallet);

  if (!(await walletBelongsToUser(supabase, userId, normalizedClientWallet))) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Client wallet does not belong to the authenticated user' });
  }

  const { data: meta, error: metaError } = await supabase
    .from('invoice_meta')
    .select('sender_name, description, client_wallet')
    .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
    .eq('creator_wallet', normalizedCreatorWallet)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (metaError) return res.status(500).json({ error: metaError.message });
  if (meta?.client_wallet && meta.client_wallet !== normalizedClientWallet) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Client wallet does not match this invoice' });
  }

  await ensureReferralCode(supabase, userId);

  await supabase
    .from('invoice_meta')
    .update({
      client_wallet: normalizedClientWallet,
      client_privy_id: userId,
    })
    .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
    .eq('creator_wallet', normalizedCreatorWallet);

  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) return res.status(200).json({ success: true, skipped: true });

  const { data: walletRow } = await supabase
    .from('wallets')
    .select('privy_id')
    .eq('wallet_address', normalizedCreatorWallet)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!walletRow) {
    return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Creator wallet not found' });
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('notification_email')
    .eq('privy_id', walletRow.privy_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  const creatorEmail = profile?.notification_email;
  if (!creatorEmail || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(creatorEmail)) {
    return res.status(200).json({ success: true, skipped: true });
  }

  const shortWallet = `${normalizedCreatorWallet.slice(0, 8)}...${normalizedCreatorWallet.slice(-8)}`;
  const dashboardUrl = 'https://truvlo.io/dashboard';
  const eventConfig: Record<EventType, { subject: string; headline: string; body: string; accent: string }> = {
    paid: {
      subject: `Payment received — ${invoiceId}`,
      headline: 'Your invoice was paid',
      body: `Your client has paid <strong style="color:#F8FAFC;">${amount || 'the invoice amount'}</strong> into escrow. Funds are held on-chain until release.`,
      accent: '#2DD4BF',
    },
    release_approved: {
      subject: `Release approved — ${invoiceId}`,
      headline: 'Client approved your release request',
      body: `Your client has approved release for <strong style="color:#F8FAFC;">${invoiceId}</strong>. You can now release the funds from your dashboard.`,
      accent: '#4ADE80',
    },
    disputed: {
      subject: `Dispute raised — ${invoiceId}`,
      headline: 'Client raised a dispute',
      body: `Your client has raised a dispute on <strong style="color:#F8FAFC;">${invoiceId}</strong>. Funds are frozen while the case is reviewed by the platform.`,
      accent: '#FCD34D',
    },
  };

  const { subject, headline, body, accent } = eventConfig[event];

  const html = `
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f4f4f5;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;">
  <div style="max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px;">
    <div style="background:#0D1117;border-radius:16px;padding:28px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#F8FAFC;margin-bottom:16px;">Truvlo</div>
      <h1 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:22px;color:#F8FAFC;">${headline}</h1>
      <p style="margin:0 0 20px;color:#94A3B8;line-height:1.6;">${body}</p>
      <div style="background:#161B22;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;">Invoice</div>
        <div style="color:#F8FAFC;font-family:monospace;margin-top:4px;">${invoiceId}</div>
        ${amount ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-top:14px;">Amount</div><div style="color:#F8FAFC;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;">${amount}</div>` : ''}
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-top:14px;">Creator wallet</div>
        <div style="color:#94A3B8;font-family:monospace;margin-top:4px;">${shortWallet}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="background:#1C2128;border-left:3px solid ${accent};border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="color:#94A3B8;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">
          ${event === 'paid' ? 'Go to your dashboard when you are ready to request release.' : ''}
          ${event === 'release_approved' ? 'Go to your dashboard to complete the release.' : ''}
          ${event === 'disputed' ? 'Open the dispute case in your dashboard to review evidence.' : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
      <a href="${dashboardUrl}" style="display:inline-block;background:#2DD4BF;color:#0D1117;text-decoration:none;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;">Go to Dashboard</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`.trim();

  try {
    const response = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: `Truvlo <${FROM_EMAIL}>`,
        to: [creatorEmail],
        subject,
        html,
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const error = await response.text();
      console.error('Resend error (notify-creator):', error);
      return res.status(502).json({ error: 'Failed to send email' });
    }

    return res.status(200).json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Email send error (notify-creator):', error);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
}

FILE: api\payout-requests.ts

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import {
  getNextPayoutCycle,
  isValidSolanaAddress,
  normalizeSolanaAddress,
  requireUserId,
  supabase,
  walletBelongsToUser,
} from './_shared.js';

type TokenType = 'USDC' | 'SOL';

function parseTokenType(value: unknown): TokenType | null {
  return value === 'SOL' || value === 'USDC' ? value : null;
}

function toNumber(value: unknown): number {
  const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number.parseFloat(String(value));
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}

async function loadAvailableRewards(privyId: string, tokenType: TokenType) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('referral_rewards')
    .select('id, reward_amount, status')
    .eq('referrer_privy_id', privyId)
    .eq('token_type', tokenType)
    .in('status', ['matured', 'requestable'])
    .is('payout_request_id', null);

  if (error) throw error;
  return data ?? [];
}

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  const userId = await requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    const [usdcRewards, solRewards, payoutRequests] = await Promise.all([
      loadAvailableRewards(userId, 'USDC'),
      loadAvailableRewards(userId, 'SOL'),
      supabase
        .from('payout_requests')
        .select('id, token_type, amount, status, payout_cycle_date, request_deadline, requested_at, processed_at, admin_note, payout_wallet')
        .eq('privy_id', userId)
        .order('requested_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(20),
    ]);

    const totalByToken = {
      USDC: usdcRewards.reduce((sum, row) => sum + toNumber(row.reward_amount), 0),
      SOL: solRewards.reduce((sum, row) => sum + toNumber(row.reward_amount), 0),
    };

    return res.status(200).json({
      balances: totalByToken,
      rewards: { USDC: usdcRewards, SOL: solRewards },
      payout_requests: payoutRequests.data ?? [],
    });
  }

  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    const { tokenType: rawTokenType, payoutWallet } = req.body as {
      tokenType?: TokenType;
      payoutWallet?: string;
    };

    const tokenType = parseTokenType(rawTokenType);
    if (!tokenType) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'tokenType must be USDC or SOL' });
    }

    if (!payoutWallet || !isValidSolanaAddress(payoutWallet)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Valid payoutWallet is required' });
    }

    if (!(await walletBelongsToUser(supabase, userId, normalizeSolanaAddress(payoutWallet)))) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Payout wallet does not belong to the authenticated user' });
    }

    // FIX: Guard against concurrent double-submission before touching any rows.
    // Check for an existing pending request for this user + tokenType.
    // Recommended long-term: add a partial unique index in Postgres:
    //   CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payout_requests_one_pending_per_user
    //   ON payout_requests (privy_id, token_type)
    //   WHERE status = 'pending';
    // That index makes this check race-safe. Until then, this guard catches the
    // common case and the unique index catches the race.
    const { data: existingPending } = await supabase
      .from('payout_requests')
      .select('id')
      .eq('privy_id', userId)
      .eq('token_type', tokenType)
      .eq('status', 'pending')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (existingPending) {
      return res.status(409).json({
        error: 'You already have a pending payout request for this token. Wait for it to be processed before submitting another.',
      });
    }

    const rewards = await loadAvailableRewards(userId, tokenType);
    const amount = rewards.reduce((sum, row) => sum + toNumber(row.reward_amount), 0);
    if (amount < 10) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'You need at least $10 in available rewards before requesting payout' });
    }

    const { payoutCycleDate, requestDeadline } = getNextPayoutCycle();

    // FIX: Insert the payout request row.
    const { data: request, error: requestError } = await supabase
      .from('payout_requests')
      .insert({
        privy_id: userId,
        token_type: tokenType,
        payout_wallet: normalizeSolanaAddress(payoutWallet),
        amount,
        status: 'pending',
        payout_cycle_date: payoutCycleDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        request_deadline: requestDeadline.toISOString(),
      })
      .select('*')
      .single();

    if (requestError) {
      // Catch the race that the unique index would prevent.
      if (requestError.code === '23505') {
        return res.status(409).json({ error: 'A concurrent payout request was already submitted' });
      }
      return res.status(500).json({ error: requestError.message });
    }

    // FIX: Only update rewards whose payout_request_id is still null.
    // This prevents a second concurrent request from claiming the same rewards
    // even if both passed the existence check above (belt-and-suspenders).
    const rewardIds = rewards.map(row => row.id);
    const { error: updateError, count } = await supabase
      .from('referral_rewards')
      .update({
        status: 'requested',
        payout_request_id: request.id,
        payout_cycle_date: payoutCycleDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        requested_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .in('id', rewardIds)
      .is('payout_request_id', null)   // guard: skip any already claimed by a race
      .eq('referrer_privy_id', userId); // belt-and-suspenders: never touch other users' rows

    if (updateError) {
      return res.status(500).json({ error: updateError.message });
    }

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      payout_request: request,
      reward_count: count ?? rewardIds.length,
      amount,
    });
  }

  return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
}

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import { ensureReferralCode, requireUserId, supabase } from './_shared.js';

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    const privyId = await requireUserId(req);
    if (!privyId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

    const referralCode = await ensureReferralCode(supabase, privyId);
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('display_name, default_token, profile_slug, notification_email, email, created_at, referral_code, referred_by_code, referral_linked_at')
      .eq('privy_id', privyId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
    return res.status(200).json({
      display_name: data?.display_name ?? null,
      default_token: data?.default_token ?? 'USDC',
      profile_slug: data?.profile_slug ?? null,
      notification_email: data?.notification_email ?? null,
      referral_code: referralCode ?? data?.referral_code ?? null,
      referred_by_code: data?.referred_by_code ?? null,
      referral_linked_at: data?.referral_linked_at ?? null,
    });
  }

  if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
    const privyId = await requireUserId(req);
    if (!privyId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

    const { display_name, default_token, notification_email, referred_by_code } = req.body as {
      display_name?: string;
      default_token?: string;
      notification_email?: string;
      referred_by_code?: string | null;
    };

    if (typeof display_name !== 'string') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'display_name must be a string' });
    }
    const trimmed = display_name.trim().slice(0, 50);
    const tokenValue = default_token === 'SOL' ? 'SOL' : 'USDC';
    const emailTrimmed = typeof notification_email === 'string' ? notification_email.trim().toLowerCase() || null : undefined;
    if (emailTrimmed && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(emailTrimmed)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid notification email' });
    }

    const referralCode = await ensureReferralCode(supabase, privyId);
    const referredByCode = typeof referred_by_code === 'string' ? referred_by_code.trim().toUpperCase() : null;
    if (referredByCode && referredByCode === referralCode) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'You cannot refer yourself' });
    }
    if (referredByCode) {
      const { data: referrer } = await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('privy_id')
        .eq('referral_code', referredByCode)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (!referrer) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Referral code not found' });
      }
      const { data: current } = await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('referred_by_code')
        .eq('privy_id', privyId)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (current?.referred_by_code && current.referred_by_code !== referredByCode) {
        return res.status(409).json({ error: 'Referral code already set' });
      }
    }

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .upsert(
        {
          privy_id: privyId,
          display_name: trimmed || null,
          default_token: tokenValue,
          ...(emailTrimmed !== undefined ? { notification_email: emailTrimmed } : {}),
          ...(referredByCode ? { referred_by_code: referredByCode, referral_linked_at: new Date().toISOString() } : {}),
          referral_code: referralCode,
        },
        { onConflict: 'privy_id' }
      );

    if (error) return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
    return res.status(200).json({
      display_name: trimmed || null,
      default_token: tokenValue,
      notification_email: emailTrimmed ?? null,
      referral_code: referralCode,
      referred_by_code: referredByCode,
    });
  }

  return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
}

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import { AnchorProvider, type Wallet } from '@coral-xyz/anchor';
import { clusterApiUrl, Connection, Keypair, PublicKey, Transaction, VersionedTransaction } from '@solana/web3.js';
import {
  calculateReferralPool,
  ensureReferralCode,
  getProfileByPrivyId,
  getPrivyIdForWallet,
  isValidSolanaAddress,
  normalizeSolanaAddress,
  requireUserId,
  supabase,
  walletBelongsToUser,
  chooseReferralShares,
} from './_shared.js';
import {
  EscrowPaySDK,
  InvoiceStatus,
  PLATFORM_FEE_BPS,
  PLATFORM_FEE_THRESHOLD_USD,
  PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD,
} from '../src/lib/escrowPaySDK.js';

type TokenType = 'USDC' | 'SOL';
type RewardSourceRole = 'creator' | 'client';

function parseTokenType(value: unknown): TokenType | null {
  return value === 'SOL' || value === 'USDC' ? value : null;
}

function getSolanaRpcUrl(): string {
  return process.env.SOLANA_RPC_URL || process.env.VITE_SOLANA_RPC_URL || clusterApiUrl('devnet');
}

function createReadOnlyEscrowSdk(): EscrowPaySDK {
  const payer = Keypair.generate();
  const mockWallet: Wallet = {
    payer,
    publicKey: payer.publicKey,
    signTransaction: async <T extends Transaction | VersionedTransaction>(tx: T) => tx,
    signAllTransactions: async <T extends Transaction | VersionedTransaction>(txs: T[]) => txs,
  };
  const connection = new Connection(getSolanaRpcUrl(), 'confirmed');
  return new EscrowPaySDK(new AnchorProvider(connection, mockWallet, { commitment: 'confirmed' }));
}

async function isInvoiceReleasedOnChain(invoiceId: string, creatorWallet: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const sdk = createReadOnlyEscrowSdk();
  const result = await sdk.fetchInvoice(invoiceId, new PublicKey(creatorWallet));
  if (!result.success || !result.data) {
    throw new Error(typeof result.error === 'string' ? result.error : 'Unable to verify invoice release state');
  }
  return result.data.status === InvoiceStatus.Released;
}

async function calculateServerPlatformFee(amount: number, tokenType: TokenType): Promise<number> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return 0;
  if (tokenType === 'USDC') {
    return amount < PLATFORM_FEE_THRESHOLD_USD ? PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD : amount * (PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000);
  }

  const sdk = createReadOnlyEscrowSdk();
  const solPriceUsd = await sdk.getSolPriceUsd();
  if (solPriceUsd && solPriceUsd > 0 && amount * solPriceUsd < PLATFORM_FEE_THRESHOLD_USD) {
    return Number((PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD / solPriceUsd).toFixed(9));
  }
  return amount * (PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000);
}

async function loadRewardSummary(privyId: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('referral_rewards')
    .select('status, token_type, reward_amount, source_role, invoice_id, created_at, payout_cycle_date')
    .eq('referrer_privy_id', privyId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

  if (error) throw error;

  const summary: Record<TokenType, Record<string, number>> = {
    USDC: { pending: 0, matured: 0, requestable: 0, requested: 0, scheduled: 0, paid: 0, rejected: 0 },
    SOL: { pending: 0, matured: 0, requestable: 0, requested: 0, scheduled: 0, paid: 0, rejected: 0 },
  };

  for (const row of data ?? []) {
    const tokenType = row.token_type as TokenType;
    const status = row.status as keyof typeof summary.USDC;
    const amount = Number(row.reward_amount ?? 0);
    if (summary[tokenType] && status in summary[tokenType]) {
      summary[tokenType][status] += amount;
    }
  }

  return { summary, rewards: data ?? [] };
}

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  const userId = await requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    const referralCode = await ensureReferralCode(supabase, userId);
    const profile = await getProfileByPrivyId<{
      display_name: string | null;
      referral_code: string | null;
      referred_by_code: string | null;
      referral_linked_at: string | null;
      created_at: string | null;
    }>(supabase, userId, 'display_name, referral_code, referred_by_code, referral_linked_at, created_at');

    const { summary, rewards } = await loadRewardSummary(userId);
    const { data: payoutRequests } = await supabase
      .from('payout_requests')
      .select('id, token_type, amount, status, payout_cycle_date, request_deadline, requested_at, processed_at, admin_note')
      .eq('privy_id', userId)
      .order('requested_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(12);

    return res.status(200).json({
      profile: profile ? { ...profile, referral_code: referralCode ?? profile.referral_code } : null,
      rewards,
      summary,
      payout_requests: payoutRequests ?? [],
    });
  }

  if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
    const { referred_by_code } = req.body as { referred_by_code?: string | null };
    const referredByCode = typeof referred_by_code === 'string' ? referred_by_code.trim().toUpperCase() : null;

    if (!referredByCode) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'referred_by_code is required' });
    }

    const referralCode = await ensureReferralCode(supabase, userId);
    if (referralCode && referralCode === referredByCode) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'You cannot refer yourself' });
    }

    const { data: referrer } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('privy_id')
      .eq('referral_code', referredByCode)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!referrer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Referral code not found' });
    }

    const { data: current } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('referred_by_code')
      .eq('privy_id', userId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (current?.referred_by_code && current.referred_by_code !== referredByCode) {
      return res.status(409).json({ error: 'Referral code already set' });
    }

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .upsert(
        {
          privy_id: userId,
          referral_code: referralCode,
          referred_by_code: referredByCode,
          referral_linked_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        { onConflict: 'privy_id' }
      );

    if (error) return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
    return res.status(200).json({ referral_code: referralCode, referred_by_code: referredByCode });
  }

  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    const {
      invoiceId,
      creatorWallet,
      clientWallet,
      tokenType: rawTokenType,
    } = req.body as {
      invoiceId?: string;
      creatorWallet?: string;
      clientWallet?: string;
      tokenType?: TokenType;
    };

    if (!invoiceId || !creatorWallet || !clientWallet || !rawTokenType) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required fields' });
    }

    if (!isValidSolanaAddress(creatorWallet) || !isValidSolanaAddress(clientWallet)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid wallet address' });
    }

    if (!(await walletBelongsToUser(supabase, userId, normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet)))) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Creator wallet does not belong to the authenticated user' });
    }

    const tokenType = parseTokenType(rawTokenType);
    if (!tokenType) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid token type' });
    }

    // Look up the invoice from invoice_meta to get the canonical amount and
    // check whether rewards have already been recorded.
    const { data: invoiceMeta, error: metaError } = await supabase
      .from('invoice_meta')
      .select('amount, referral_reward_recorded_at, creator_wallet')
      .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
      .eq('creator_wallet', normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet))
      .maybeSingle();

    if (metaError) return res.status(500).json({ error: metaError.message });
    if (!invoiceMeta) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Invoice not found' });

    if (invoiceMeta.referral_reward_recorded_at) {
      return res.status(409).json({
        error: 'Referral rewards have already been recorded for this invoice',
        recorded_at: invoiceMeta.referral_reward_recorded_at,
      });
    }

    let isReleased: boolean;
    try {
      isReleased = await isInvoiceReleasedOnChain(invoiceId, normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet));
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unable to verify invoice release state';
      return res.status(503).json({ error: message });
    }

    if (!isReleased) {
      return res.status(200).json({ success: true, skipped: true, reason: 'Invoice is not final yet' });
    }

    const amount = Number(invoiceMeta.amount);
    if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invoice has no valid amount recorded' });
    }

    const [creatorPrivyId, clientPrivyId] = await Promise.all([
      getPrivyIdForWallet(supabase, normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet)),
      getPrivyIdForWallet(supabase, normalizeSolanaAddress(clientWallet)),
    ]);

    if (!creatorPrivyId) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Creator profile not found' });
    }

    const creatorProfile = await getProfileByPrivyId<{
      privy_id: string;
      referral_code: string | null;
      referred_by_code: string | null;
      created_at: string | null;
    }>(supabase, creatorPrivyId, 'privy_id, referral_code, referred_by_code, created_at');

    const clientProfile = clientPrivyId
      ? await getProfileByPrivyId<{
          privy_id: string;
          referral_code: string | null;
          referred_by_code: string | null;
          created_at: string | null;
        }>(supabase, clientPrivyId, 'privy_id, referral_code, referred_by_code, created_at')
      : null;

    const platformFee = await calculateServerPlatformFee(amount, tokenType);
    const rewardPool = calculateReferralPool(platformFee);

    const shares = chooseReferralShares(
      creatorProfile?.created_at ?? null,
      clientProfile?.created_at ?? null,
      Boolean(creatorProfile?.referred_by_code),
      Boolean(clientProfile?.referred_by_code)
    );

    if (shares.length === 0 || rewardPool <= 0) {
      await supabase
        .from('invoice_meta')
        .update({
          creator_privy_id: creatorPrivyId,
          client_privy_id: clientPrivyId ?? null,
          client_wallet: normalizeSolanaAddress(clientWallet),
          referral_reward_recorded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
        .eq('creator_wallet', normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet));

      return res.status(200).json({ success: true, created: 0, skipped: true });
    }

    const records = await Promise.all(
      shares.map(async share => {
        const sourcePrivyId = share.role === 'creator' ? creatorPrivyId : clientPrivyId;
        if (!sourcePrivyId) return null;

        const sourceProfile = share.role === 'creator' ? creatorProfile : clientProfile;
        const referralCode = sourceProfile?.referred_by_code ?? null;
        if (!referralCode) return null;

        const { data: referrerProfile } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('privy_id')
          .eq('referral_code', referralCode)
          .maybeSingle();
        if (!referrerProfile) return null;

        const rewardAmount = Number((rewardPool * (share.shareBps / 10000)).toFixed(9));
        const { error } = await supabase.from('referral_rewards').upsert(
          {
            invoice_id: invoiceId,
            source_role: share.role as RewardSourceRole,
            referrer_privy_id: referrerProfile.privy_id,
            referred_privy_id: sourcePrivyId,
            referrer_wallet: null,
            referral_code: referralCode,
            token_type: tokenType,
            invoice_amount: amount,
            platform_fee: platformFee,
            reward_pool: rewardPool,
            reward_amount: rewardAmount,
            reward_share_bps: share.shareBps,
            status: 'matured',
            requestable_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
          { onConflict: 'invoice_id,source_role' }
        );

        if (error) throw error;
        return { role: share.role, reward_amount: rewardAmount, share_bps: share.shareBps };
      })
    );

    const created = records.filter(Boolean);

    await supabase
      .from('invoice_meta')
      .update({
        creator_privy_id: creatorPrivyId,
        client_privy_id: clientPrivyId ?? null,
        client_wallet: normalizeSolanaAddress(clientWallet),
        referral_reward_recorded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
      .eq('creator_wallet', normalizeSolanaAddress(creatorWallet));

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      created: created.length,
      records: created,
    });
  }

  return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
}

FILE: api\register-wallet.ts
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import {
  ensureReferralCode,
  isValidSolanaAddress,
  normalizeSolanaAddress,
  requireUserId,
  supabase,
} from './_shared.js';

function generateSlug(displayName: string | null): string {
  const suffix = Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 6);
  if (displayName) {
    const base = displayName
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, '')
      .trim()
      .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
      .slice(0, 30);
    return base ? `${base}-${suffix}` : `user-${suffix}`;
  }
  return `user-${suffix}`;
}

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    const privyId = await requireUserId(req);
    if (!privyId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

    const { wallet_address } = req.body as { wallet_address?: string };
    if (!wallet_address) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'wallet_address required' });
    if (!isValidSolanaAddress(wallet_address)) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid wallet address' });

    const normalizedWallet = normalizeSolanaAddress(wallet_address);

    // Register the wallet
    const { error: walletError } = await supabase
      .from('wallets')
      .upsert({ privy_id: privyId, wallet_address: normalizedWallet }, { onConflict: 'privy_id,wallet_address' });
    if (walletError) return res.status(500).json({ error: walletError.message });

    // Ensure profile exists and has a slug
    const { data: profile } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('profile_slug, display_name')
      .eq('privy_id', privyId)
      .maybeSingle();

    let slug = profile?.profile_slug ?? null;

    if (!slug) {
      slug = generateSlug(profile?.display_name ?? null);
      await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .upsert({ privy_id: privyId, profile_slug: slug, referral_code: await ensureReferralCode(supabase, privyId) }, { onConflict: 'privy_id' });
    }

    return res.status(200).json({ profile_slug: slug });
  }

  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    const privyId = await requireUserId(req);
    if (!privyId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

    const { wallet_address } = req.body as { wallet_address?: string };
    if (!wallet_address) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'wallet_address required' });
    if (!isValidSolanaAddress(wallet_address)) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid wallet address' });

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('wallets')
      .delete()
      .eq('privy_id', privyId)
      .eq('wallet_address', normalizeSolanaAddress(wallet_address));

    if (error) return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
    return res.status(200).json({ success: true });
  }

  return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
}


──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FILE: api\send-invoice.ts
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from '@vercel/node';
import { PrivyClient } from '@privy-io/server-auth';

const privy = new PrivyClient(
  process.env.VITE_PRIVY_APP_ID!,
  process.env.PRIVY_APP_SECRET!
);

const RESEND_API_KEY = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
const FROM_EMAIL = process.env.FROM_EMAIL || 'onboarding@resend.dev';

async function verifyToken(req: VercelRequest): Promise<string | null> {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.replace('Bearer ', '');
  if (!token) return null;
  try {
    const claims = await privy.verifyAuthToken(token);
    return claims.userId;
  } catch { return null; }
}

export default async function handler(req: VercelRequest, res: VercelResponse) {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
  }

  const userId = await verifyToken(req);
  if (!userId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

  const { invoiceId, clientEmail, creatorWallet, amount, tokenType, description, senderName, invoiceUrl } = req.body;

  if (!invoiceId || !clientEmail || !creatorWallet || !amount || !invoiceUrl) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required fields' });
  }

  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(clientEmail)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid email address' });
  }

  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) {
    console.error('RESEND_API_KEY not set');
    return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Email service not configured' });
  }

  const shortCreator = `${creatorWallet.slice(0, 8)}...${creatorWallet.slice(-8)}`;

  const emailHtml = `
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Invoice ${invoiceId}</title>
</head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f4f4f5;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;">
  <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="background:#f4f4f5;padding:40px 20px;">
    <tr>
      <td align="center">
        <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="max-width:520px;background:#0D1117;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;">

          <!-- Header -->
          <tr>
            <td style="padding:32px 32px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
              <span style="font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#F8FAFC;letter-spacing:-0.02em;">
                <span style="color:#2DD4BF;">T</span>ruvlo
              </span>
            </td>
          </tr>

          <!-- Body -->
          <tr>
            <td style="padding:32px;">
              <h2 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#F8FAFC;letter-spacing:-0.01em;">
                You have a new invoice
              </h2>
              <p style="margin:0 0 24px;font-size:15px;color:#94A3B8;line-height:1.6;">
                ${senderName
                  ? `<strong style="color:#F8FAFC;">${senderName}</strong> sent you an invoice for payment.`
                  : 'Someone sent you an invoice for payment.'
                } Review the details and pay securely through escrow.
              </p>

              <!-- Invoice details -->
              <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"
                style="background:#161B22;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);margin-bottom:24px;">
                <tr>
                  <td style="padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">
                    <span style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;">Invoice ID</span>
                    <p style="margin:4px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:#F8FAFC;font-family:monospace;">${invoiceId}</p>
                  </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                  <td style="padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">
                    <span style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;">Amount due</span>
                    <p style="margin:4px 0 0;font-size:28px;font-weight:700;color:#F8FAFC;letter-spacing:-0.02em;">${amount} ${tokenType || ''}</p>
                  </td>
                </tr>
                ${description ? `
                <tr>
                  <td style="padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">
                    <span style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;">Description</span>
                    <p style="margin:4px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:#F8FAFC;">${description}</p>
                  </td>

                <tr>

                    ${senderName
                      ? `<p style="margin:4px 0 2px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#F8FAFC;">${senderName}</p>
                         <p style="margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#64748B;font-family:monospace;">${shortCreator}</p>`
                      : `<p style="margin:4px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:#94A3B8;font-family:monospace;">${shortCreator}</p>`
                    }
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </table>

              <!-- How escrow works -->
              <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"
                style="background:#1C2128;border-radius:8px;border-left:3px solid #2DD4BF;margin-bottom:24px;">
                <tr>

                    </p>

                      style="display:inline-block;background:#2DD4BF;color:#0D1117;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;
                             text-decoration:none;padding:14px 32px;border-radius:8px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;">
                      Review &amp; Pay Invoice
                    </a>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </table>

              <p style="margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#64748B;text-align:center;line-height:1.6;">

                <a href="${invoiceUrl}" style="color:#2DD4BF;word-break:break-all;">${invoiceUrl}</a>
              </p>
            </td>
          </tr>

          <!-- Footer -->
          <tr>
            <td style="padding:20px 32px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
              <p style="margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#64748B;line-height:1.6;">
                You received this because your email was provided when this invoice was created.
                Truvlo is a smart contract escrow platform on Solana. Your funds are always in your control.
              </p>
            </td>
          </tr>

        </table>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </table>
</body>
</html>
  `.trim();

  try {
    const response = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: `Truvlo <${FROM_EMAIL}>`,
        to: [clientEmail],
        subject: `${senderName ? senderName + ' sent you an invoice' : 'New invoice'} — ${amount} ${tokenType || ''}`,
        html: emailHtml,
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const error = await response.text();
      console.error('Resend error:', error);
      return res.status(502).json({ error: 'Failed to send email' });
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    return res.status(200).json({ success: true, id: data.id });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Email send error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
}
