  borderRadius: '16px',
  padding: '40px 32px',
};

const ApproveRelease: React.FC = () => {
  const { invoiceId, creator } = useParams<{ invoiceId: string; creator: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { connection } = useConnection();
  const { authenticated, getAccessToken } = usePrivy();
  const { activeWallet: privyWallet } = useActiveWallet();
  const publicKey = useMemo(
    () => (privyWallet?.address ? new PublicKey(privyWallet.address) : null),
    [privyWallet?.address],
  );
  const connected = authenticated && !!publicKey;
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { signAndSendTransaction } = useSignAndSendTransaction();

  const [pageState, setPageState] = useState<PageState>({ type: 'loading' });
  const [approving, setApproving] = useState(false);
  const [disputing, setDisputing] = useState(false);
  const [sdkInitError, setSdkInitError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [now, setNow] = useState(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => setNow(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)), 60000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const urlValid = useMemo(() => {
    if (!invoiceId || !creator) return false;
    try { new PublicKey(creator); return true; } catch { return false; }
  }, [invoiceId, creator]);

  const sdk = useMemo(() => {
    if (!publicKey || !privyWallet) return null;
    try {
      const anchorWallet = createPrivySolanaAnchorWallet(privyWallet, publicKey);
      const provider = new AnchorProvider(connection, anchorWallet, { commitment: 'confirmed' });
      const sponsorFn = async (tx: Uint8Array): Promise<string> => {
        return sendSponsoredSolanaTransaction(signAndSendTransaction, privyWallet, tx);
      };
      return new EscrowPaySDK(provider, false, sponsorFn);
    } catch { return null; }
  }, [connection, publicKey, privyWallet, signAndSendTransaction]);

  const createReadOnlySdk = (conn: Connection): EscrowPaySDK | null => {
    try {
      const mock: Wallet = {
        publicKey: new PublicKey('11111111111111111111111111111111'),
        signTransaction: async <T extends Transaction | VersionedTransaction>(tx: T) => tx,
        signAllTransactions: async <T extends Transaction | VersionedTransaction>(txs: T[]) => txs,
      };
      const provider = new AnchorProvider(conn, mock, { commitment: 'confirmed' });
      const instance = new EscrowPaySDK(provider);
      if (!instance.isInitialized()) { setSdkInitError(instance.getInitError()); return null; }
      return instance;
    } catch { return null; }
  };

  const fetchInvoice = async () => {
    if (!urlValid) { setPageState({ type: 'error', message: 'Invalid link — missing invoice ID or creator address.' }); return; }
    const readOnly = createReadOnlySdk(connection);
    if (!readOnly) { setPageState({ type: 'error', message: sdkInitError || 'Failed to initialize. Please refresh.' }); return; }
    try {
      const result = await readOnly.fetchInvoice(invoiceId!, new PublicKey(creator!));
      if (result.success && result.data) {
        setPageState({ type: 'loaded', invoice: result.data });
      } else {
        setPageState({ type: 'error', message: result.error || 'Invoice not found.' });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setPageState({ type: 'error', message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load invoice.' });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { fetchInvoice(); }, [connection, urlValid]);

  const fromSmallestUnit = (amount: unknown, tokenType: TokenType) => {
    const decimals = tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 6 : 9;
    try {
      const raw = amount && typeof amount === 'object' && 'toNumber' in amount && typeof amount.toNumber === 'function'
        ? amount.toNumber()
        : Number(amount ?? 0);
      const int = BigInt(Math.round(raw));
      const divisor = BigInt(10 ** decimals);
      const whole = int / divisor;
      const remainder = int % divisor;
      return parseFloat(`${whole}.${remainder.toString().padStart(decimals, '0')}`);
    } catch { return 0; }
  };

  const getSecondsRemaining = (inv: InvoiceData) => {
    if (!inv.completionRequestedAt) return -1;
    const req = inv.completionRequestedAt.toNumber
      ? inv.completionRequestedAt.toNumber()
      : Number(inv.completionRequestedAt);
    return Math.max(0, 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 - (now - req));
  };

  const handleApprove = async () => {
    if (!sdk || !connected) { toast({ title: 'Connect your wallet first', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    setApproving(true);
    try {
      const result = await sdk.approveRelease(invoiceId!, new PublicKey(creator!));
      if (result.success) {
        setPageState({ type: 'approved' });
        const token = await getAccessToken();
        fetch('/api/notify-creator', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ invoiceId, creatorWallet: creator, clientWallet: publicKey?.toBase58() ?? '', event: 'release_approved' }),
        }).catch(() => {});
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'Approval failed', description: typeof result.error === 'string' ? result.error : 'Failed', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error && e.message.includes('rejected') ? 'Cancelled.' : 'Transaction failed.';
      toast({ title: 'Approval failed', description: msg, variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally { setApproving(false); }
  };

  const handleDispute = async () => {
    if (!sdk || !connected) { toast({ title: 'Connect your wallet first', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    setDisputing(true);
    try {
      const result = await sdk.raiseDispute(invoiceId!, new PublicKey(creator!));
      if (result.success) {
        setPageState({ type: 'disputed' });
        const token = await getAccessToken();
        fetch('/api/notify-creator', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ invoiceId, creatorWallet: creator, clientWallet: publicKey?.toBase58() ?? '', event: 'disputed' }),
        }).catch(() => {});
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'Dispute failed', description: typeof result.error === 'string' ? result.error : 'Failed', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error && e.message.includes('rejected') ? 'Cancelled.' : 'Transaction failed.';
      toast({ title: 'Dispute failed', description: msg, variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally { setDisputing(false); }
  };

  // ── LOADING ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (pageState.type === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div style={cardStyle}>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-8">
          <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin" style={{ color: '#2DD4BF' }} />
          <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px' }}>
            Loading invoice...
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── ERROR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (pageState.type === 'error') {
    return (
      <div style={cardStyle}>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-8 text-center">
          <AlertCircle className="h-10 w-10" style={{ color: '#EF4444' }} />
          <div>
            <h3 style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '1.125rem', color: '#F8FAFC', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              Something went wrong
            </h3>
            <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', marginBottom: '24px' }}>
              {pageState.message}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            Go Home
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── APPROVED ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (pageState.type === 'approved') {
    return (
      <div style={cardStyle}>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-6 text-center">
          <div
            className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' }}
          >
            <Check className="h-8 w-8" style={{ color: '#22C55E' }} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2
              style={{
                fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '1.5rem',
                color: '#F8FAFC',
                letterSpacing: '-0.01em',
                marginBottom: '10px',
              }}
            >
              Release approved
            </h2>
            <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: '28px' }}>
              The creator can now withdraw the funds from escrow. Thank you for confirming.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            Open Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── DISPUTED ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (pageState.type === 'disputed') {
    return (
      <div style={cardStyle}>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-6 text-center">
          <div
            className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.1)' }}
          >
            <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8" style={{ color: '#F59E0B' }} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2
              style={{
                fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '1.5rem',
                color: '#F8FAFC',
                letterSpacing: '-0.01em',
                marginBottom: '10px',
              }}
            >
              Dispute raised
            </h2>
            <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              Your funds are now frozen. The platform will review the case and contact both parties.
            </p>
            <p style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: '28px' }}>
              Do not send additional payments until the dispute is resolved.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            Go Home
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── LOADED ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const inv = pageState.invoice;
  const secondsLeft = getSecondsRemaining(inv);
  const isDisputed = inv.status === InvoiceStatus.Disputed;
  const alreadyApproved = inv.clientApproved;
  const amountValue = fromSmallestUnit(inv.amountPaid || inv.amount, inv.tokenType);
  const symbol = inv.tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 'USDC' : 'SOL';
  const decimals = inv.tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 2 : 4;
  const amountWhole = Math.floor(amountValue);
  const amountFrac = (amountValue - amountWhole).toFixed(decimals).slice(1);

  return (
    <div style={cardStyle}>
      {/* Invoice amount */}
      <div className="mb-6">
        <p
          className="uppercase tracking-widest mb-2"
          style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', letterSpacing: '0.08em' }}
        >
          Release amount
        </p>
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: '3.5rem',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
              lineHeight: 1,
            }}
          >
            {amountWhole}
          </span>
          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: '2rem',
              color: '#94A3B8',
              letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
              lineHeight: 1,
            }}
          >
            {amountFrac}
          </span>
          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              fontWeight: 500,
              fontSize: '1rem',
              color: '#64748B',
              marginLeft: '4px',
            }}
          >
            {symbol}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Divider */}
      <div className="mb-5" style={{ height: '1px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }} />

      {/* Invoice details */}
      <div className="space-y-3 mb-5">
        <div>
          <p style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.08em', marginBottom: '3px' }}>Invoice ID</p>
          <p style={{ fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace', fontSize: '12px', color: '#94A3B8' }}>{invoiceId}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Countdown timer */}
      {secondsLeft > 0 && !isDisputed && !alreadyApproved && (
        <div
          className="rounded-lg p-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 mb-5"
          style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}
        >
          <Clock className="h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: '#94A3B8' }} />
          <div>
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 500, color: '#F8FAFC' }}>
              {formatCountdown(secondsLeft)}
            </p>
            <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', color: '#64748B' }}>
              Funds auto-release if you take no action
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Already approved */}
      {alreadyApproved && (
        <div
          className="rounded-lg p-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 mb-5"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2)' }}
        >
          <Check className="h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: '#22C55E' }} />
          <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', color: '#4ADE80' }}>
            You've already approved this release
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Disputed */}
      {isDisputed && (
        <div
          className="rounded-lg p-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 mb-5"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.2)' }}
        >
          <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: '#F59E0B' }} />
          <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '13px', color: '#FCD34D' }}>
            This invoice is disputed — funds are frozen
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Action buttons */}
      {!alreadyApproved && !isDisputed && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {!connected && (
            <p
              className="text-center text-sm mb-2"
              style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}
            >
              Connect your wallet to approve or dispute this release.
            </p>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={handleApprove}
            disabled={approving || disputing || !connected}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg py-3.5 text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF',
              color: '#0D1117',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              border: 'none',
              cursor: approving || !connected ? 'default' : 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {approving
              ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />Approving...</>
              : <><Check className="h-4 w-4" />Approve Release</>}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={handleDispute}
            disabled={approving || disputing || !connected}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-150 hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-50"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              border: '1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.3)',
              color: '#FCD34D',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              cursor: disputing || !connected ? 'default' : 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {disputing
              ? <><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />Raising dispute...</>
              : <><AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />Raise Dispute</>}
          </button>

          <p
            className="text-center"
            style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '11px', lineHeight: 1.5 }}
          >
            Raising a dispute freezes all funds until the platform resolves the case.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ApproveRelease;

// ── preserved exactly ──────────────────────────────────────────
function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (!error) return 'Unknown error';
  if (typeof error === 'string') return error;
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message || 'An error occurred';
  if (typeof error === 'object') {
    const obj = error as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof obj.message === 'string') return obj.message;
    if (typeof obj.msg === 'string') return obj.msg;
    if (typeof obj.error === 'string') return obj.error;
    try {
      const str = JSON.stringify(error);
      if (str && str !== '{}') return str.length > 150 ? str.substring(0, 150) + '...' : str;
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return 'An error occurred';
}

const DarkInput = (props: React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>) => {
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  return (
    <input
      {...props}
      style={{
        ...inputStyle,
        borderColor: focused ? 'rgba(45,212,191,0.3)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
        boxShadow: focused ? '0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,0.08)' : 'none',
      }}
      onFocus={() => setFocused(true)}
      onBlur={() => setFocused(false)}
    />
  );
};

const DarkTextarea = (props: React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  return (
    <textarea
      {...props}

      }}

      onBlur={() => setFocused(false)}

  );

const CreateInvoiceForm: React.FC = () => {
  const { connection } = useConnection();
  const { authenticated, getAccessToken } = usePrivy();
  const { activeWallet: privyWallet } = useActiveWallet();
  const publicKey = useMemo(
    () => (privyWallet?.address ? new PublicKey(privyWallet.address) : null),
    [privyWallet?.address],
  );
  const connected = authenticated && !!publicKey;
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { signAndSendTransaction } = useSignAndSendTransaction();

  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [clientEmail, setClientEmail] = useState('');
  const [senderName, setSenderName] = useState('');
  const [tokenType, setTokenType] = useState<TokenType>(TokenType.USDC);
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [createdInvoice, setCreatedInvoice] = useState<{
    invoiceId: string;
    signature: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // ── profile auto-fill ──────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authenticated) return;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const token = await getAccessToken();
        const res = await fetch('/api/profile', {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json() as { display_name: string | null; default_token: string };
          if (data.display_name) setSenderName(data.display_name);
          if (data.default_token === 'SOL') setTokenType(TokenType.SOL);
        }
      } catch { /* non-blocking */ }
    })();
  }, [authenticated, getAccessToken]);

  // ── SDK init — preserved exactly ───────────────────────────────
  const sdk = useMemo(() => {
    if (!publicKey || !privyWallet) return null;
    const anchorWallet = createPrivySolanaAnchorWallet(privyWallet, publicKey);
    const provider = new AnchorProvider(connection, anchorWallet, { commitment: 'confirmed' });
    const sponsorFn = async (tx: Uint8Array): Promise<string> => {
      return sendSponsoredSolanaTransaction(signAndSendTransaction, privyWallet, tx);
    };
    const instance = new EscrowPaySDK(provider, false, sponsorFn);
    if (!instance.isInitialized()) {
      console.error('SDK failed to initialize:', instance.getInitError());
    }
    return instance;
  }, [connection, publicKey, privyWallet, signAndSendTransaction]);

  // ── submit — preserved exactly ──────────────────────────────────
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!sdk || !connected || !publicKey) {
      toast({ title: 'Wallet not connected', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }
    if (!sdk.isInitialized()) {
      toast({ title: 'SDK not initialized', description: sdk.getInitError() || 'Please try again', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }

    const amountNum = parseFloat(amount);
    if (isNaN(amountNum) || amountNum <= 0) {
      toast({ title: 'Enter a valid amount', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }
    if (!description.trim()) {
      toast({ title: 'Description required', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }
    if (!clientEmail.trim() || !clientEmail.includes('@')) {
      toast({ title: 'Valid email required', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }

    setIsCreating(true);

    try {
      const invoiceId = sdk.generateInvoiceId();

      const result = await sdk.createInvoice({
        invoiceId,
        amount: amountNum,
        tokenType,
      });

      if (result.success && result.data) {
        const invoiceUrl = `${window.location.origin}/invoice/${result.data.invoiceId}/${publicKey?.toBase58()}`;

        setCreatedInvoice({
          invoiceId: result.data.invoiceId,
          signature: result.data.signature,
        });
        toast({ title: 'Invoice ready to send' });

        try {
          const token = await getAccessToken();
          await fetch('/api/create-invoice-meta', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              invoiceId: result.data.invoiceId,
              creatorWallet: publicKey?.toBase58(),
              clientEmail: clientEmail.trim(),
              senderName: senderName.trim(),
              description: description.trim(),
              tokenType: tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 'USDC' : 'SOL',
              amount: amountNum,
              invoiceUrl,
            }),
          });
          toast({ title: 'Invoice ready to send', description: `Payment link sent to ${clientEmail.trim()}` });
        } catch {
          toast({ title: 'Invoice ready to send', description: 'Copy the link below to share with your client.' });
        }
      } else {
        const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(result.error);
        console.log('Create invoice failed:', errorMsg);
        toast({ title: 'Failed', description: errorMsg, variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.error('Create invoice exception:', error);
      const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
      let displayMsg = errorMsg;
      if (errorMsg.includes('User rejected') || errorMsg.includes('rejected the request')) {
        displayMsg = 'Transaction cancelled.';
      } else if (errorMsg.toLowerCase().includes('insufficient')) {
        displayMsg = 'Insufficient balance.';
      }
      toast({ title: 'Something went wrong — try again', description: displayMsg, variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setIsCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const invoiceUrl = createdInvoice
    ? `${window.location.origin}/invoice/${createdInvoice.invoiceId}/${publicKey?.toBase58()}`
    : '';

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(invoiceUrl);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'Failed to copy', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
  };

  // ── not connected ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!connected) {
    return (
      <div
        className="w-full rounded-xl p-12 text-center"
        style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' }}
      >
        <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>
          Connect to continue — then create your first escrow invoice.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── success state ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (createdInvoice) {
    return (
      <div
        className="w-full rounded-xl p-8"
        style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' }}
      >
        <div className="text-center mb-7">
          <div
            className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,212,191,0.1)' }}
          >
            <Check className="h-7 w-7" style={{ color: '#2DD4BF' }} />
          </div>
          <h3
            style={{
              fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: '1.375rem',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              letterSpacing: '-0.01em',
              marginBottom: '6px',
            }}
          >
            Invoice ready to send
          </h3>
          <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px' }}>
            Share this link with your client to lock funds in escrow.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Invoice ID */}
          <div className="rounded-lg p-4" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}>
            <p style={labelStyle}>Invoice ID</p>
            <p
              style={{
                fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace',
                fontSize: '13px',
                color: '#F8FAFC',
                letterSpacing: '0.02em',
              }}
            >
              {createdInvoice.invoiceId}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Payment link */}
          <div className="rounded-lg p-4" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}>
            <p style={labelStyle}>Payment Link</p>
            <p
              className="break-all mb-3"
              style={{
                fontFamily: '"JetBrains Mono", monospace',
                fontSize: '11px',
                color: '#94A3B8',
                lineHeight: 1.6,
              }}
            >
              {invoiceUrl}
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={handleCopy}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-90"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF',
                color: '#0D1117',
                fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                border: 'none',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />}
              {copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy Link'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Explorer link */}
          <a
            href={getSolanaExplorerTxUrl(createdInvoice.signature)}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-70"
            style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', textDecoration: 'none' }}
          >
            View on Solana Explorer
            <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
          </a>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3 mt-7">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setCreatedInvoice(null);
              setAmount('');
              setDescription('');
              setClientEmail('');
              setSenderName('');
            }}
            className="flex-1 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
              color: '#F8FAFC',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            Create Another
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')}
            className="flex-1 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-90"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF',
              color: '#0D1117',
              fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
              border: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            Open Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── form ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <div
      className="w-full rounded-xl p-8"
      style={{ backgroundColor: '#161B22', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-7">
        <h2
          style={{
            fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif',
            fontWeight: 700,
            fontSize: '1.5rem',
            color: '#F8FAFC',
            letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
            marginBottom: '6px',
          }}
        >
          New Invoice
        </h2>
        <p style={{ color: '#94A3B8', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '14px' }}>
          Funds lock on-chain when your client pays.
        </p>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-5">
        {/* Token selector */}
        <div>
          <label style={labelStyle}>Token</label>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {([TokenType.USDC, TokenType.SOL] as const).map((t) => {
              const active = tokenType === t;
              const label = t === TokenType.USDC ? 'USDC' : 'SOL';
              return (
                <button
                  key={t}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTokenType(t)}
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-150"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: active ? 'rgba(45,212,191,0.1)' : '#1C2128',
                    border: active ? '1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.3)' : '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
                    color: active ? '#2DD4BF' : '#94A3B8',
                    fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Amount */}
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="amount" style={labelStyle}>
            Amount ({tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 'USDC' : 'SOL'})
          </label>
          <DarkInput
            id="amount"
            type="number"
            step={tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? '0.01' : '0.0001'}
            min="0"
            placeholder="0.00"
            value={amount}
            onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Sender name */}
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="senderName" style={labelStyle}>Your name or company</label>
          <DarkInput
            id="senderName"
            type="text"
            placeholder="e.g. Kenny Fafimiye or Truvlo Studio"
            value={senderName}
            onChange={(e) => setSenderName(e.target.value)}
          />
          <p
            className="mt-1.5"
            style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px' }}
          >
            Shown to the client so they know who sent the invoice
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Client email */}
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="email" style={labelStyle}>Client Email</label>
          <DarkInput
            id="email"
            type="email"
            placeholder="client@company.com"
            value={clientEmail}
            onChange={(e) => setClientEmail(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Description */}
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="description" style={labelStyle}>Description</label>
          <DarkTextarea
            id="description"
            placeholder="Describe the work or services..."
            value={description}
            onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Fee info */}
        <div
          className="rounded-lg p-3.5"
          style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128' }}
        >
          <p style={{ color: '#64748B', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', fontSize: '12px', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
            You receive 100% of the invoice amount. Your client pays a 1% platform fee (flat $2 below $200).
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Submit */}
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={isCreating}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-opacity duration-150 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-60"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF',
            color: '#0D1117',
            fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
            border: 'none',
            cursor: isCreating ? 'default' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          {isCreating ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              Creating...
            </>
          ) : (
            'Create Invoice'
          )}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CreateInvoiceForm;

interface InvoiceWithKey {
  publicKey: PublicKey;
  account: InvoiceData;
}

type AmountLike =

  | number
  | string
  | bigint
  | { toNumber?: () => number; toString?: () => string }
  | null
  | undefined;

function formatCountdown(seconds: number): string {
  if (seconds <= 0) return 'Auto-releasing soon';
  const days = Math.floor(seconds / 86400);
  const hours = Math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600);
  const mins = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
  if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${hours}h remaining`;
  if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${mins}m remaining`;
  return `${mins}m remaining`;
}

const DarkBadge = ({
  children,
  variant,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  variant: 'orange' | 'blue' | 'green' | 'amber' | 'default';
}) => {
  const styles: Record<string, { bg: string; color: string }> = {
    orange: { bg: 'rgba(249,115,22,0.1)', color: '#FB923C' },
    blue: { bg: 'rgba(59,130,246,0.1)', color: '#93C5FD' },
    green: { bg: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)', color: '#4ADE80' },
    amber: { bg: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.1)', color: '#FCD34D' },
    default: { bg: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', color: '#94A3B8' },
  };
  const s = styles[variant] ?? styles.default;
  return (
    <span
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: s.bg,
        color: s.color,
        fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
};
