FILE: src\components\ui\form.tsx
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import * as LabelPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-label"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import {
  Controller,
  ControllerProps,
  FieldPath,
  FieldValues,
  FormProvider,
  useFormContext,
} from "react-hook-form"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"

const Form = FormProvider

type FormFieldContextValue<
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>
> = {
  name: TName
}

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue>(
  {} as FormFieldContextValue
)

const FormField = <
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>
>({
  ...props
}: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
  return (
    <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>
  )
}

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext)
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext)
  const { getFieldState, formState } = useFormContext()

  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState)

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>")
  }

  const { id } = itemContext

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  }
}

type FormItemContextValue = {
  id: string
}

const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue>(
  {} as FormItemContextValue
)

const FormItem = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const id = React.useId()

  return (
    <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
      <div ref={ref} className={cn("space-y-2", className)} {...props} />
    </FormItemContext.Provider>
  )
})
FormItem.displayName = "FormItem"

const FormLabel = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Label
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(error && "text-destructive", className)}
      htmlFor={formItemId}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormLabel.displayName = "FormLabel"

const FormControl = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof Slot>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Slot>
>(({ ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Slot
      ref={ref}
      id={formItemId}
      aria-describedby={
        !error
          ? `${formDescriptionId}`
          : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
      }
      aria-invalid={!!error}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormControl.displayName = "FormControl"

const FormDescription = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <p
      ref={ref}
      id={formDescriptionId}
      className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormDescription.displayName = "FormDescription"

const FormMessage = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField()
  const body = error ? String(error?.message) : children

  if (!body) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <p
      ref={ref}
      id={formMessageId}
      className={cn("text-sm font-medium text-destructive", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {body}
    </p>
  )
})
FormMessage.displayName = "FormMessage"

export {
  useFormField,
  Form,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormMessage,
  FormField,
}

  <div ref={ref} className={cn("flex items-center", className)} {...props} />

InputOTPGroup.displayName = "InputOTPGroup"

const InputOTPSlot = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<"div">,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"div"> & { index: number }
>(({ index, className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const inputOTPContext = React.useContext(OTPInputContext)
  const { char, hasFakeCaret, isActive } = inputOTPContext.slots[index]

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        "relative flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center border-y border-r border-input text-sm transition-all first:rounded-l-md first:border-l last:rounded-r-md",
        isActive && "z-10 ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-background",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {char}
      {hasFakeCaret && (
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">

      "relative flex w-px items-center justify-center bg-border after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:left-1/2 after:w-1 after:-translate-x-1/2 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 data-[panel-group-direction=vertical]:h-px data-[panel-group-direction=vertical]:w-full data-[panel-group-direction=vertical]:after:left-0 data-[panel-group-direction=vertical]:after:h-1 data-[panel-group-direction=vertical]:after:w-full data-[panel-group-direction=vertical]:after:-translate-y-1/2 data-[panel-group-direction=vertical]:after:translate-x-0 [&[data-panel-group-direction=vertical]>div]:rotate-90",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  >
    {withHandle && (
      <div className="z-10 flex h-4 w-3 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border bg-border">
        <GripVertical className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
      </div>
    )}
  </ResizablePrimitive.PanelResizeHandle>
)

FILE: src\components\ui\sidebar.tsx
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import { VariantProps, cva } from "class-variance-authority"
import { PanelLeft } from "lucide-react"

import { useIsMobile } from "@/hooks/use-mobile"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar:state"
const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem"
const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b"

type SidebarContext = {
  state: "expanded" | "collapsed"
  open: boolean
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void
  openMobile: boolean
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void
  isMobile: boolean
  toggleSidebar: () => void
}

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContext | null>(null)

function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.")
  }

  return context
}

const SidebarProvider = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    defaultOpen?: boolean
    open?: boolean
    onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  }
>(
  (
    {
      defaultOpen = true,
      open: openProp,
      onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
      className,
      style,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const isMobile = useIsMobile()
    const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false)

    // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
    // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
    const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)
    const open = openProp ?? _open
    const setOpen = React.useCallback(
      (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
        const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value
        if (setOpenProp) {
          setOpenProp(openState)
        } else {
          _setOpen(openState)
        }

        // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
        document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`
      },
      [setOpenProp, open]
    )

    // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
    const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
      return isMobile
        ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open)
        : setOpen((open) => !open)
    }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])

    // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
    React.useEffect(() => {
      const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (
          event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
          (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
        ) {
          event.preventDefault()
          toggleSidebar()
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
      return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
    }, [toggleSidebar])

    // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
    // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
    const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"

    const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContext>(
      () => ({
        state,
        open,
        setOpen,
        isMobile,
        openMobile,
        setOpenMobile,
        toggleSidebar,
      }),
      [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar]
    )

    return (
      <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
        <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
          <div
            style={
              {
                "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
                "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
                ...style,
              } as React.CSSProperties
            }
            className={cn(
              "group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full has-[[data-variant=inset]]:bg-sidebar",
              className
            )}
            ref={ref}
            {...props}
          >
            {children}
          </div>
        </TooltipProvider>
      </SidebarContext.Provider>
    )
  }
)
SidebarProvider.displayName = "SidebarProvider"

const Sidebar = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    side?: "left" | "right"
    variant?: "sidebar" | "floating" | "inset"
    collapsible?: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none"
  }
>(
  (
    {
      side = "left",
      variant = "sidebar",
      collapsible = "offcanvas",
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar()

    if (collapsible === "none") {
      return (
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex h-full w-[--sidebar-width] flex-col bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground",
            className
          )}
          ref={ref}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      )
    }

    if (isMobile) {
      return (
        <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
          <SheetContent
            data-sidebar="sidebar"
            data-mobile="true"
            className="w-[--sidebar-width] bg-sidebar p-0 text-sidebar-foreground [&>button]:hidden"
            style={
              {
                "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE,
              } as React.CSSProperties
            }
            side={side}
          >
            <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      )
    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className="group peer hidden md:block text-sidebar-foreground"
        data-state={state}
        data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
        data-variant={variant}
        data-side={side}
      >
        {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}
        <div
          className={cn(
            "duration-200 relative h-svh w-[--sidebar-width] bg-transparent transition-[width] ease-linear",
            "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",
            "group-data-[side=right]:rotate-180",
            variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
              ? "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)_+_theme(spacing.4))]"
              : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[--sidebar-width-icon]"
          )}
        />
        <div
          className={cn(
            "duration-200 fixed inset-y-0 z-10 hidden h-svh w-[--sidebar-width] transition-[left,right,width] ease-linear md:flex",
            side === "left"
              ? "left-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]"
              : "right-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]",
            // Adjust the padding for floating and inset variants.
            variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
              ? "p-2 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)_+_theme(spacing.4)_+2px)]"
              : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[--sidebar-width-icon] group-data-[side=left]:border-r group-data-[side=right]:border-l",
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          <div
            data-sidebar="sidebar"
            className="flex h-full w-full flex-col bg-sidebar group-data-[variant=floating]:rounded-lg group-data-[variant=floating]:border group-data-[variant=floating]:border-sidebar-border group-data-[variant=floating]:shadow"
          >
            {children}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
)
Sidebar.displayName = "Sidebar"

const SidebarTrigger = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof Button>,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>
>(({ className, onClick, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar()

  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      data-sidebar="trigger"
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      className={cn("h-7 w-7", className)}
      onClick={(event) => {
        onClick?.(event)
        toggleSidebar()
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <PanelLeft />
      <span className="sr-only">Toggle Sidebar</span>
    </Button>
  )
})
SidebarTrigger.displayName = "SidebarTrigger"

const SidebarRail = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"button">
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar()

  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      data-sidebar="rail"
      aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
      tabIndex={-1}
      onClick={toggleSidebar}
      title="Toggle Sidebar"
      className={cn(
        "absolute inset-y-0 z-20 hidden w-4 -translate-x-1/2 transition-all ease-linear after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:left-1/2 after:w-[2px] hover:after:bg-sidebar-border group-data-[side=left]:-right-4 group-data-[side=right]:left-0 sm:flex",
        "[[data-side=left]_&]:cursor-w-resize [[data-side=right]_&]:cursor-e-resize",
        "[[data-side=left][data-state=collapsed]_&]:cursor-e-resize [[data-side=right][data-state=collapsed]_&]:cursor-w-resize",
        "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:translate-x-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:after:left-full group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:hover:bg-sidebar",
        "[[data-side=left][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-right-2",
        "[[data-side=right][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-left-2",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
SidebarRail.displayName = "SidebarRail"

const SidebarInset = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"main">
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  return (
    <main
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(

const sidebarMenuButtonVariants = cva(
  "peer/menu-button flex w-full items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-md p-2 text-left text-sm outline-none ring-sidebar-ring transition-[width,height,padding] hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 active:bg-sidebar-accent active:text-sidebar-accent-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 group-has-[[data-sidebar=menu-action]]/menu-item:pr-8 aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 data-[active=true]:bg-sidebar-accent data-[active=true]:font-medium data-[active=true]:text-sidebar-accent-foreground data-[state=open]:hover:bg-sidebar-accent data-[state=open]:hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground group-data-[collapsible=icon]:!size-8 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:!p-2 [&>span:last-child]:truncate [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground",
        outline:
          "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_hsl(var(--sidebar-border))] hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground hover:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_hsl(var(--sidebar-accent))]",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-8 text-sm",
        sm: "h-7 text-xs",
        lg: "h-12 text-sm group-data-[collapsible=icon]:!p-0",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

const SidebarMenuButton = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
    asChild?: boolean
    isActive?: boolean
    tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>
  } & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>
>(
  (
    {
      asChild = false,
      isActive = false,
      variant = "default",
      size = "default",
      tooltip,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"
    const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar()

    const button = (
      <Comp
        ref={ref}
        data-sidebar="menu-button"
        data-size={size}
        data-active={isActive}
        className={cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
        {...props}
      />
    )

    if (!tooltip) {
      return button
    }

    if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
      tooltip = {
        children: tooltip,
      }
    }

    return (
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
        <TooltipContent
          side="right"
          align="center"
          hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}
          {...tooltip}
        />
      </Tooltip>
    )
  }
)
SidebarMenuButton.displayName = "SidebarMenuButton"

  "group pointer-events-auto relative flex w-full items-center justify-between space-x-4 overflow-hidden rounded-md border p-6 pr-8 shadow-lg transition-all data-[swipe=cancel]:translate-x-0 data-[swipe=end]:translate-x-[var(--radix-toast-swipe-end-x)] data-[swipe=move]:translate-x-[var(--radix-toast-swipe-move-x)] data-[swipe=move]:transition-none data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[swipe=end]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-80 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-right-full data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top-full data-[state=open]:sm:slide-in-from-bottom-full",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "border bg-background text-foreground",
        destructive:
          "destructive group border-destructive bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

const Toast = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Root> &
    VariantProps<typeof toastVariants>
>(({ className, variant, ...props }, ref) => {
  return (
    <ToastPrimitives.Root
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(toastVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
Toast.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Root.displayName

>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (

    ref={ref}

      "inline-flex h-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-colors hover:bg-secondary focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 group-[.destructive]:border-muted/40 group-[.destructive]:hover:border-destructive/30 group-[.destructive]:hover:bg-destructive group-[.destructive]:hover:text-destructive-foreground group-[.destructive]:focus:ring-destructive",
      className

"use client"

import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast"
import {
  Toast,
  ToastClose,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastProvider,
  ToastTitle,
  ToastViewport,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

export function Toaster() {
  const { toasts } = useToast()

  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      {toasts.map(function ({ id, title, description, action, ...props }) {
        return (
          <Toast key={id} {...props}>
            <div className="grid gap-1">
              {title && <ToastTitle>{title}</ToastTitle>}
              {description && (
                <ToastDescription>{description}</ToastDescription>
              )}
            </div>
            {action}
            <ToastClose />
          </Toast>
        )
      })}
      <ToastViewport />
    </ToastProvider>
  )
}

FILE: src\contexts\ActiveWalletContext.tsx
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useWallets as useSolanaWallets } from '@privy-io/react-auth/solana';

// Type from Privy — a connected Solana wallet object
type ConnectedSolanaWallet = ReturnType<typeof useSolanaWallets>['wallets'][number];

interface ActiveWalletContextValue {
  activeWallet: ConnectedSolanaWallet | null;
  allWallets: ConnectedSolanaWallet[];
  setActiveWallet: (wallet: ConnectedSolanaWallet) => void;
}

const ActiveWalletContext = createContext<ActiveWalletContextValue>({
  activeWallet: null,
  allWallets: [],
  setActiveWallet: () => {},
});

const STORAGE_KEY = 'escrowpay_active_wallet';

export const ActiveWalletProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const { wallets } = useSolanaWallets();
  const [activeWallet, setActiveWalletState] = useState<ConnectedSolanaWallet | null>(null);

  // When wallets array changes (new wallet created/imported or on initial load),
  // restore saved selection or fall back to wallets[0]
  useEffect(() => {
    if (wallets.length === 0) {
      setActiveWalletState(null);
      return;
    }
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    const match = saved ? wallets.find(w => w.address === saved) : null;
    setActiveWalletState(match ?? wallets[0]);
  }, [wallets]);

  const setActiveWallet = useCallback((wallet: ConnectedSolanaWallet) => {
    setActiveWalletState(wallet);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, wallet.address);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ActiveWalletContext.Provider value={{ activeWallet, allWallets: wallets, setActiveWallet }}>
      {children}
    </ActiveWalletContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useActiveWallet = () => useContext(ActiveWalletContext);

FILE: src\hooks\use-mobile.tsx
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

FILE: src\hooks\use-toast.ts
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"use client"

// Inspired by react-hot-toast library
import * as React from "react"

import type {
  ToastActionElement,
  ToastProps,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string
  title?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
  action?: ToastActionElement
}

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const

let count = 0

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  return count.toString()
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes

type Action =
  | {
      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"]
      toast: ToasterToast
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"]
      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"]
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"]
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
    }

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[]
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId)
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    })
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY)

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout)
}

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      }

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      }

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId)
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id)
        })
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false,
              }
            : t
        ),
      }
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        }
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      }
  }
}

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = []

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] }

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action)
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState)
  })
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId()

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    })
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id })

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss()
      },
    },
  })

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  }
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState)
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState)
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1)
      }
    }
  }, [state])

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  }
}

export { useToast, toast }

/**

 */

export enum TokenType {
  USDC = 0,
  SOL = 1,
}

export enum InvoiceStatus {
  Unpaid = 0,
  PartiallyPaid = 1,
  FullyPaid = 2,
  Released = 3,
  Disputed = 4,
}

export interface InvoiceData {
  bump: number;
  escrowBump: number;
  invoiceId: string;
  creator: PublicKey;
  client: PublicKey | null;
  amount: BN;
  amountPaid: BN;
  amountReleased: BN;
  tokenType: TokenType;
  status: InvoiceStatus;
  createdAt: BN;
  paidAt: BN | null;
  releasedAt: BN | null;
  releaseSchedule: number[];
  currentReleaseIndex: number;
  completionRequestedAt: BN | null;
  clientApproved: boolean;
  disputeRaisedAt: BN | null;
  verdictHash: number[] | null;
}

export interface CreateInvoiceParams {
  invoiceId: string;
  amount: number;
  tokenType: TokenType;
}

export interface PaymentBreakdown {
  invoiceAmount: number;
  platformFee: number;
  totalPayable: number;
  feePercentage: number;
}

export interface SDKResult<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
}

export type SponsorFn = (tx: Uint8Array) => Promise<string>;

function safeStringify(obj: any): string {
  if (obj === null) return 'null';
  if (obj === undefined) return 'undefined';
  if (typeof obj === 'string') return obj;
  if (typeof obj === 'number' || typeof obj === 'boolean') return String(obj);
  try {
    if (obj instanceof Error) {
      return obj.message || obj.toString() || 'Error';
    }
    if (obj.message && typeof obj.message === 'string') {
      return obj.message;
    }
    const seen = new WeakSet();
    const str = JSON.stringify(obj, (key, value) => {
      if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
        if (seen.has(value)) return '[Circular]';
        seen.add(value);
      }
      return value;
    });
    if (str && str !== '{}' && str !== '[]') {
      return str.length > 300 ? str.substring(0, 300) + '...' : str;
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
  try {
    return String(obj);
  } catch {
    return 'Unknown error';
  }
}

export class EscrowPaySDK {
  private readonly provider: Provider;
  private program: Program<Idl> | null = null;
  private readonly usdcMint: PublicKey;
  private readonly programId: PublicKey;
  private coder: BorshCoder | null = null;
  private initialized: boolean = false;
  private initError: string | null = null;
  private readonly sponsorFn: SponsorFn | null;

  constructor(provider: Provider, useMainnet: boolean = false, sponsorFn: SponsorFn | null = null) {
    this.provider = provider;
    this.programId = PROGRAM_ID;
    this.usdcMint = useMainnet ? USDC_MINT_MAINNET : USDC_MINT_DEVNET;
    this.sponsorFn = sponsorFn;
    try {
      this.program = new Program(IDL as Idl, this.provider);
      this.coder = new BorshCoder(IDL as Idl);
      this.initialized = true;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to initialize Anchor program:', e);
      this.initError = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to initialize program';
      this.initialized = false;
    }
  }

  isInitialized(): boolean {
    return this.initialized;
  }

  private withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> {
    return Promise.race([
      promise,
      new Promise<T>((_, reject) =>
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`rpc_timeout_${ms}`)), ms)
      ),
    ]);
  }

  getInitError(): string | null {
    return this.initError;
  }

  private decodeInvoiceAccount(data: Buffer): any {
    if (!this.coder) return null;
    try {
      return this.coder.accounts.decode('Invoice', data);
    } catch {
      try {
        return this.coder.accounts.decode('invoice', data);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

  private parseInvoiceData(raw: any): InvoiceData | null {
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
      let tokenType = TokenType.USDC;
      const tt = raw.tokenType ?? raw.token_type;
      if (typeof tt === 'number' || typeof tt === 'bigint') {
        tokenType = Number(tt) === 1 ? TokenType.SOL : TokenType.USDC;
      } else if (tt?.SOL !== undefined || tt?.sol !== undefined) {
        tokenType = TokenType.SOL;
      }

      let status = InvoiceStatus.Unpaid;
      const rawStatus = raw.status || {};
      if (rawStatus.PartiallyPaid !== undefined || rawStatus.partiallyPaid !== undefined || rawStatus.partially_paid !== undefined) {
        status = InvoiceStatus.PartiallyPaid;
      } else if (rawStatus.FullyPaid !== undefined || rawStatus.fullyPaid !== undefined || rawStatus.fully_paid !== undefined) {
        status = InvoiceStatus.FullyPaid;
      } else if (rawStatus.Released !== undefined || rawStatus.released !== undefined) {
        status = InvoiceStatus.Released;
      } else if (rawStatus.Disputed !== undefined || rawStatus.disputed !== undefined) {
        status = InvoiceStatus.Disputed;
      }

      return {
        bump: raw.bump,
        escrowBump: raw.escrowBump ?? raw.escrow_bump ?? 0,
        invoiceId: raw.invoiceId ?? raw.invoice_id ?? '',
        creator: raw.creator,
        client: raw.client,
        amount: raw.amount,
        amountPaid: raw.amountPaid ?? raw.amount_paid ?? new BN(0),
        amountReleased: raw.amountReleased ?? raw.amount_released ?? new BN(0),
        tokenType,
        status,
        createdAt: raw.createdAt ?? raw.created_at ?? new BN(0),
        paidAt: raw.paidAt ?? raw.paid_at ?? null,
        releasedAt: raw.releasedAt ?? raw.released_at ?? null,
        releaseSchedule: raw.releaseSchedule ?? raw.release_schedule ?? [],
        currentReleaseIndex: raw.currentReleaseIndex ?? raw.current_release_index ?? 0,
        completionRequestedAt: raw.completionRequestedAt ?? raw.completion_requested_at ?? null,
        clientApproved: raw.clientApproved ?? raw.client_approved ?? false,
        disputeRaisedAt: raw.disputeRaisedAt ?? raw.dispute_raised_at ?? null,
        verdictHash: raw.verdictHash ?? raw.verdict_hash ?? null,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to parse invoice data:', e);
      return null;
    }
  }

  calculatePaymentBreakdown(paymentAmount: number, tokenType: TokenType, solPriceUsd?: number): PaymentBreakdown {
    let platformFee: number;
    let feePercentage: number;
    if (tokenType === TokenType.USDC) {
      if (paymentAmount < PLATFORM_FEE_THRESHOLD_USD) {
        platformFee = PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD;
        feePercentage = (PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD / paymentAmount) * 100;
      } else {
        platformFee = paymentAmount * (PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000);
        feePercentage = PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 100;
      }
    } else {
      if (solPriceUsd && solPriceUsd > 0) {
        const valueUsd = paymentAmount * solPriceUsd;
        if (valueUsd < PLATFORM_FEE_THRESHOLD_USD) {
          platformFee = PLATFORM_FLAT_FEE_USD / solPriceUsd;
          feePercentage = (platformFee / paymentAmount) * 100;
        } else {
          platformFee = paymentAmount * (PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000);
          feePercentage = PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 100;
        }
      } else {
        platformFee = paymentAmount * (PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 10000);
        feePercentage = PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / 100;
      }
    }
    const totalPayable = paymentAmount + platformFee;
    return {
      invoiceAmount: paymentAmount,
      platformFee: parseFloat(platformFee.toFixed(tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 6 : 9)),
      totalPayable: parseFloat(totalPayable.toFixed(tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 6 : 9)),
      feePercentage,
    };
  }

  private toSmallestUnit(amount: number, tokenType: TokenType): BN {
    const decimals = tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 6 : 9;
    const amountStr = amount.toFixed(decimals);
    const [intPart, fracPart = ''] = amountStr.split('.');
    const paddedFrac = fracPart.padEnd(decimals, '0').slice(0, decimals);
    const smallestUnit = BigInt(intPart) * BigInt(10 ** decimals) + BigInt(paddedFrac);
    return new BN(smallestUnit.toString());
  }

  private fromSmallestUnit(amount: BN, tokenType: TokenType): number {
    const decimals = tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 6 : 9;
    try {
      return amount.toNumber() / Math.pow(10, decimals);
    } catch {
      return parseInt(amount.toString()) / Math.pow(10, decimals);
    }
  }

  private async testConnection(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      if (!this.provider?.connection) return false;
      const timeout = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('connection timeout')), 5_000)
      );
      const { value } = await Promise.race([
        this.provider.connection.getLatestBlockhashAndContext('finalized'),
        timeout,
      ]);
      return !!(value && value.blockhash);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private parseError(error: any): string {
    if (!error) return 'Unknown error occurred.';
    if (typeof error === 'string') return error;
    let message = '';
    try {
      message = error.message || error.msg || '';
      if (typeof message !== 'string') message = safeStringify(message);
    } catch { message = ''; }
    let errorStr = '';
    try {
      errorStr = typeof error.toString === 'function' ? error.toString() : '';
      if (errorStr === '[object Object]') errorStr = '';
    } catch { errorStr = ''; }
    if (message.includes('User rejected') || message.includes('rejected the request') ||
        errorStr.includes('User rejected') || errorStr.includes('rejected the request')) {
      return 'Transaction was cancelled.';
    }
    if (message.toLowerCase().includes('insufficient') ||
        errorStr.toLowerCase().includes('insufficient') ||
        message.includes('no record of a prior credit') ||
        errorStr.includes('no record of a prior credit') ||
        message.includes('Attempt to debit an account') ||
        errorStr.includes('Attempt to debit an account')) {
      return 'Insufficient SOL balance. Please add SOL to your wallet for transaction fees.';
    }
    if (message.includes('Simulation failed') || errorStr.includes('Simulation failed')) {
      if (message.includes('no record of a prior credit') || message.includes('Attempt to debit')) {
        return 'Insufficient SOL balance. Please add SOL to your wallet for transaction fees.';
      }
      if (message.includes('custom program error')) {
        const match = message.match(/custom program error: (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)/);
        if (match) return `Program error: ${match[1]}`;
      }
      return 'Transaction simulation failed. Please try again.';
    }
    try {
      if (error.error?.errorCode?.code) {
        const msg = error.error.errorMessage || error.error.errorCode.name;
        if (msg && typeof msg === 'string') return msg;
        return 'Program error: ' + String(error.error.errorCode.code);
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    try {
      if (error.logs && Array.isArray(error.logs)) {
        for (const log of error.logs) {
          if (typeof log === 'string') {
            if (log.includes('Error Code:')) {
              const match = log.match(/Error Code: (\w+)/);
              if (match) return 'Error: ' + match[1];
            }
            if (log.includes('Error Message:')) {
              const match = log.match(/Error Message: (.+)/);
              if (match) return match[1];
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    try {
      if (error.simulationResponse?.err) {
        const simErr = error.simulationResponse.err;
        if (typeof simErr === 'string') return simErr;
        if (simErr?.InstructionError) {
          const instErr = simErr.InstructionError[1];
          if (typeof instErr === 'string') return instErr;
          if (instErr?.Custom !== undefined) return 'Program error code: ' + String(instErr.Custom);
        }
        return 'Transaction simulation failed.';
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    if (message && message.length > 0) {
      if (message.includes('AnchorError')) {
        const match = message.match(/Error Message: ([^.]+)/);
        if (match) return match[1];
      }
      return message.length > 200 ? message.substring(0, 200) + '...' : message;
    }
    if (errorStr && errorStr.length > 0 && errorStr !== '[object Object]') {
      return errorStr.length > 200 ? errorStr.substring(0, 200) + '...' : errorStr;
    }
    return 'Transaction failed. Please try again.';
  }

  private logError(context: string, error: any): void {
    const safeError = {
      context,
      name: String(error?.name || 'Unknown'),
      message: String(error?.message || 'No message'),
      parsed: this.parseError(error),
    };
    console.error('SDK Error:', JSON.stringify(safeError, null, 2));
  }

  private async sendTx(builder: any): Promise<string> {
    if (this.sponsorFn) {
      const tx: Transaction = await builder.transaction();
      const { blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight } =
        await this.provider.connection.getLatestBlockhash('confirmed');
      tx.recentBlockhash = blockhash;
      tx.lastValidBlockHeight = lastValidBlockHeight;
      tx.feePayer = this.provider.publicKey!;
      const serialized = tx.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false, verifySignatures: false });
      return await this.sponsorFn(Uint8Array.from(serialized));
    }
    return await builder.rpc();
  }

  async getInvoicePDA(invoiceId: string, creator: PublicKey): Promise<[PublicKey, number]> {
    return PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
      [Buffer.from("invoice"), Buffer.from(invoiceId), creator.toBuffer()],
      this.programId
    );
  }

  async getEscrowPDA(invoiceId: string, creator: PublicKey): Promise<[PublicKey, number]> {
    return PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
      [Buffer.from("escrow"), Buffer.from(invoiceId), creator.toBuffer()],
      this.programId
    );
  }

  generateInvoiceId(): string {
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';
    let result = 'INV-';
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      result += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    return result;
  }

  async createInvoice(params: CreateInvoiceParams): Promise<SDKResult<{
    signature: string;
    invoiceAddress: string;
    invoiceId: string;
  }>> {
    if (!this.provider.publicKey) {
      return { success: false, error: "Wallet not connected" };
    }
    if (!this.initialized || !this.program) {
      return { success: false, error: this.initError || "SDK not initialized" };
    }
    try {
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) {
        return { success: false, error: "Network unavailable" };
      }
      const trimmedId = params.invoiceId?.trim() ?? '';
      if (!trimmedId || trimmedId.length > 32 || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(trimmedId)) {
        return { success: false, error: "Invoice ID must be 1–32 characters (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores only)" };
      }
      if (params.amount <= 0) {
        return { success: false, error: "Amount must be greater than 0" };
      }
      const [invoiceAddress] = await this.getInvoicePDA(params.invoiceId, this.provider.publicKey);
      const amountSmallestUnit = this.toSmallestUnit(params.amount, params.tokenType);
      let tx: string;
      if (params.tokenType === TokenType.SOL) {
        const builder = this.program.methods
          .initializeConfigSol(params.invoiceId, amountSmallestUnit)
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoiceAddress,
            creator: this.provider.publicKey,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          });
        tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      } else {
        const [escrowAddress] = await this.getEscrowPDA(params.invoiceId, this.provider.publicKey);
        const builder = this.program.methods
          .initializeConfig(params.invoiceId, amountSmallestUnit)
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoiceAddress,
            escrow: escrowAddress,
            usdcMint: this.usdcMint,
            creator: this.provider.publicKey,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
            rent: RENT_SYSVAR_ID,
          });
        tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      }
      return {
        success: true,
        data: {
          signature: tx,
          invoiceAddress: invoiceAddress.toString(),
          invoiceId: params.invoiceId,
        }
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('createInvoice', error);
      return { success: false, error: this.parseError(error) };
    }
  }

  async payInvoice(
    invoiceId: string,
    creatorPubkey: PublicKey,
    paymentAmount: number,
    tokenType: TokenType,
    solPriceUsd?: number
  ): Promise<SDKResult<{ signature: string; breakdown: PaymentBreakdown }>> {
    if (!this.provider.publicKey) {
      return { success: false, error: "Wallet not connected" };
    }
    if (!this.initialized || !this.program) {
      return { success: false, error: this.initError || "SDK not initialized" };
    }
    try {
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) {
        return { success: false, error: "Network unavailable" };
      }
      const [invoiceAddress] = await this.getInvoicePDA(invoiceId, creatorPubkey);
      const paymentSmallestUnit = this.toSmallestUnit(paymentAmount, tokenType);
      const resolvedSolPrice = tokenType === TokenType.SOL && !solPriceUsd
        ? await this.getSolPriceUsd()
        : solPriceUsd ?? null;
      const breakdown = this.calculatePaymentBreakdown(paymentAmount, tokenType, resolvedSolPrice ?? undefined);
      let tx: string;
      if (tokenType === TokenType.SOL) {
        const feeSmallestUnit = this.toSmallestUnit(breakdown.platformFee, TokenType.SOL);
        const builder = this.program.methods
          .payInvoiceSol(invoiceId, paymentSmallestUnit, feeSmallestUnit)
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoiceAddress,
            platformTreasury: PLATFORM_TREASURY,
            client: this.provider.publicKey,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          });
        tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      } else {
        const [escrowAddress] = await this.getEscrowPDA(invoiceId, creatorPubkey);
        const clientToken = getAssociatedTokenAddressSync(this.usdcMint, this.provider.publicKey);
        const treasuryToken = getAssociatedTokenAddressSync(this.usdcMint, PLATFORM_TREASURY);
        const builder = this.program.methods
          .payInvoice(invoiceId, paymentSmallestUnit)
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoiceAddress,
            escrow: escrowAddress,
            clientToken: clientToken,
            platformTreasuryToken: treasuryToken,
            usdcMint: this.usdcMint,
            client: this.provider.publicKey,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
          });
        tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      }
      return { success: true, data: { signature: tx, breakdown } };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('payInvoice', error);
      return { success: false, error: this.parseError(error) };
    }
  }

  async setReleaseSchedule(
    invoiceId: string,
    creatorPubkey: PublicKey,
    scheduleBps: number[]
  ): Promise<SDKResult<{ signature: string }>> {
    if (!this.provider.publicKey) return { success: false, error: 'Wallet not connected' };
    if (!this.initialized || !this.program) return { success: false, error: this.initError || 'SDK not initialized' };
    try {
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) return { success: false, error: 'Network unavailable' };
      const [invoiceAddress] = await this.getInvoicePDA(invoiceId, creatorPubkey);
      const builder = this.program.methods
        .setReleaseSchedule(invoiceId, scheduleBps)
        .accounts({ invoice: invoiceAddress, client: this.provider.publicKey });
      const tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      return { success: true, data: { signature: tx } };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('setReleaseSchedule', error);
      return { success: false, error: this.parseError(error) };
    }
  }

  async releaseFunds(
    invoiceId: string,
    releaseAmount: number,
    tokenType: TokenType
  ): Promise<SDKResult<{ signature: string }>> {
    if (!this.provider.publicKey) {
      return { success: false, error: "Wallet not connected" };
    }
    if (!this.initialized || !this.program) {
      return { success: false, error: this.initError || "SDK not initialized" };
    }
    try {
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) {
        return { success: false, error: "Network unavailable" };
      }
      const [invoiceAddress] = await this.getInvoicePDA(invoiceId, this.provider.publicKey);
      const releaseSmallestUnit = this.toSmallestUnit(releaseAmount, tokenType);
      let tx: string;
      if (tokenType === TokenType.SOL) {
        const builder = this.program.methods
          .releaseFundsSol(invoiceId, releaseSmallestUnit)
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoiceAddress,
            creator: this.provider.publicKey,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          });
        tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      } else {
        const [escrowAddress] = await this.getEscrowPDA(invoiceId, this.provider.publicKey);
        const creatorToken = getAssociatedTokenAddressSync(this.usdcMint, this.provider.publicKey);
        const builder = this.program.methods
          .releaseFunds(invoiceId, releaseSmallestUnit)
          .accounts({
            invoice: invoiceAddress,
            escrow: escrowAddress,
            creatorToken: creatorToken,
            usdcMint: this.usdcMint,
            creator: this.provider.publicKey,
            associatedTokenProgram: ASSOCIATED_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
            tokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
            systemProgram: SystemProgram.programId,
          });
        tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      }
      return { success: true, data: { signature: tx } };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('releaseFunds', error);
      return { success: false, error: this.parseError(error) };
    }
  }

  async fetchInvoice(invoiceId: string, creator: PublicKey): Promise<SDKResult<InvoiceData>> {
    try {
      if (!this.initialized || !this.program) {
        return { success: false, error: this.initError || "SDK not initialized" };
      }
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) {
        return { success: false, error: "Network unavailable" };
      }
      const [invoiceAddress] = await this.getInvoicePDA(invoiceId, creator);
      try {
        const invoiceAccessor = (this.program.account as any).invoice || (this.program.account as any).Invoice;
        if (invoiceAccessor) {
          const invoice = await invoiceAccessor.fetch(invoiceAddress);
          const parsed = this.parseInvoiceData(invoice);
          if (parsed) return { success: true, data: parsed };
        }
      } catch (anchorError) {
        console.log('Anchor fetch failed, trying direct RPC:', anchorError);
      }
      const accountInfo = await this.provider.connection.getAccountInfo(invoiceAddress);
      if (!accountInfo || !accountInfo.data) {
        return { success: false, error: "Invoice not found" };
      }
      const decoded = this.decodeInvoiceAccount(accountInfo.data);
      const parsed = this.parseInvoiceData(decoded);
      if (!parsed) return { success: false, error: "Failed to decode invoice data" };
      return { success: true, data: parsed };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('fetchInvoice', error);
      const message = this.parseError(error);
      if (message.includes('Account does not exist') || message.includes('not found')) {
        return { success: false, error: "Invoice not found" };
      }
      return { success: false, error: message };
    }
  }

  async fetchInvoicesByCreator(creator?: PublicKey): Promise<SDKResult<Array<{ publicKey: PublicKey; account: InvoiceData }>>> {
    const targetCreator = creator || this.provider.publicKey;
    if (!targetCreator) return { success: false, error: "No creator provided" };
    try {
      if (!this.initialized || !this.program) {
        return { success: false, error: this.initError || "SDK not initialized" };
      }
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) {
        return { success: false, error: "Network unavailable" };
      }
      try {
        const invoiceAccessor = (this.program.account as any).invoice || (this.program.account as any).Invoice;
        if (invoiceAccessor) {
          const allInvoices = await this.withTimeout(invoiceAccessor.all(), 8_000);
          if (Array.isArray(allInvoices)) {
            const filtered = allInvoices.filter((inv: any) => {
              try {
                return inv?.account?.creator?.toString() === targetCreator.toString();
              } catch { return false; }
            });
            const mapped = filtered.map((inv: any) => {
              const parsed = this.parseInvoiceData(inv.account);
              return { publicKey: inv.publicKey, account: parsed as InvoiceData };
            }).filter((inv: any) => inv.account !== null);
            return { success: true, data: mapped };
          }
        }
      } catch (anchorError) {
        console.log('Anchor fetchAll failed, trying direct RPC:', anchorError);
      }
      const accounts = await this.provider.connection.getProgramAccounts(this.programId, {
        filters: [
          { memcmp: { offset: 0, bytes: utils.bytes.bs58.encode(INVOICE_DISCRIMINATOR) } },
        ],
      });
      if (!accounts?.length) return { success: true, data: [] };
      const targetCreatorStr = targetCreator.toBase58();
      const mapped = accounts
        .filter(acc => acc.account.data.length >= MIN_INVOICE_BYTES)
        .map((acc) => {
          try {
            const decoded = this.decodeInvoiceAccount(acc.account.data);
            const parsed = this.parseInvoiceData(decoded);
            if (parsed && parsed.creator?.toString() === targetCreatorStr)
              return { publicKey: acc.pubkey, account: parsed };
          } catch (e) {
            console.error('Failed to decode account:', e);
          }
          return null;
        }).filter((inv): inv is { publicKey: PublicKey; account: InvoiceData } => inv !== null);
      return { success: true, data: mapped };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('fetchInvoicesByCreator', error);
      return { success: true, data: [] };
    }
  }

  async fetchInvoicesByClient(client?: PublicKey): Promise<SDKResult<Array<{ publicKey: PublicKey; account: InvoiceData }>>> {
    const targetClient = client || this.provider.publicKey;
    if (!targetClient) return { success: false, error: 'No client provided' };
    if (!this.initialized || !this.program) return { success: false, error: this.initError || 'SDK not initialized' };
    try {
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) return { success: false, error: 'Network unavailable' };
      const targetStr = targetClient.toString();
      try {
        const invoiceAccessor = (this.program.account as any).invoice || (this.program.account as any).Invoice;
        if (invoiceAccessor) {
          const allInvoices = await this.withTimeout(invoiceAccessor.all(), 8_000);
          if (Array.isArray(allInvoices)) {
            const filtered = allInvoices.filter((inv: any) => {
              try {
                const clientField = inv?.account?.client;
                if (!clientField) return false;
                let clientKey: string;
                if (typeof clientField === 'string') {
                  clientKey = clientField;
                } else if (clientField.toBase58) {
                  clientKey = clientField.toBase58();
                } else if (clientField.toString) {
                  clientKey = clientField.toString();
                } else if (clientField.key) {
                  clientKey = clientField.key.toString();
                } else {
                  clientKey = String(clientField);
                }
                return clientKey === targetStr;
              } catch { return false; }
            });
            const mapped = filtered.map((inv: any) => {
              const parsed = this.parseInvoiceData(inv.account);
              return { publicKey: inv.publicKey, account: parsed as InvoiceData };
            }).filter((inv: any) => inv.account !== null);
            return { success: true, data: mapped };
          }
        }
      } catch (anchorError) {
        console.log('Anchor fetchAll failed for client invoices, trying RPC fallback:', anchorError);
      }
      const accounts = await this.provider.connection.getProgramAccounts(this.programId, {
        filters: [
          { memcmp: { offset: 0, bytes: utils.bytes.bs58.encode(INVOICE_DISCRIMINATOR) } },
        ],
      });
      if (!accounts?.length) return { success: true, data: [] };
      const mapped = accounts
        .filter(acc => acc.account.data.length >= MIN_INVOICE_BYTES)
        .map((acc) => {
          try {
            const decoded = this.decodeInvoiceAccount(acc.account.data);
            const parsed = this.parseInvoiceData(decoded);
            if (!parsed) return null;
            if (!parsed.client) return null;
            if (parsed.client.toString() !== targetStr) return null;
            return { publicKey: acc.pubkey, account: parsed };
          } catch { return null; }
        }).filter(Boolean) as Array<{ publicKey: PublicKey; account: InvoiceData }>;
      return { success: true, data: mapped };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('fetchInvoicesByClient', error);
      return { success: false, error: this.parseError(error) };
    }
  }

  async getSolPriceUsd(): Promise<number | null> {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `https://hermes.pyth.network/v2/updates/price/latest?ids[]=${PYTH_SOL_USD_FEED_ID}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const data = await res.json();
      const price = data?.parsed?.[0]?.price;
      if (!price) return null;
      const computed = parseFloat(price.price) * Math.pow(10, price.expo);
      if (!isFinite(computed) || computed < 0.10 || computed > 100_000) return null;
      return computed;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  async requestRelease(
    invoiceId: string,
    _tokenType?: TokenType,
  ): Promise<SDKResult<{ signature: string }>> {
    if (!this.provider.publicKey) return { success: false, error: 'Wallet not connected' };
    if (!this.initialized || !this.program) return { success: false, error: this.initError || 'SDK not initialized' };
    try {
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) return { success: false, error: 'Network unavailable' };
      const [invoiceAddress] = await this.getInvoicePDA(invoiceId, this.provider.publicKey);
      const builder = this.program.methods
        .requestRelease(invoiceId)
        .accounts({ invoice: invoiceAddress, creator: this.provider.publicKey });
      const tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      return { success: true, data: { signature: tx } };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('requestRelease', error);
      return { success: false, error: this.parseError(error) };
    }
  }

  async approveRelease(
    invoiceId: string,
    creatorPubkey: PublicKey
  ): Promise<SDKResult<{ signature: string }>> {
    if (!this.provider.publicKey) return { success: false, error: 'Wallet not connected' };
    if (!this.initialized || !this.program) return { success: false, error: this.initError || 'SDK not initialized' };
    try {
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) return { success: false, error: 'Network unavailable' };
      const [invoiceAddress] = await this.getInvoicePDA(invoiceId, creatorPubkey);
      const builder = this.program.methods
        .approveRelease(invoiceId)
        .accounts({ invoice: invoiceAddress, client: this.provider.publicKey });
      const tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      return { success: true, data: { signature: tx } };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('approveRelease', error);
      return { success: false, error: this.parseError(error) };
    }
  }

  async raiseDispute(
    invoiceId: string,
    creatorPubkey: PublicKey
  ): Promise<SDKResult<{ signature: string }>> {
    if (!this.provider.publicKey) return { success: false, error: 'Wallet not connected' };
    if (!this.initialized || !this.program) return { success: false, error: this.initError || 'SDK not initialized' };
    try {
      if (!(await this.testConnection())) return { success: false, error: 'Network unavailable' };
      const [invoiceAddress] = await this.getInvoicePDA(invoiceId, creatorPubkey);
      const builder = this.program.methods
        .raiseDispute(invoiceId)
        .accounts({ invoice: invoiceAddress, client: this.provider.publicKey });
      const tx = await this.sendTx(builder);
      return { success: true, data: { signature: tx } };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logError('raiseDispute', error);
      return { success: false, error: this.parseError(error) };
    }
  }

  isAutoReleaseReady(invoice: InvoiceData): boolean {
    if (!invoice.completionRequestedAt) return false;
    const requestedAt = invoice.completionRequestedAt.toNumber();
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    return now - requestedAt > 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;
  }

  autoReleaseSecondsRemaining(invoice: InvoiceData): number {
    if (!invoice.completionRequestedAt) return -1;
    const requestedAt = invoice.completionRequestedAt.toNumber();
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    const elapsed = now - requestedAt;
    const timeout = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;
    return Math.max(0, timeout - elapsed);
  }

  formatAmount(amount: BN | number, tokenType: TokenType): string {
    const value = amount instanceof BN ? this.fromSmallestUnit(amount, tokenType) : amount;
    const symbol = tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 'USDC' : 'SOL';
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: tokenType === TokenType.USDC ? 2 : 4,
    }).format(value) + ' ' + symbol;
  }

  formatCurrency(amount: number): string {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'USD',
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(amount);
  }

  getProgramId(): PublicKey {
    if (!this.program) throw new Error('SDK not initialized');
    return this.program.programId;
  }

  getUSDCMint(): PublicKey {
    return this.usdcMint;
  }
}

export default EscrowPaySDK;

import type { Wallet } from '@coral-xyz/anchor';
import type { ConnectedStandardSolanaWallet } from '@privy-io/react-auth/solana';
import { PublicKey, Transaction, VersionedTransaction } from '@solana/web3.js';
import { PRIVY_SOLANA_CHAIN } from './solanaConfig';

type AnchorTransaction = Transaction | VersionedTransaction;
type WalletSource =
  | ConnectedStandardSolanaWallet
  | (() => ConnectedStandardSolanaWallet | null | undefined);

function getWallet(source: WalletSource): ConnectedStandardSolanaWallet | null | undefined {
  return typeof source === 'function' ? source() : source;
}

function serializeTransaction(tx: AnchorTransaction): Uint8Array {
  if (tx instanceof VersionedTransaction) {
    return tx.serialize();
  }

  return tx.serialize({
    requireAllSignatures: false,
    verifySignatures: false,
  });
}

function deserializeSignedTransaction<T extends AnchorTransaction>(
  originalTx: T,
  signedTransaction: Uint8Array,
): T {
  return (originalTx instanceof VersionedTransaction
    ? VersionedTransaction.deserialize(signedTransaction)
    : Transaction.from(signedTransaction)) as T;
}

async function signPrivyTransaction<T extends AnchorTransaction>(
  walletSource: WalletSource,
  tx: T,
): Promise<T> {
  const privyWallet = getWallet(walletSource);
  if (!privyWallet) throw new Error('Wallet disconnected');

  const { signedTransaction } = await privyWallet.signTransaction({
    transaction: serializeTransaction(tx),
    address: privyWallet.address,
    chain: PRIVY_SOLANA_CHAIN,
  });

  return deserializeSignedTransaction(tx, signedTransaction);
}

export function createPrivySolanaAnchorWallet(
  walletSource: WalletSource,
  publicKeyOverride?: PublicKey,
): Wallet {
  const privyWallet = getWallet(walletSource);
  const publicKey = publicKeyOverride ?? (privyWallet ? new PublicKey(privyWallet.address) : null);
  if (!publicKey) throw new Error('Wallet disconnected');

  return {
    publicKey,
    signTransaction: <T extends AnchorTransaction>(tx: T) => signPrivyTransaction(walletSource, tx),
    signAllTransactions: <T extends AnchorTransaction>(txs: T[]) =>
      Promise.all(txs.map((tx) => signPrivyTransaction(walletSource, tx))),
  };
}

import type { ConnectedStandardSolanaWallet } from '@privy-io/react-auth/solana';
import bs58 from 'bs58';
import { PRIVY_SOLANA_CHAIN } from './solanaConfig';

type SignAndSendTransaction = (input: {
  transaction: Uint8Array;
  wallet: ConnectedStandardSolanaWallet;
  chain?: typeof PRIVY_SOLANA_CHAIN;
  options?: {
    sponsor?: boolean;
  };
}) => Promise<{ signature: Uint8Array | string }>;

export function normalizeSolanaSignature(signature: Uint8Array | string): string {
  if (typeof signature === 'string') return signature;
  return bs58.encode(signature);
}

export async function sendSponsoredSolanaTransaction(
  signAndSendTransaction: SignAndSendTransaction,
  wallet: ConnectedStandardSolanaWallet,
  transaction: Uint8Array,
): Promise<string> {
  const result = await signAndSendTransaction({
    transaction,
    wallet,
    chain: PRIVY_SOLANA_CHAIN,
    options: { sponsor: true },
  });

  return normalizeSolanaSignature(result.signature);
}

import { clusterApiUrl } from '@solana/web3.js';

export const SOLANA_CLUSTER = 'devnet';
export const PRIVY_SOLANA_CHAIN = `solana:${SOLANA_CLUSTER}` as const;

export function getSolanaRpcUrl(): string {
  return import.meta.env.VITE_SOLANA_RPC_URL || clusterApiUrl(SOLANA_CLUSTER);
}

export function getSolanaExplorerTxUrl(signature: string): string {
  return `https://explorer.solana.com/tx/${signature}?cluster=${SOLANA_CLUSTER}`;
}

export function getSolanaExplorerAddressUrl(address: string): string {
  return `https://explorer.solana.com/address/${address}?cluster=${SOLANA_CLUSTER}`;
}

                      await copy(reputationLink, () => {
                        setCopiedReputation(true);
                        setTimeout(() => setCopiedReputation(false), 1500);
                      });
                    }}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium"

                      border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
                      fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif',
                    }}
                  >
                    {copiedReputation ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    {copiedReputation ? 'Copied' : 'Copy link'}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', color: '#94A3B8', fontSize: '14px', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                  Your reputation page aggregates invoice history across every wallet linked to this account.
                  It is the public record you can share with clients.
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  {profile?.profile_slug ? (
                    <Link
                      to={`/profile/account/${profile.profile_slug}`}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF', color: '#0D1117', textDecoration: 'none', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}
                    >
                      Open reputation page
                      <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Link>
                  ) : (
                    <Link
                      to="/wallet"
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: '#2DD4BF', color: '#0D1117', textDecoration: 'none', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}
                    >
                      Register a wallet
                      <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Link>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            <section style={cardStyle} className="p-5">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <p style={labelStyle}>Rewards</p>
                  <p style={{ ...valueStyle, fontSize: '1.4rem', marginTop: '4px' }}>Payout queue</p>
                </div>
                <span className="rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,212,191,0.12)', color: '#2DD4BF', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}>
                  Manual cycle
                </span>
              </div>

              {loading && !referrals ? (
                <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2" style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', color: '#94A3B8', fontSize: '13px' }}>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Loading rewards...
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                  {(['USDC', 'SOL'] as const).map(tokenType => {
                    const bucket = summary[tokenType];
                    const total = bucket.matured + bucket.requestable;
                    return (
                      <div key={tokenType} className="rounded-xl p-3" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <p style={labelStyle}>{tokenType}</p>
                          <p style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, color: '#F8FAFC' }}>{total.toFixed(tokenType === 'USDC' ? 2 : 4)}</p>
                        </div>
                        <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', color: '#94A3B8', fontSize: '12px', marginTop: '6px' }}>
                          {bucket.matured.toFixed(tokenType === 'USDC' ? 2 : 4)} matured · {bucket.requestable.toFixed(tokenType === 'USDC' ? 2 : 4)} ready
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}

                  <div className="rounded-xl p-3" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1C2128', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
                    <p style={labelStyle}>Latest request</p>
                    <p style={{ fontFamily: '"Space Grotesk", sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, color: '#F8FAFC', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                      {latestPayout ? `${latestPayout.token_type} · ${latestPayout.status}` : 'No request yet'}
                    </p>
                    <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', color: '#94A3B8', fontSize: '12px', marginTop: '6px', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                      {latestPayout
                        ? `Cycle: ${latestPayout.payout_cycle_date ?? '—'} · Deadline: ${latestPayout.request_deadline ? new Date(latestPayout.request_deadline).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }) : '—'}`
                        : 'Completed invoices become requestable on the next payout cycle once the $10 threshold is met.'}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {referralError && (
                    <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', color: '#FCD34D', fontSize: '12px', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                      {referralError}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>

            <section style={cardStyle} className="p-5">
              <p style={labelStyle}>Profile settings</p>
              <p style={{ ...valueStyle, fontSize: '1.4rem', marginTop: '4px' }}>Edit your personal defaults</p>
              <p style={{ fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif', color: '#94A3B8', fontSize: '14px', marginTop: '10px', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                Keep your display name, notification email, and default token in sync with the invoices you send.
              </p>
              <Link
                to="/settings"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium mt-4"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)', color: '#F8FAFC', textDecoration: 'none', fontFamily: '"DM Sans", sans-serif' }}
              >
                Open profile settings
                <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Link>
            </section>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AccountPage;
